Taiwan Export Growth Slows Sharply — Exports from Taiwan climbed by 39% year-on-year to USD 67.62 billion in April 2026, slowing sharply from a 61.8% surge and falling well below market expectations of a 55% increase. Still, export growth remained solid, supported by sustained global demand for semiconductors and electronics, which helped offset disruptions linked to the Middle East conflict. By sector, exports continued to be led by information, communication and audio-video products (62.3%), followed by electronic parts (38.9%) and machinery (12.9%). In contrast, shipments of base metals and articles of base metals (-0.4%) and chemicals (-4.3%) declined. All major trading partners saw increased exports, namely the US (63.8%), Mainland China and Hong Kong (15.8%), ASEAN (36.8%), Europe (64.2%), Japan (28.4%), and South Korea (39.3%). For the January–April period, total exports reached USD 263.35 billion, up 47.8% compared with the same period in the previous year.

【華資實業：2025年營收6.29億元 擬每股派現0.0225元】華資實業公告稱，2025年實現營業收入6.29億元，同比增長；淨利潤5902.02萬元，同比大幅增加。主要因黃原膠專案投產增收、投資收益增加等。此外，公司擬向全體股東每股派發現金紅利0.0225元（含稅），合計擬派發現金紅利1091.10萬元，佔2025年度歸屬於上市公司股東淨利潤的18.49%。同時，公司將審議增加經營範圍並修訂《公司章程》的議案。

【若英國選舉引發拋售 摩根大通資管傾向於逢低買入英鎊】摩根大通資產管理公司表示，若英國地方選舉結果導致英鎊遭遇拋壓，該機構將準備趁機買入。初步計票結果顯示，首相基爾·斯塔默領導的工黨可能遭遇重挫。這家美國資產管理公司的外匯策略主管Nick Wall表示，英國的政治風險在很大程度上已經反映在英鎊及英國國債價格中；即便糟糕的選舉結果引發對斯塔默領導地位的挑戰，潛在競爭者也會謹慎維持財政紀律，這應有助於支撐英國金融市場。

【機構：油價 “負面殺傷力” 拖累印度股市】巴賈傑金融服務投資總裁拉克希米・艾耶表示，油價需企穩在100 美元下方，印度股市才能重拾上漲動能；目前小盤股已率先走強並步入牛市行情。艾耶稱：“原油仍是市場中最捉摸不定的變數，時而成為行情主角，而更多時候，原油正展現出利空拖累的負面一面。”艾耶警示，印度小盤股已出現過度樂觀情緒，後續行情將呈現個股分化特徵。她還指出，受伊朗局勢影響，分析師對印度企業15%—16%的盈利增長預測並不現實；本季度將成為企業盈利的嚴峻考驗，甚至可能觸發市場回撥。

【高華科技：持股5%以上股東減持180萬股 減持計劃實施完畢】高華科技公告稱，持股5%以上股東黃標因自身資金需求，原計劃透過集中競價或大宗交易方式減持不超180萬股，佔總股本比例不超0.97%。截至2026年5月7日，黃標透過集中競價交易方式減持180萬股（佔總股本0.97%），減持價格區間為34.80 - 42.17元/股，減持總金額6800.53萬元，本次減持計劃已實施完畢。減持後，黃標持股1997萬股，佔比10.74%。

【投資者擔心OpenAI估值難確定 軟銀將100億美元保證金貸款目標下調40%】據知情人士透露，在一些投資者表現出猶豫之後，軟銀集團已將用OpenAI股權作抵押貸款100億美元的計劃縮減了40%。他們表示，在近幾周與潛在貸款提供方的磋商中，軟銀和幫它尋求這筆保證金貸款的銀行家談到的目標金額已經低至60億美元。相關討論仍在進行中，包括最終借款規模在內的細節仍可能發生變化。因事未公開，知情人士要求匿名。他們還說，這是因為被推介的投資者表達了擔憂，認為OpenAI這樣一家未上市公司很難確定估值。

【助力統一大市場建設 國內貿易交易指引今日釋出】今天（8日），中國物流與採購聯合會、中國商業聯合會、中國紡織工業聯合會、中國輕工業聯合會、中國網路社會組織聯合會等17家全國性行業協會商會，在商務部等相關部門的指導下，在北京共同釋出《國內貿易交易指引（試行）》，為從事批發、零售、物流、住宿餐飲等國內貿易的企業，提供清晰、明確、可操作的行為規範，助力全國統一大市場建設。據介紹，《國內貿易交易指引（試行）》聚焦國內貿易全流程，對訂立交易合同、貨物交付驗收、賬期及支付、爭議解決、規範商業行為等各環節進行了明確和規定。（央視新聞）

【雲南檢察機關依法對俞志明涉嫌貪汙、受賄、國有公司人員濫用職權案提起公訴】據最高檢訊息，日前，雲南省建設投資控股集團有限公司原副總經理俞志明涉嫌貪汙罪、受賄罪、國有公司人員濫用職權罪一案，由雲南省監察委員會調查終結，移送檢察機關審查起訴。經雲南省人民檢察院指定管轄，由大理州人民檢察院依法向大理州中級人民法院提起公訴。案件正在進一步辦理中。 檢察機關在審查起訴階段，依法告知了被告人俞志明享有的訴訟權利，並依法訊問了被告人，聽取了辯護人的意見。大理州人民檢察院起訴指控：被告人俞志明利用擔任雲南省城鄉建設投資有限公司董事長、雲南省建設投資控股集團有限公司副總經理等職務上的便利，夥同他人非法佔有國有資產，數額特別巨大；其利用擔任雲南省第四建築工程公司董事長，雲南省城鄉建設投資有限公司董事長，雲南省建設投資控股集團有限公司總經理助理、副總經理等職務上的便利，為他人在工程專案承攬、職務晉升等方面提供幫助，非法收受他人財物，數額特別巨大；其在擔任雲南省城鄉建設投資有限公司董事長期間，濫用職權，違規建設工程專案，造成國有資產特別重大損失，依法應當以貪汙罪、受賄罪、國有公司人員濫用職權罪追究其刑事責任。

【旭升集團：廣州工控集團完成收購 成控股股東】旭升集團公告稱，2025年12月22日，廣州工控集團及其一致行動人與原控股股東徐旭東及其一致行動人簽署協議，擬受讓3.13億股，佔總股本27.05%。本次權益變動後，控股股東由徐旭東變更為廣州工控集團，實控人變更為廣州市人民政府。股份協議轉讓於2026年3月26日完成過戶登記，4月1日全部完成交割過戶。截至3月31日，廣州工控集團依法規範運作，嚴格履行承諾，未改變公司主營業務等，公司也未為其提供擔保或借款。

Taiwan Trade Surplus Misses Expectations — Taiwan’s trade surplus widened to USD 14.35 billion in April 2026 from USD 7.4 billion in the same month of the previous year, but missed market expectations of USD 19.1 billion. Exports soared 39% year-on-year to USD 67.62 billion, mainly driven by higher sales of information, communication and audio-video products (62.3%) and parts of electronic products (33.7%). Among major trading partners, shipments rose strongly to the US (63.8%), as well as Mainland China and Hong Kong (15.8%) and ASEAN (36.8%). Meanwhile, imports increased 29.2% from a year earlier to USD 53.27 billion, primarily due to higher purchases of parts of electronic products (61.3%) and information, communication and audio-video products (33.2%). Import growth was strongest from Mainland China and Hong Kong (28.6%), ASEAN (52.9%) and South Korea (78.3%). For the January–April period, the country’s trade surplus reached USD 67.3 billion, with exports surging 47.8% while imports rose 33.2%.

【眾信旅遊：積極推出巴西深度遊產品 最佳化南美旅遊產品】巴西政府7日宣佈，自2026年5月11日起，對持普通護照的中國公民實施免簽入境政策。從眾信旅遊獲悉，未來，眾信旅遊將積極推出巴西深度遊產品，並最佳化現有南美旅遊產品。眾信旅遊澳美非事業部總經理許寧表示，巴西作為南美特色最為突出的目的地，多年來深受中國遊客的喜愛，巴西足球、巴西狂歡節等特色文化體驗更是中國遊客到訪巴西不可或缺的組成部分。本次巴西免籤政策的落地，將會對目的地市場產生明顯的拉動作用。據介紹，目前眾信旅遊已成為國內南美旅遊市場供應量前三的旅行社之一。（上證報）

Bulgaria Construction Output Growth Slows in March — Construction output in Bulgaria rose 7.7% year-on-year in March 2026, slowing from an upwardly revised 9.7% increase in the previous month. Growth moderated in both building construction (12.6% vs 16.9% in February) and civil engineering works (5.7% vs 7.4%). Meanwhile, specialized construction activities continued to rise (3.9% vs 3.8%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, construction output increased 0.6%, decelerating from an upwardly revised 4.0% rise in February. Building construction fell slightly (-0.2% vs 3.0%), while activity slowed down in civil engineering (0.1% vs 3.2%) and specialized construction (1.8% vs 5.9%).

【貴州省市場監督管理局原局長丁雄軍被公訴】日前，貴州省市場監督管理局原黨組書記、局長丁雄軍（正廳級）涉嫌受賄罪、洗錢罪一案，由貴州省監察委員會調查終結，移送檢察機關審查起訴。經貴州省人民檢察院指定管轄，由黔東南州人民檢察院依法向黔東南州中級人民法院提起公訴。案件正在進一步辦理中。檢察機關在審查起訴階段，依法告知了被告人丁雄軍享有的訴訟權利，並依法訊問了被告人，聽取了辯護人的意見。黔東南州人民檢察院起訴指控：被告人丁雄軍利用擔任貴州省清鎮市委常委、副市長，貴陽市兩湖一庫管理局黨委書記、局長，貴陽國家高新技術產業開發區黨工委書記、貴陽市白雲區委書記，貴陽市人民政府秘書長，畢節市委常委、市人民政府副市長，貴州省能源局黨組書記、局長，中國貴州茅臺酒廠（集團）有限責任公司黨委書記、董事長等職務上的便利，以及職權或地位形成的便利條件，為他人謀取利益，非法收受他人財物，數額特別巨大；掩飾、隱瞞部分受賄所得的來源和性質，情節嚴重，依法應當以受賄罪、洗錢罪追究其刑事責任。（最高檢）

World Food Prices Highest Since 2023 — The FAO Food Price Index rose 1.6% to 130.7 points in April 2026, marking a third consecutive monthly increase and reaching the highest since February 2023. Prices for vegetable oils jumped 5.9% to hit a fresh June-2022 high, driven by palm, soy, sunflower and rapeseed oils amid disruptions linked to the war with Iran. Prices of cereals rose 0.8% to its highest since February 2025, reflecting higher prices across major cereals, except sorghum and barley. Wheat went up 0.8% on drought concerns in parts of the US, expectations of lower rainfall in Australia, and prospects of reduced wheat plantings in 2026 due to elevated fertilizer and energy costs linked to disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz. Meat prices were up 1.2% to hit a record high. On the other hand, sugar declined 4.7%, amid expectations of ample global supplies in the current season and improved production prospects in China and Thailand. Dairy products decreased 1.1% driven by lower quotations for butter and cheese.

【塞爾維亞與中國企業簽署快速路專案合同】塞爾維亞政府與中國山東高速集團7日在貝爾格萊德簽署一項商業及預融資合同，合作建設連線塞爾維亞中部和東部地區的“卡拉喬爾傑領袖走廊”快速路專案。 塞爾維亞總統武契奇在簽約儀式上表示，這條快速路將有效連線首都貝爾格萊德南部郊區與塞中部地區。他高度評價中方合作伙伴展現出的高效率、嚴謹和責任感，並指出，塞爾維亞近年來基礎設施建設快速發展，很大程度上得益於與中國企業的成功合作。 中國駐塞爾維亞大使李明表示，“卡拉喬爾傑領袖走廊”對促進塞爾維亞中東部地區互聯互通具有重要意義。專案成功簽約是中國企業深耕塞爾維亞市場的又一成果，也是中塞雙方賡續友誼、共謀發展的重要見證。 根據合同，專案一期全長83公里，預計於2035年前完成二期建設，屆時整條快速路總長將達到125公里。(新華社)

【美銀：菲律賓通脹率料在第四季度見頂】美銀證券分析師Jojo Gonzales在一份報告中表示，菲律賓的通脹率料將在第四季度見頂，同比接近10%。該分析師補充道：“這關鍵取決於中東衝突在下半年得到解決，且布倫特原油均價達到每桶92.50美元，這是我們的基準預期。”4月份通脹率飆升至三年多高點，表明價格上漲正迅速從燃料蔓延至電力和食品領域。美銀證券將菲律賓2026年和2027年的平均通脹率預期分別上調至7.3%和5.3%，高於此前對這兩年均為5.0%的預期。

【荷蘭國際：歐元幾乎未受特朗普關稅威脅影響，市場關注伊朗戰爭】荷蘭國際集團的Francesco Pesole在一份報告中表示，在伊朗戰爭主導局勢之際，歐元幾乎未受美國總統特朗普對歐盟發出最新關稅威脅的影響。特朗普警告稱，如果歐盟未能在7月4日之前批准與美國的貿易協議，他將對歐盟徵收高得多的關稅。Pesole表示，歐元缺乏反應是可以理解的，因為“地緣政治的波動性使得提前兩個月反映風險預期變得不切實際“。不過他表示，如果伊朗戰爭結束，貿易將成為特朗普接下來的議程。歐元上漲0.2%，至1.1744美元。荷蘭國際集團依然認為，如果美伊達成任何和平協議，歐元將升至1.18美元上方，但預計如果談判破裂，歐元將跌破1.17美元。

【長江防總：預計長江流域主汛期降水總體偏少】5月7日，記者從長江防汛抗旱總指揮部瞭解到，今年汛期長江流域氣候年景總體偏差，部分時段流域內可能旱澇並存。當前長江流域已全面進入汛期。據流域氣象中心最新預測，2026年長江流域汛期澇旱並重，長江中游旱重於澇，強對流天氣將多發重發。預計主汛期（6-8月）降水總體偏少。在空間上，金沙江、岷江、嘉陵江、長江下游等流域偏多一到二成，長江中上游面上偏少一到二成，其中中游幹流區偏少二到四成；時間演變上，6月下旬至7月上旬長江中下游地區有雨水集中期，7月中旬後隨著副熱帶高壓北抬，岷江、嘉陵江流域降雨將增多，四川盆地東部至長江中游將出現階段性高溫天氣，盛夏期颱風影響將增多。（央視新聞）

【財政部、中國證監會有關部門負責人就兩家內地會計師事務所獲准從事H股企業審計業務答記者問】請介紹一下內地與香港會計交流合作情況。

答：內地與香港會計界長期保持深入交流和密切合作關係。兩地會計、審計準則實現持續等效，為滬港通、深港通等兩地資本市場互聯互通提供了堅實支撐。粵港澳大灣區高階人才培養工程加快推進，有力支援了大灣區會計人才高地建設。在跨境監管合作方面，內地與香港先後簽署一系列合作備忘錄，線上索移交共享、監管資訊互通、審計工作底稿調取等方面建立了良好的協同機制。在考試開放方面，內地註冊會計師考試和全國會計專業技術資格考試向香港居民開放，兩地註冊會計師部分考試科目相互豁免。在會計服務方面，內地對香港會計專業人士實行國民待遇，允許取得中國註冊會計師資格的香港會計專業人士依法在內地設立會計師事務所、擔任會計師事務所合夥人（股東），香港會計專業人士註冊成為內地註冊會計師時享有審計工作經驗互認。上述政策舉措極大地便利了香港會計專業人士在內地就業創業。

未來財政部、中國證監會將會同香港監管機構持續推動兩地會計行業交流合作，深化在準則等效、監管協同、市場開放、資訊共享及專業服務等領域的務實合作，促進兩地會計行業高質量發展。

【俄國防部稱擊落兩百多架烏克蘭無人機】俄羅斯國防部5月8日通報稱，莫斯科時間當天0時至早晨7時，俄防空系統在莫斯科州、別爾哥羅德州、布良斯克州等多地共攔截和擊毀264架烏克蘭無人機。根據俄羅斯首都莫斯科市市長索比亞寧在其社交媒體釋出的訊息，截至莫斯科時間8日上午8時22分，當天已有超過25架飛往莫斯科的無人機被擊落。對於以上訊息，烏克蘭方面目前暫無回應。（央視新聞）

【兩家內地會計師事務所獲准從事H股企業審計】經財政部、中國證監會內地會計師事務所從事H股企業審計業務稽核推薦委員會稽核認可，並經香港監管機構確認，容誠會計師事務所（特殊普通合夥）、天職國際會計師事務所（特殊普通合夥）獲准自2026年5月15日起，可以本所名義在香港資本市場為符合條件的H股公司出具審計報告。增補兩家內地會計師事務所從事H股企業審計業務，對於降低內地企業在港上市成本、推動兩地資本市場互聯互通、促進香港融入國家發展大局具有積極而深遠的意義，將有助於進一步深化內地與香港會計交流合作，推動兩地會計行業共同發展。財政部、中國證監會將根據內地與香港有關監管要求，對獲准從事H股企業審計業務的會計師事務所進行嚴格管理，確保持續符合要求，推動其高質量完成H股企業審計業務。

【外交部：中國的發展從來不是誰的威脅】5月8日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。有記者問，我們注意到，近期一些西方媒體和智庫炒作“中國衝擊2.0”，稱中國在新能源、人工智慧等高技術領域快速發展，並依賴國外市場吸收過剩產能，擠佔發達國家市場份額，對全球經濟造成比傳統製造業時代“更嚴重的衝擊”。同時也有外媒評論稱，有關論調忽視中國工業生態體系正在發生的真實創新，中國出口恰恰是全球經濟在動盪前行中所需的助推力，比以往更加不可或缺。發言人對此有何評論？對此，林劍表示，從“世界工廠”到“世界市場”和“創新高地”，中國發展靠的是創新驅動的真本事，給世界帶來的是實實在在的合作機遇與空間。林劍指出，開放帶來進步，合作才能共贏。中國的發展，從來不是誰的“威脅”，而是推動各國共同發展的增量。中國將繼續擴大高水平對外開放，捍衛多邊貿易體制，以自身穩定發展為世界經濟提供更多確定性和新動能。

【福達股份：2026年一季度營收5.04億元 同比增長6.95%】福達股份公告稱，2026年5月8日，公司以“影片錄播和網路互動”方式召開2025年度暨2026年第一季度業績說明會。2026年一季度，公司實現營業收入5.04億元，同比增長6.95%；歸母淨利潤0.75億元，同比增長15.36%；扣非淨利潤0.72億元，同比增長10.21%。公司表示，一季度國內乘用車市場疲軟，公司積極把握髮電市場增量需求及商用車週期復甦機遇，拓展相關領域市場，有效對沖了乘用車市場波動影響。

Euro Nears Three-Week High on ECB Hike Expectations — The euro traded above $1.17, approaching its strongest level since April 20, as markets turned more hawkish on the European Central Bank’s policy outlook amid renewed inflation concerns. Brent crude oil prices rose back above $100 per barrel after clashes between the US and Iran near the Strait of Hormuz, raising fears of further instability in the region’s fragile ceasefire. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump warned the European Union that he would impose "much higher" tariffs on EU goods unless the bloc eliminates its tariffs on US products by July 4. Money markets are pricing in over 50 basis points of ECB tightening, or at least two rate hikes, by year-end, with a more than 75% chance of a first increase in June. Several ECB officials have recently signaled a higher likelihood of rate hikes due to persistent inflation pressures.

【四川：到2027年新一代智慧終端、智慧體等應用普及率超70%】四川省人民政府辦公廳近日印發《四川省加快推進“人工智慧+”一號創新工程實施方案》，方案提出，到2027年，實現人工智慧與重點領域廣泛深度融合，新一代智慧終端、智慧體等應用普及率超70%，形成2—3個具有全國競爭力的細分賽道產業叢集，重點支援打造10個左右具有全國影響力的行業標杆大模型、研發一批輕量化端側模型，建設10個左右行業領域重大標誌性應用場景，建成20個左右應用場景實驗室等公共平臺。到2030年，爭創1—2個國家級新興產業叢集、建設200家智慧製造先進工廠，集聚人工智慧企業2500家以上、產業規模突破4000億元，加快建成具有全國影響力的人工智慧創新策源地和應用先導區，新一代智慧終端、智慧體等應用普及率超90%。到2035年，全面步入智慧經濟和智慧社會發展新階段。

【報告：2025年線上渠道首超線下成購險第一入口，AI成投保決策核心輔助】5月7日，清華大學五道口金融學院中國保險與養老金融研究中心、元保集團聯合釋出的《2025年中國網際網路保險消費者洞察報告》顯示，傳統保險公司線上渠道佔比達63%，首次超越線下成為消費者購險首選入口，近六成網際網路保險消費者從線下遷移至線上，便捷投保、靈活繳費、資訊透明為核心驅動因素 。報告指出，2025年網際網路保險呈現三大特徵：線上化、智慧化、理性化。社媒與短影片成為保險資訊核心觸達渠道，約四成使用者透過該路徑瞭解保險；AI工具滲透率大幅提升，透過AI大模型/APP查詢保險資訊的使用者佔比16%，同比增60%，超四成使用者購險前用AI對比產品，超半數將AI推薦作為決策參考 。消費端更趨理性，近六成使用者優先關注產品對比、理賠案例等專業內容，保障範圍、保額、理賠取代價格成為首要考量，從“價格敏感”轉向“價值敏感” 。新購市場中，意外險、車險、重疾險領跑，剛需保障優先成為主流邏輯，20-40歲青年為線上購險主力，老年群體線上保障需求持續釋放 。行業層面，網際網路保險保費預計突破7000億元，同比增25%以上，滲透率升至11.5%，從單一銷售渠道升級為行業數字化基礎設施。

FTSE MIB Extends Retreat — The FTSE MIB fell 0.5% to 49,000 on Friday, extending its pullback from record highs, as tariff threats and geopolitical tensions weighed on sentiment. President Trump warned that the European Union could face significantly higher tariffs as early as July 4 if it does not cut duties on US imports to zero. The remarks followed a call with European Commission President von der Leyen, who said negotiations were still progressing and that the EU was making “good progress” toward lowering trade barriers ahead of the deadline. Meanwhile, markets were also pressured by heightened tensions in the Middle East after the US conducted strikes on Iranian military targets in response to attacks on three US Navy destroyers in the Strait of Hormuz. Financial stocks led losses, with UniCredit (-1.4%), Intesa Sanpaolo (-1.2%), BPER Banca (-2.2%), and Banca Mediolanum (-1%), among the notable laggards. For the week, the index is heading for a second weekly advance.

Bund Yields Slightly Up as ECB Rate Hike Expectations Strengthen — Germany’s 10-year Bund yield edged higher to 3.02% as markets adopted a more hawkish stance on the European Central Bank’s policy outlook, driven by renewed inflation concerns. Brent crude oil prices climbed back above $100 per barrel following clashes between the US and Iran near the Strait of Hormuz, an escalation that risks further destabilizing a fragile ceasefire. Elsewhere, US President Donald Trump warned the European Union that he would increase tariffs on EU goods to "much higher levels" if the bloc does not reduce its tariffs on US goods to zero by July 4. Money markets are currently pricing in more than 50 basis points of tightening, or at least two rate hikes, by the end of the year, with over a 75% probability of a first increase in June. Several ECB board members have recently warned that the likelihood of a rate hike has risen due to persistent inflation pressures.

【外交部回應3家中國企業入選美國《時代》週刊 “最具影響力人工智慧公司”榜單】5月8日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。有記者問：日前，美國《時代》週刊釋出了“2026年最具影響力的10家人工智慧公司”榜單，中國有3家企業入選。有觀點稱這充分體現了中國AI產業和技術發展的成就。發言人對此有何回應？對此，林劍表示，在許多人工智慧相關評選中，中國企業和產品都榜上有名。這是科技自主創新與發展進步的直接體現。中國始終堅持走開放共贏的人工智慧創新之路，歡迎各國企業到中國市場的“健身房”一展身手，在創新發展中錘鍊筋骨、相互成就。（央視新聞）

【外交部闢謠外媒宏都拉斯相關報道】5月8日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。彭博社記者提問，有報道稱，宏都拉斯新任總統表示，新政府需要審查前任總統同中方達成的商業協議，其中包括使用華為的裝置等，宏都拉斯和美方正在就使用思科的裝置進行談判。中方對此有何評論？林劍指出，相關報道移花接木、挑撥是非，與事實不符，嚴重違背新聞職業道德。林劍強調，世界上只有一箇中國，臺灣是中國領土不可分割的一部分，中華人民共和國政府是代表全中國的唯一合法政府。一箇中國原則是國際社會普遍共識和國際關係基本準則，也是中洪發展關係的政治基礎和前提條件，容不得半點含糊。中洪建交以來，雙方本著相互尊重、平等協商的原則，開展各領域的務實合作，互利雙贏成果顯著造福兩國人民，也得到兩國人民的廣泛擁護。事實證明，堅持一箇中國原則是順應歷史發展大勢、契合時代進步潮流的正確決定，符合宏都拉斯國家和人民的根本利益。（北京日報）

India 10Y Yield Rises From Over 2-Week Low — The yield on India’s 10-year G-Sec rose to around 6.96%, edging higher after touching a more than two-week low, as renewed US-Iran tensions in the Middle East pushed oil prices higher and weighed on sentiment. Brent crude rose back above $100 per barrel, raising inflation concerns for the import-dependent economy and reinforcing expectations of stickier domestic price pressures, keeping bond yields elevated. At the same time, attention turned to the government’s INR 34,000 crore auction of the new 10-year bond, with investors assessing demand and pricing expectations around a cut-off yield near 6.95%. The additional supply added upward pressure on yields, as markets factored in absorption risk for the fresh issuance. Overall, higher oil prices and supply concerns from the weekly auction kept yields slightly firmer, even as broader global risk sentiment remained volatile amid ongoing geopolitical uncertainty.

Despite Friday’s decline, the STOXX 50 ended the week up 1.5%, while the STOXX 600 gained 0.8%.

Austria Industrial Output Rises in March — Industrial production in Austria rose 1.7% year-on-year in March 2026, accelerating from a revised flat reading in the previous month. The increase was driven mainly by stronger growth in the industrial sector (2.8% vs 1.0% in February), while construction output continued to decline, though at a slower pace (-3.0% vs -4.9%). Among the main industrial groupings, output increased notably for capital goods (9.4% vs 3.5%) and intermediate goods (1.2% vs 0.5%). Consumer durable goods production remained strong, although growth slowed slightly (15.8% vs 21.1%). Meanwhile, the decline in consumer non-durable goods eased (-2.3% vs -3.7%), while energy output turned negative (-7.2% vs 1.6%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial output grew 1.5% in March.

Markets are pricing in roughly 60 bps of Bank of England rate hikes, equivalent to at least two increases, before year-end.

Hungary Inflation Rate Picks Up to 2.1% — The annual inflation rate in Hungary rose to 2.1% in April 2026 from 1.8% in March, marking a three-month high. The acceleration was driven mainly by higher food prices, which rose to 1.5% after stalling in March, and a rebound in other goods, including other items and fuels (0.1% vs -0.7%). In contrast, price growth slowed in several categories, with alcoholic beverages and tobacco easing to 4.1% from 5.5%, clothing to 0.8% from 1.4%, and services edging down slightly to 4.0% from 4.1%, while consumer durables were unchanged at 2.7%. Household energy recorded a sharp swing, falling 0.4% from a 4.3% increase in March. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.4%, the same pace as in the prior period. Meanwhile, the annual core inflation rate, which excludes volatile items such as food and energy, rose to 2.2% from 1.9% in March, slightly below market expectations of 2.3%.

Slovakia Industrial Production Falls at Softer Pace — Industrial production in Slovakia fell 0.9% year-on-year in March 2026, improving from a 2.9% drop in February. The easing in the pace of decline was partly driven by a smaller drag from key industries, even as weakness persisted in core manufacturing sectors. The manufacture of transport equipment remained the main negative contributor, falling nearly 6% for a second consecutive month. Refined petroleum products also continued to weigh on output, plunging almost 46% year-on-year, though the broader industrial downturn was less severe than in prior months. This was partially offset by stronger performance in smaller sectors, including a 12% increase in food production and nearly 6% growth in electricity and gas supply. Overall, 7 of 15 monitored industrial sectors still recorded declines, but their combined impact was less pronounced than in February. On a seasonally adjusted basis, industrial production rose 0.7%.

South Korean Shares Set New Record — The benchmark KOSPI rose 0.11% to close at a fresh record high of 7,498 on Friday, extending its winning streak to a fourth straight session, as gains in AI-related chip stocks continued to support investor sentiment. The index opened lower amid risk aversion across Asian markets on news of renewed US-Iran tensions, but sentiment later stabilized after US President Donald Trump said the ceasefire with Iran remained in effect. Large-cap performance was mixed, with SK Hynix (1.93%), Hyundai Motor Company (7.17%), and Kia Corporation (4.38%) posting gains, while Samsung Electronics (-1.10%), Doosan Enerbility (-4.99%), and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (-5.05%) declined. Optimism surrounding Korea’s AI and semiconductor outlook continued to underpin the market, following strong earnings momentum and robust export demand tied to the global AI boom. Additional support came after South Korea posted a record current account surplus in March, driven by a sharp surge in semiconductor exports.

Spain Industrial Output Rebounds in March — Spain’s industrial production rose by 1.8% year-on-year in March 2026, following a downwardly revised 0.9% fall in February. This marks the first increase in industrial activity since last November, reflecting improved performance across consumer goods (3.2% vs 0.2% in February), of which non-durables (4.2% vs 0.7%); capital goods (3% vs 0.7%), and intermediate goods (1.8% vs -2.7%). Conversely, output declined for energy (-1.9% vs -1.6%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial activity surged by 2.3% in March, rebounding from a 0.1% decline in the prior month and recording the strongest growth since December 2024. Intermediate goods, capital goods, and energy were the key drivers, increasing by 3.1%, 2.9%, and 1.9%, respectively.

Corn Futures Stay at 3-Week Low — Corn futures held around $4.5 per bushel, trading near a three-week low as faster US planting progress outweighed production pressure from elevated global energy prices. Renewed clashes between the US and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz heightened concerns over prolonged energy supply disruptions, pushing global oil prices higher. Elevated input costs, including fertilizers, chemicals and diesel for irrigation, are squeezing margins and threatening yields for the nutrient-intensive crop. In response, farmers in key regions from the US to Europe are reducing corn acreage and shifting to less input-heavy crops to manage costs. However, faster-than-average US planting pace weighed on prices, with USDA crop progress report showing nationwide planting at 38% complete, ahead of the five-year average of 34%. Recent weather across the US Corn Belt has improved, with forecasts pointing to drier conditions that eased earlier concerns about planting delays following Midwest storms.

US Job Growth Seen Slowing in April — The US economy likely added 62K jobs in April 2026, following a 178K increase in March, which marked the strongest payroll gain since December 2024. While the figure would point to a moderation in hiring, it would also mark the first back-to-back monthly increase in employment in nearly a year, reinforcing signs that the US labor market is gradually cooling while remaining broadly resilient. Healthcare and social assistance likely continued to drive job creation, while manufacturing payrolls are expected to post another increase. Government employment, however, probably declined. The report is also expected to show the unemployment rate holding steady at 4.3%. Average hourly earnings likely rose 0.3% mom, slightly above March’s 0.2% increase. On an annual basis, wage growth is projected to accelerate to 3.8% from 3.5%. Analysts also note that it is still too early for any potential economic effects from the US-Israeli conflict with Iran to be reflected in the labor market data.

UK Natgas Prices Rebound from 2-Week Low — UK natural gas futures rose to 108.5 pence per therm, recovering from a two-week low as prospects for peace in the Middle East remained uncertain amid renewed tensions. The US military launched strikes on Iranian military targets on Thursday in response to attacks on its three destroyers in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, President Trump said the ceasefire remains in place despite the strikes, while Iranian TV reported that the situation is “back to normal,” providing some relief. These developments come as the US seeks to de-escalate tensions, while also awaiting Iran’s response to a proposal to reopen the strategic waterway. The near-closure of the strait has disrupted around one-fifth of global LNG supply, with the route facing restrictions from both sides. Although most gas from the Persian Gulf goes to Asia, the disruption has tightened global supply and intensified competition, fueling concerns in Europe as the region needs to replenish inventories before next winter.

Norway Manufacturing Output Hits 11-Month High — Norway’s manufacturing production rose 2.0% month-over-month in March 2026, rebounding from a 0.4% decline in the previous month. This marked the largest monthly increase since April 2025, driven by a rebound in output of food, beverages and tobacco (1.0% vs -1.6% in February), textiles, wearing apparel and leather (0.3% vs -0.3%), wood and wood products (1.9% vs -0.8%), rubber, plastic and mineral products (2.5% vs -2.4%), and ships, boats and oil platforms (5.1% vs -2.8%). Further gains were seen in paper and paper products (7.9% vs 3.3%), machinery and equipment (2.8% vs 1.1%), fabricated metal products (1.8% vs 0.4%), computer and electrical equipment (2.4% vs 0.7%), and transport equipment n.e.c. (1.6% vs 0.5%). Meanwhile, production declined in refined petroleum, chemicals and pharmaceuticals (-1.9% vs -1.3%) and basic metals (-0.4% vs 0.5%). On a yearly basis, manufacturing output grew 3.2% in March, rebounding from a 0.1% decline in the previous month.

Swiss Consumer Morale Better than Expected — Switzerland’s consumer sentiment index rose to -40 in April 2026, beating market expectations of -46 and improving slightly from -42 a year earlier. The increase was driven mainly by stronger views on the expected economic outlook, with that sub index improving to -58 from -67 in April 2025. Consumers also reported a slightly better assessment of their past financial situation compared with a year ago. Expectations for future personal finances were broadly unchanged, while the indicator measuring willingness to make major purchases remained weak despite a modest improvement from last year. Overall, sentiment stayed deeply negative, reflecting continued caution among Swiss households despite some improvement in economic expectations.

ASX 200 Sinks But Logs First Weekly Gain in Four — The S&P/ASX 200 tumbled 134 points, or 1.5%, to finish at 8,744 on Friday, ending two days of gains as profit-taking and broad sector weakness dragged the market lower. The sell-off followed Wall Street’s slump Thursday amid renewed Middle East tensions after U.S. and Iranian forces exchanged fire in the Strait of Hormuz, each blaming the other for the escalation. Sentiment was further pressured by the Reserve Bank’s third rate hike this year, earlier this week, lifting the cash rate to 4.35% amid persistent inflation risks and second-round price pressures from geopolitical uncertainty. Losses were broad-based, led by financials, retail trade, logistics, and energy minerals. The four major banks plunged between 1.5% and 4.8%. Other notable laggards included Wisetech Global (-4.6%), ASX Ltd. (-3.2%), Bluescope Steel Ltd. (-2.7%), and Lynas Rare Earths Ltd. (-2.5%). Still, markets edged up 0.2% for the week, up for the first time in four weeks, helped by bargain hunting.

Iron Ore Extends Rally on Stronger Steel Prices — Iron ore futures rose above CNY 815 per ton, climbing toward their strongest levels since February last year and heading for a fourth consecutive weekly gain as firmer steel prices continued to support demand for the key steelmaking material. Analysts said stronger steel prices have improved profit margins for mills, encouraging greater iron ore purchasing activity. Prices were also supported by a continued decline in steel inventories, which have now fallen for seven straight weeks, signaling potential restocking demand for raw materials. On the supply side, Brazilian iron ore shipments increased to 34.57 million tons in April from 30.07 million tons a year earlier, highlighting ample global supply conditions. Meanwhile, mining operations resumed this week at two blocks of Guinea’s massive Simandou iron ore project, operated by a consortium led by Baowu Resources, after workers ended a strike.

【US Said to Suspect Nvidia Chips Smuggled to Alibaba Via Thailand】A Bangkok-based company involved in Thailand’s national AI initiatives is suspected of helping divert billions of dollars worth of Super Micro Computer Inc. servers containing advanced Nvidia Corp. chips to China in violation of U.S. export controls, according to people familiar with the matter. U.S. prosecutors alleged in a March indictment that Super Micro’s co-founder worked with a Southeast Asian company identified only as “Company-1” and various brokers to route restricted AI semiconductors into China. The unidentified company was said to be Bangkok-based OBON Corp., while some servers allegedly ended up with Alibaba Group. Alibaba denied any involvement in smuggling activities and said it has no business relationship with Super Micro, OBON or the brokers mentioned in the indictment.

Sweden Factory Orders Fall 7.3% in March — Total orders received by the Swedish industry fell by 7.3% year-on-year in March 2026, reversing from a downwardly revised 0.6% increase in the previous month. Orders from foreign customers dropped by 14.5%, worsening from a 1.3% decline in February, while domestic orders rose 6.5%, accelerating from a 4.9% increase. Among industrial groups, the intermediate goods industry recorded a sharper decline (-25.4% vs -5.6%), while the durable consumer goods industry also turned negative (-1.8% vs 11.2%). Meanwhile, growth accelerated in the energy-related sector (19.3% vs 6.0%) and the non-durable consumer goods industry (10.7% vs 5.1%). On a monthly basis, industrial orders fell 1.4% in March, unchanged from an upwardly revised 1.4% decline in the previous month. In the first quarter of the year, total orders were down 4.0%, with the domestic market growing 3.7% and the export market declining 8.2%.

Seychelles Consumer Prices Fall in April — Consumer prices in Seychelles edged down by 0.01% in April 2026, reversing a 0.24% increase in the previous month. This marked the first decline since December 2025, largely driven by cost declines for fresh fish (-6.11% vs -0.56% in March) and other foods (-0.22% vs 0.61%), while prices continued to increase for non-food products (0.12% vs 0.20%). Among food items excluding fish, costs declined mainly for milk, cheese and eggs (-6.95% vs -5.47%), fruits (-2.04% vs 0.23%), and sugar, jam, honey and confectionery (-1.2% vs -1.75%). Among non-food products, prices particularly decreased for furniture and household equipment (-1.3% vs -0.48%), health (-1.6% vs -0.22%), and recreation and culture (-5.04% vs -4.38%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices fell by 0.09% in April, the third straight month of decline, following a 0.04% loss in the preceding period.

Lithuania Trade Deficit Narrows in March — Lithuania’s trade deficit narrowed to EUR 548.3 million in March 2026 from EUR 737.0 million in the corresponding month of the previous year, as exports rose while imports dropped. Exports increased by 2.7% year-on-year to EUR 3,352.5 million, driven by higher sales of fertilizers (26.7%), optical, photographic, cinematographic, measuring, checking, precision, medical or surgical instruments and apparatus; parts and accessories (29.2%), electrical machinery and equipment and related parts (9.1%). Exports of goods of Lithuanian origin decreased by 0.9%. Meanwhile, imports fell by 2.5% to EUR 3,900.8 million due to a decline in imports of mineral fuels, mineral oils and products of their distillation (27%), articles of iron or steel (25.7%). For the first quarter of 2026, the country posted a trade deficit of EUR 1,338.6 million, narrowing from EUR 1,618.7 million in the same period a year ago.

Swedish Household Spending Hits 4-Month High — Household spending in Sweden increased 1.4% month-on-month in March 2026, picking up from an upwardly revised 0.2% rise in the previous month. This marked the highest reading since November 2025, mainly driven by stronger consumption of clothing and footwear (3.4% vs 0.4% in February), transport, retail trade, and motor vehicle services (2.3% vs 0.7%), post and telecommunications (3.2% vs 1.1%), and recreation and culture (3.7% vs 1.4%). At the same time, spending rebounded in food and beverages (3.1% vs -0.4%), restaurants, cafes, hotels, and other accommodation services (1.6% vs -1.4%), and other goods and services (4.5% vs -4.0%). Meanwhile, consumption slowed for furniture, furnishings, household equipment, and consumables (0.6% vs 0.8%), while it declined for housing, electricity, gas, and heating (-1.7% vs 0.5%). On a yearly basis, household consumption climbed 4.1%, accelerating from an upwardly revised 1.9% increase in the previous month.

German Trade Surplus Smallest in 4 Months — Germany’s trade surplus narrowed to €14.4 billion in March 2026 from a downwardly revised €19.6 billion in February, falling short of market expectations of €18.4 billion. It was the smallest trade surplus since last November, as exports rose less than imports. Exports unexpectedly increased by 0.5% mom to a near 3½-year high of €135.8 billion, slowing sharply from a 3.6% rise in February and beating expectations of a 1.7% decline. Shipments to EU member states grew 3.4%, with exports to the Eurozone rising 4.1% and those to non-Eurozone countries climbing 1.7%. By contrast, exports to third countries fell 3.3%. Meanwhile, imports surged 5.1% mom to €121.5 billion, the highest level since November 2022, accelerating from an upwardly revised 4.9% increase in February and far exceeding expectations of a 0.8% rise. The increase was driven by purchases from both EU partners (3.0%) and non-EU countries (7.4%), particularly imports from China and the UK.

German Industrial Output Unexpectedly Falls — Germany’s industrial output shrank 0.7% month-on-month in March 2026, following a downwardly revised 0.5% decline in the previous month and missing market expectations for a 0.5% increase. The drop was mainly driven by weaker energy production (-4.0%) and a decline in mechanical engineering output (-2.7%). In contrast, activity improved in construction (1.9%) and the automotive industry (1.9%). Excluding energy and construction, industrial production declined 0.9%, reflecting lower output of capital goods (-1.6%) and consumer goods (-1.9%), while intermediate goods production rose 0.8%. On a less volatile three-month basis, industrial activity contracted 1.2% in the January–March period compared with the previous three months. On an annual basis, industrial production dropped 2.8%, sharply worsening from a 0.2% decline in February.

Sweden Industrial Output Growth Slows in March — Industrial production in Sweden rose 3% year-on-year in March 2026, easing from a downwardly revised 6.2% in the previous month. Manufacturing output slowed to 3.5% from 6.4% in the prior month, weighed down by weaker gains in textiles, clothing and leather industries (3% vs 6.3% in February), and transport equipment (0.1% vs 19.5%), as well as declines in electrical equipment (-5.3% vs 0.6%), machinery and equipment (-1.4% vs 5.2%), and motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers (-1.9% vs 18.9%). Meanwhile, mining and quarrying output fell 6.8%, reversing a 6.1% rise in the previous month. On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial production dropped 2%, down from a downwardly revised 3.8% growth in the prior period.

【韓國稱第四艘韓國油輪成功穿越紅海】韓國海洋水產部週五表示，一艘韓國油輪已成功穿越紅海，目前正在返韓途中，這是韓國第四次透過紅海運送石油。韓國海洋水產部稱，該船在沙特延布港裝載石油後，於上午11點左右穿越紅海。出於安全考慮，該船的航行細節未予公佈。自韓國開始利用這條連線印度洋和地中海、途經蘇伊士運河的水道繞開霍爾木茲海峽以來，這艘油輪是第四艘透過該水道的韓國油輪。

South Africa Forex Reserves at 4-Month Low — Gross foreign exchange reserves fell to $77.09 billion in April 2026, from $77.76 billion in the previous month, marking the lowest level since December 2025. The changes in gross reserves and the international liquidity position were mainly due to a foreign exchange loan received from the French Development Agency (AFD) on behalf of the government, amounting to US$235.8 million, as well as an increase in the US dollar gold price and valuation adjustments due to foreign exchange and asset price movements. Foreign exchange reserves specifically declined to $51.7 billion from $52.7 billion in March. In contrast, gold reserves increased slightly to $18.7 billion from $18.5 billion, while Special Drawing Rights (SDR) holdings edged up to $6.7 billion from $6.6 billion. Meanwhile, the central bank’s forward position, reflecting unsettled or swap transactions, remained unchanged at $0.59 billion. In April 2025, the reserves stood at $67.59 billion.

Finland Trade Balance Swings to Surplus — Finland posted a trade surplus of EUR 0.25 billion in March 2026, shifting from a deficit of EUR 0.16 billion in the corresponding month of the previous year, preliminary estimates showed. Exports climbed by 13.7% year-on-year to an eight-month high of EUR 7.36 billion, driven by sharp increases of shipments to both EU (+11.8%) and non-EU countries (+16.3%). Sales to Sweden (+15%), the US (+40.9%), Poland (+50.7%), and Estonia (+22.3%) saw the largest increases. Meanwhile, imports rose at a softer 7.2%, but to a six-year high of EUR 7.11 billion. It should be noted that imports from EU countries are now compiled using a new methodology starting January 2026, so only total values are comparable with those of 2025. Finnish Customs will not publish other annual change data for imports in 2026. Coal Falls as Fuel Switching Demand Remains Limited — Coal prices slipped toward $130 per ton and were on track to finish the week lower, as fuel switching by major Asian economies in response to the Middle East-driven energy supply shock proved less aggressive than initially expected. Thermal coal has served as an alternative to liquefied natural gas for power generation, particularly after the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz disrupted roughly 20% of global LNG supply. However, recent data showed that both Japan and South Korea imported less thermal coal in April compared with March, with volumes also remaining well below the five-year average, indicating that demand has stayed relatively subdued by historical standards. Analysts also noted that the sharpest decline in LNG imports across Asia has come from China, which has reduced overseas purchases and shifted instead toward domestic coal production as well as pipeline and locally sourced natural gas, helping ease pressure on global LNG supply available to other Asian buyers.

Rupiah Under Strain After Forex Reserve Data — The rupiah weakened toward IDR 17,390 per dollar on Friday, extending prior losses, as the U.S. dollar firmed amid renewed hostilities between Washington and Tehran around the Strait of Hormuz. Pressure also mounted after April data showed Indonesia’s forex reserves fell for a fourth straight month to their lowest in nearly two years, underscoring fragile external buffers. Meanwhile, risks from Middle East tensions to energy costs and supply chains remain even as April inflation stayed manageable. Bank Indonesia’s interventions and tighter safeguards, including stricter oversight of corporates with heavy forex needs and lower caps on dollar purchases without documentation, helped steady the currency through the week. Even so, the rupiah has shed almost 4% year-to-date, ranking among Asia’s weakest. Strains had already been building before the Gulf conflict escalated in late February, as investors flagged fiscal vulnerabilities and transparency concerns in local capital markets.

【南京、東營晉級：人均GDP超20萬元的城市增至11個】江蘇南京、山東東營新近公佈的統計公報顯示，2025年兩市人均GDP分別達到20.2萬元和20.4萬元。由此，中國大陸人均GDP超過20萬元的地級及以上城市增加到11個。GDP反映經濟總量，人均GDP體現的是產出水平。去年，我國人均GDP超過20萬元的城市有鄂爾多斯、克拉瑪依、北京、上海、無錫、榆林、深圳、蘇州、常州、東營和南京，共11個；GDP居前11位的則是上海、北京、深圳、重慶、廣州、蘇州、成都、杭州、武漢、南京和寧波。兩個組別的成員分散，總量、人均雙雙拔尖的只有上海、北京、深圳、蘇州、南京五地。（21財經）

【湖南省委書記沈曉明：全力配合國務院事故調查組開展工作】5月8日，湖南省委書記沈曉明主持召開排程會，深入學習貫徹習近平總書記重要指示精神，聽取瀏陽華盛煙花廠爆炸事故有關進展情況彙報，對後續處置工作進行再部署再落實。會議指出，此次事故造成重大人員傷亡，代價極為慘重，教訓極其深刻。全省上下要全力配合國務院事故調查組開展工作，查深查透全省安全生產方面的深層次問題，為從根本上扭轉安全生產的被動局面打下堅實基礎，以實際行動深刻領悟“兩個確立”的決定性意義、堅決做到“兩個維護”。會議強調，要繼續做好搜救和醫療救治工作，加強事故現場管控，嚴防次生災害發生。要深入細緻做好善後安撫，讓遇難人員家屬和受傷群眾感受到黨中央和習近平總書記的親切關懷，感受到社會的關愛和組織的溫暖。要統籌抓好面上安全穩定工作，採取有力舉措，堅決守住不發生影響社會穩定的風險底線。（湖南日報）

【印尼自由港推遲格拉斯伯格銅礦全面復產時間一年】印尼自由港公司將旗下巨型格拉斯伯格銅礦的全面復產時間推遲一年，此舉進一步加劇了本已影響全球銅市場的供應緊張局面。印尼自由港總裁董事託尼・韋納斯在週四釋出的宣告中表示，這座位於巴布亞省中部的礦區，目前目標定於2028 年初恢復滿負荷生產。格拉斯伯格銅礦曾是全球第二大銅礦產地，去年礦區遭遇嚴重泥石流災害後，生產運營陷入停滯。就在上個月，韋納斯還曾表示，待未受災害影響的礦區區域重啟後，整座礦山可在2027 年初實現全面達產。

Dutch Manufacturing Output Rebounds in March — Manufacturing production in the Netherlands rose 2.8% month-on-month in March 2026, rebounding from a 1.3% drop in February. This marked the strongest growth since December 2023. Overall industrial production also increased by 2.8% from a month earlier. Compared with the same period last year, output grew 1.7%, with half of all industrial business categories recording higher production. Among the eight major sectors, the machinery industry posted the strongest growth, while the electrical and electronics sector recorded the steepest decline.

【德財長說美髮動的“不負責任戰爭”衝擊德經濟】德國財政部長拉爾斯·克林拜爾7日說，美國政府對伊朗發動的“不負責任的戰爭”導致能源價格飆升，令德國經濟和公共財政遭受重大打擊。 克林拜爾當天接受多家媒體採訪時說，中東戰事導致德國稅收收入預期下調，進而拖累經濟增長。他援引一項資料說，由於當前中東緊張局勢加劇能源價格上漲，今後經濟放緩的可能性上升，導致德國未來五年稅收預期下調約875億歐元。 克林拜爾說，資料體現了德國目前面臨的“嚴重不確定性”，凸顯持續加強危機管理的重要性。他表示，德國需聚焦投資與改革以增強經濟韌性，減輕外部風險可能帶來的衝擊。 (新華社)

Indian Rupee Weakens on Oil Prices Jump — The Indian rupee weakened to around 94.5 per dollar, reversing part of a two-day recovery, as renewed US-Iran hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz drove oil prices higher. The escalation, marked by exchanges of fire and accusations of ceasefire violations, reignited concerns over potential disruptions to a key global shipping route, prompting a sharp rebound in Brent crude to around $101.50 per barrel. Higher oil prices pressured the rupee through India’s elevated energy import exposure, with recent gains unwound as volatile crude prices drove position adjustments across the FX market. Persistent structural dollar demand also continued to weigh on the currency, while central bank measures aimed at stabilising the rupee offered only limited support. Market participants said a sustained recovery would depend on stability in oil prices and moderation in related dollar outflows.

【美法院裁決特朗普政府全球進口關稅缺乏法律依據】美國國際貿易法院7日公佈裁決，認定特朗普政府徵收10%全球進口關稅的法律依據不成立，白宮此前釋出的公告無效。美國24個州政府和兩家美國企業先後在3月5日和9日就特朗普政府加徵的全球進口關稅提起訴訟，美國國際貿易法院對這兩起相關案件進行合併審理，並於4月10日進行口頭辯論。美國國際貿易法院法官7日以多數透過的裁決結果永久禁止美國聯邦政府依據《1974年貿易法》第122條對兩家美國進口企業和華盛頓州政府加徵10%的進口關稅。由於原告中美國其他20多個州政府沒有提交有力證據證明全球進口關稅對其帶來傷害，法院認定這些州沒有訴訟資格，相關訴訟請求不予考慮。目前，尚不清楚聯邦政府是否會就這一裁決提起上訴。（新華社）

【花旗全力拓展外匯業務 瞄準對沖基金和私募股權客戶】隨著全球交易量的增長，花旗集團擴大面向對沖基金和私募股權客戶的外匯業務。花旗外匯交易全球主管Flavio Figueiredo在新加坡接受媒體採訪時稱，鑑於該行在企業和實錢資金流領域的既有地位，這兩個細分市場被視為關鍵機遇。他表示，該行的戰略是鞏固已具備強大影響力的領域，並“進軍滲透率較低的細分市場”。這項舉措瞄準對沖基金和為收購、增長及重組提供融資的私募股權和風險投資公司等。Figueiredo透露，為了支援這項舉措，該行計劃今年將全球外匯銷售和交易團隊擴大4%-5%。除招聘人才外，花旗還在加大對其電子分銷平臺的投入，該平臺可讓銀行和做市商等流動性提供商向客戶報送價格，並以電子方式執行交易。

【以軍提升警戒狀態應對黎巴嫩真主黨報復性攻擊】記者當地時間5月8日獲悉，有訊息人士透露，以色列國防軍在黎巴嫩境內以及黎以臨時邊界的部隊已進入最高階別警戒狀態。訊息人士表示，此舉是針對黎巴嫩真主黨在其精銳部隊拉德萬部隊指揮官被打死後的報復性攻擊做準備。當地時間7日，以色列國防軍發表宣告，宣佈在6日針對黎巴嫩首都貝魯特的空襲中打死黎巴嫩真主黨“拉德萬部隊”指揮官艾哈邁德·加利卜·巴盧特。宣告還稱，黎真主黨負責防空事務的指揮官侯賽因·魯馬尼及情報部門官員穆罕默德·巴齊也在此次襲擊中身亡。（央視）
【新紫光前沿技術研究院釋出“紫弦”三維近存架構】2026新紫光集團創新峰會上，新紫光前沿技術研究院釋出“紫弦”三維化近存計算架構，以3D DRAM為核心，首創3.5D異質異構整合方案，儲存頻寬可達30TB/s，基於國內領先供應鏈可規模化量產。PNM近存計算模式下訪存延遲最大降低18倍，模擬模擬顯示同等算力下token吞吐率較英偉達B200系列高出1.5至2倍以上。

【華西證券：餐飲行業需求回暖 供應鏈龍頭競爭力提升】華西證券釋出研報稱，餐飲行業作為重點受益領域，受益於從中央定調到地方落地的全方位政策紅利。餐飲需求穩步回升，統計局資料顯示2025年全國餐飲收入達5.8萬億元，同比增長3.2%，春節期間年夜飯預訂與商圈客流的爆發式增長進一步驗證了終端韌性。餐飲供應鏈作為餐飲行業高質量發展的底層支撐，持續享受政策紅利與行業擴容雙重利好，具備高確定性的中長期成長空間。與此同時，行業競爭態勢發生積極變化，價格戰轉向價值競爭，龍頭企業透過控費增效實現了盈利能力的顯著修復，盈利水平已呈現築底回升態勢。

【2025年我國腳踏車全行業總產量超1.1億輛】2025年，我國腳踏車全行業總產量為1.11億輛，同比增長11.3%，全年生產實現平穩增長。 這是記者8日從2026中國國際腳踏車展覽會上瞭解到的訊息。本屆展覽會在上海舉辦，緊扣全球腳踏車產業綠色、智慧、高階發展趨勢，集中展現我國腳踏車新產品和產業發展新趨勢。 中國腳踏車協會副理事長兼秘書長郭文玉介紹，2025年，我國腳踏車全行業規模以上企業實現營業收入同比增長9%，利潤實現大幅提升。 出口方面，2025年，我國腳踏車出口4893.9萬輛，同比增長2.4%，行業出口保持平穩增長；腳踏車零部件出口額36.32億美元，同比增長10.6%，零部件出口表現突出。 “腳踏車場景消費拓展新邊界，多元場景啟用細分需求。”郭文玉說，2025年，我國舉辦腳踏車賽事101場，較2024年增長23%，參與競賽人數突破百萬人；我國業餘騎行俱樂部數量突破8萬家，騎行裝備市場快速擴容。全國共享單車日均騎行量達1.2億次，作為城市交通的補充，更好滿足城市通勤、短途出行等需求。摺疊腳踏車、親子騎行車等品類精準對接家庭出行與休閒健身需求，滿足了消費者日益多元化的生活方式。 2025年，電動腳踏車以舊換新政策與新國標落地實施。(新華社)

Sensex Falls as US-Iran Tensions Reignite — India’s BSE Sensex fell about 0.6% to open at 77,407 on Friday, following losses from the last session as rising oil prices driven by renewed US-Iran tensions in the Middle East weighed on sentiment and clouded hopes on progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Investors remained cautious after reports that Iran accused the US of violating a month-long ceasefire following retaliatory strikes near the Strait of Hormuz, although President Donald Trump insisted the truce remained in effect as Washington awaited Tehran’s response to a new peace proposal. Heavyweight financial stocks led the decline, with key laggards including Axis Bank (-1.4%), HDFC Bank (-1.4%), Bajaj Finance (-1.0%), Shriram Finance (-0.9%), and ICICI Bank (-0.5%). Other notable losers included Shakti Pumps (-7.2%), Britannia Industries (-4.7%), and Tejas Networks (-2.1%), while top performers were Nuvama (+8.8%) and Shipping Corporation of India (+6.2%). On a weekly basis, the benchmark index is up 0.7% so far.

【日本參議院全體會議審議設立“國家情報局”相關法案】5月8日，日本高市早苗內閣推動的設立“國家情報局”的相關法案在日本參議院全體會議進入審議階段。日本首相高市早苗出席會議。此前，4月23日，相關法案在日本眾議院全體會議上經表決透過。根據該法案，日本擬構建以“國家情報會議”為核心、“國家情報局”為執行機構的情報體系，負責統籌安全保障、反恐等領域的情報活動以及涉外國間諜的“對外情報活動”。“國家情報局”還被賦予要求政府各省廳向其提供情報的綜合協調權。

【伊朗公佈向美驅逐艦發射導彈影片】伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊今天（5月8日）釋出影片，據稱為伊朗向試圖透過霍爾木茲海峽的美軍驅逐艦發射導彈。當地時間5月7日晚至今天凌晨，伊朗南部波斯灣沿岸多地傳出爆炸聲。伊朗武裝部隊哈塔姆·安比亞中央司令部發言人表示，由於美國違反停火協議，襲擊伊朗油輪和另一艘進入霍爾木茲海峽的船隻，伊朗武裝力量打擊了霍爾木茲海峽以東的美國軍艦。美軍中央司令部證實美驅逐艦遭襲，並稱進行了回擊，但美方無意尋求局勢升級。 （CCTV國際時訊）

【2026年北京香山論壇先導會在京開幕】2026年北京香山論壇先導會8日在北京開幕。 本次先導會由中國軍事科學學會和中國國際戰略學會共同主辦，以“全球安全治理：挑戰與出路”為主題，邀請了40餘個國家和國際組織的120餘名官方代表、專家學者參會。 會議期間，與會代表將圍繞“國際秩序與國際法治”“亞太安全新挑戰”“維護國際共同安全的責任”及“新興技術軍事應用的風險管控”等重要議題展開研討。今年正值北京香山論壇創立20週年，本次先導會還將舉辦“國際論壇在全球安全治理中的作用——北京香山論壇20週年紀念特別專題交流”活動，邀請全球知名防務與安全智庫代表，共同回顧北京香山論壇二十載歷程，探討國際安全論壇在平等對話、凝聚共識、化解分歧等方面的獨特價值。(新華社)

【安理會審議蘇丹和南蘇丹局勢 中方呼籲相關方推動阿卜耶伊和平穩定】5月7日，安理會審議蘇丹和南蘇丹局勢，關注阿卜耶伊的安全情況。會上透露，蘇丹和南蘇丹將在聯合國安排下舉行多年來首次正式會談。聯合國政治和建設和平事務部助理秘書長波比通報稱，受蘇丹衝突和南蘇丹局勢不穩的影響，阿卜耶伊的安全域性勢在過去六個月內持續惡化，去年12月的無人機襲擊造成6名維和人員死亡。波比同時透露，南蘇丹不久前致函聯合國，要求安排與蘇丹的聯合會議。聯合國秘書長非洲之角問題特使叢光在通報中強調，阿卜耶伊的最終地位仍然是蘇丹與南蘇丹之間最重要的未解決問題之一；他呼籲各方允許為聯阿安全部隊增派聯合國警察分隊。

【英偉達CEO黃仁勳：若受邀，將隨特朗普一同訪問中國】據路透社7日報道，美國政府正邀請英偉達、蘋果、埃克森美孚、波音等大型企業執行長隨同特朗普訪問中國。英偉達公司執行長黃仁勳7日晚間接受採訪時表示：“如果受邀，那將是我的榮幸——能夠代表美國與特朗普總統一同訪問中國，將是莫大的榮耀。”當被問及具體安排時，他補充道：“我們應該讓總統宣佈他決定宣佈的任何訊息。”據報道，高通、黑石集團、花旗集團和Visa等高管也在受邀之列。一位知情人士證實，花旗執行長簡·弗雷澤（Jane Fraser）已受邀出席。如果行程按計劃進行，高通執行長克里斯蒂亞諾·阿蒙（Cristiano Amon）也將出席。一位訊息人士透露，多名企業執行長已在6日晚間接到邀請。彭博社稱，黃仁勳的發言表明“這位美國市值最高公司的領導人尚未收到訪華邀請”。波音執行長凱利·奧特伯格（Kelly Ortberg）今年4月受訪時表示，公司正寄望特朗普政府協助推動一筆期待已久的大額中國訂單落地。（澎湃）

Copper Set for Weekly Rise — Copper futures held above $6.1 per pound on Friday and were on track to post a weekly gain of more than 3%, supported by easing energy prices earlier in the week, which helped reduce pressure on global growth and industrial metals demand. However, sentiment remained fragile as the US and Iran exchanged fire in the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration is currently awaiting Iran’s response to a proposal aimed at reopening Hormuz and ending the nearly 10-week conflict, with reports suggesting Tehran is expected to reply via Pakistan within the next two days. The ongoing conflict has also disrupted shipments of sulphuric acid, a key input in copper refining, adding to supply-side risks. At the same time, continued large-scale agreements among major technology firms have accelerated data center construction, strengthening the longer-term demand outlook for copper given its critical role in electrification and power grid infrastructure.

Malaysia Industrial Output Growth Steady in March — Industrial production in Malaysia grew by 3.1% year-on-year in March 2026, matching market expectations and the pace seen in the previous month. Still, the latest figure remained the weakest growth in industrial activity since last June, driven mainly by a deeper contraction in mining output (-6.5% vs -2.0%), as crude oil and condensate production declined more sharply (-11.3% vs -4.3%) and natural gas output continued to fall (-3.4% vs -0.4%). On the other hand, activity in the manufacturing sector increased 5.5% from 4.2% in the previous month, mainly boosted by robust output of electrical and electronic products (12.5% vs 12.9%) and food, beverages, and tobacco (9.1% vs 5.7%). Additionally, the generation of electricity also went up (4.9% vs 4.6%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial activity fell by 1.8% in March, easing from a 2.9% drop in the preceding period.

【U.S. and South Africa Begin Talks on Mining and Energy Investment Deal】The United States and South Africa have begun early-stage discussions on potential bilateral investment deals spanning mining, energy and infrastructure, in a move that could ease strained relations between the two countries. Around 25 officials and industry representatives met in Johannesburg, marking the highest-level engagement this year focused on minerals cooperation. Talks centered on identifying priority projects, including rare earths assets such as the Phalaborwa mine, and building supply chains less reliant on China, while South Africa’s key mineral resources and processing capacity were highlighted as strategic areas of cooperation.

【Anthropic正考慮進行融資 估值接近1萬億美元】據英國《金融時報》週五報道，Anthropic正考慮在今年夏天籌集數百億美元，用於大規模擴充計算能力。此舉可能使其估值升至近1萬億美元，從而超越競爭對手OpenAI。 Anthropic新一輪融資預計投前估值約為9000億美元，融資規模最高可達500億美元。Anthropic近期一直在處理來自Dragoneer投資集團、General Catalyst和光速創投（Lightspeed Venture Partners）等投資方的投資意向。

【百聯股份成立奧特萊斯商業管理公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，上海百聯奧特萊斯商業管理有限公司成立，法定代表人為曹海倫，註冊資本為2000萬元，經營範圍包含：商業綜合體管理服務；工程管理服務；停車場服務；諮詢策劃服務；企業管理諮詢；市場營銷策劃等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由百聯股份全資持股。

【古巴政府：美國新一輪制裁措施是“經濟侵略”】古巴外交部7日釋出公告說，美國對古巴新一輪制裁措施是“經濟侵略”行為，企圖製造所謂“人道主義危機”，以此為藉口採取更危險的行動，包括對古巴發動軍事侵略。 公告表示，美方7日公佈的新一輪制裁措施旨在進一步擴大美國封鎖政策的域外效力，並可能對外國企業、銀行及其他實體實施“次級制裁”，進一步阻礙古巴經濟執行。 公告說，美國一向以“世界憲兵”自居，公然違反國際法和自由貿易原則，企圖透過脅迫和恐嚇迫使國際社會服從並執行對古封鎖。美國正試圖將古巴進一步孤立於國際經濟和金融體系之外。古巴將繼續在所有國際場合譴責美國封鎖政策，呼籲國際社會共同抵制這一打壓行動。 美國財政部和國務院7日在官網上公佈針對古巴的新一輪制裁措施。美國財政部外國資產控制辦公室釋出公告，把來自古巴的多名個人和實體列入“特別指定國民清單”。美國務院也釋出公告，將古巴企業管理集團公司、莫阿鎳廠以及相關企業高管列入制裁名單。(新華社)

【香港傳染病學專家曾祈殷：香港漢坦病毒風險不是特別高，但不能掉以輕心】據香港電臺網站5月8日訊息，世界衛生組織表示，荷蘭郵輪洪迪厄斯號至今報告8宗涉及漢坦病毒的個案，當中3人死亡，涉及的是漢坦病毒家族成員、可以人傳人的安第斯病毒。香港衛生防護中心表示，郵輪上沒有香港居民。感染及傳染病科專科醫生曾祈殷表示，漢坦病毒的天然宿主包括老鼠或田鼠等囓齒動物。涉事郵輪途經的地方，包括南美的島嶼，都是鼠患較嚴重的地方，估計染病人士可能在上船前已經受感染。而安第斯病毒暫時所知屬於有限度人傳人，要透過密切接觸，例如夫婦或者密閉空間等。他認為香港現在的風險不是特別高，但不能掉以輕心，最重要是加緊做好滅鼠及防鼠工作。

Palm Oil Set for Back-to-Back Weekly Losses — Malaysian palm oil futures traded below MYR 4,550 per tonne, extending recent losses as weakness in Dalian edible oils weighed on sentiment. The market is heading for a second straight weekly decline, down about 0.8% so far, reflecting demand concerns. April imports by top consumer India plunged 27% month-over-month to a one-year low, adding to bearish sentiment. Meanwhile, cargo surveyors estimated Malaysia’s exports during April 1–25 fell 15.7%–16.8% from March, linked to softer post-festive buying. Still, losses were partly cushioned by a weaker ringgit and firmer Chicago soyoil. Crude oil prices also climbed on renewed U.S.–Iran tensions, boosting expectations for stronger biofuel demand. Domestically, Malaysia will implement its B15 biodiesel mandate from June 1, raising the blend from the current B10 to curb fuel imports and support palm oil consumption. Market participants now await monthly data from the Malaysian Palm Oil Board due Monday for clearer supply-demand signals.

【訊息人士稱預計伊官員今日正式回應美對14點提議的評估反饋】記者當地時間5月8日獲悉，據巴基斯坦方面訊息，伊朗正在審查美國對14點提議的回應。14點提議旨在正式結束敵對行動，並開啟為期30天的談判視窗，就伊朗核計劃、解除制裁以及霍爾木茲海峽安全通行等問題進行詳細討論。巴基斯坦外交訊息人士稱，預計伊朗官員將於5月8日正式作出回應，美國方面正在等待伊朗在關鍵問題上的立場。（央視）

【Anthropic Eyes Up to $50bn Fundraise at Nearly $1 Trillion Valuation as AI Compute Race Accelerates: FT】Anthropic is considering raising tens of billions of dollars this summer to expand computing capacity, in a deal that could value the AI company at about $900bn pre-money and potentially nearly $1tn, the Financial Times reported, citing people familiar with the matter. Investors including Dragoneer, General Catalyst and Lightspeed Venture Partners are reportedly in discussions, with some expecting the round to raise up to $50bn and close within two months. The company’s annualised revenue is said to be approaching $45bn, up from $9bn at end-2025. The funding push comes as Anthropic, maker of Claude, faces compute constraints and prepares broader deployment of its new model Mythos, while securing infrastructure deals with firms including Amazon Web Services , Google , Broadcom and SpaceX . OpenAI was valued at $852bn post-money in March after a $122bn funding round.

【工信部批覆6G技術試驗頻率，專家：將加速6中國證券報·中證金牛座記者，此次6GHz頻段6G試驗頻率許可的落地，標誌著我國6G研發正式從實驗室測試階段步入外場試驗新階段，擺脫了純理論與室內測試帶來的侷限，可在實際組網環境中開展裝置適配、訊號覆蓋、干擾相容及業務承載全維度測試。同時面向國際電信聯盟（ITU）6G典型場景與關鍵效能指標開展技術攻關和測試驗證，牽引產業鏈晶片、基站、終端等環節協同研發迭代，加速完善關鍵技術與產業配套體系，為後續6G標準定型、規模組網奠定堅實基礎，加速6G產業化程序與商用落地節奏，助力我國在全球6G頻譜佈局、標準制定和產業生態競爭中獲得主導地位。（中證報）

【港股午評：恒指跌1.09%，儲存半導體、光通訊概念股集體熄火，內房股活躍 】受外圍市場調整影響，港股上午盤三大指數集體走低，恒生指數跌1.09%，國企指數跌0.63%，恒生科技指數跌1.07%。昨日強勢的權重科技股多數下跌令大市承壓，阿里巴巴、騰訊跌1.5%，京東跌1.4%，百度逆勢上漲超3%；近期熱門的儲存半導體、光通訊概念股集體熄火，其中華虹半導體大跌近10%，豬肉概念股、生物醫藥股、中資券商股、鋰電池股齊跌。另外，深圳廣州等多地釋出樓市新政，五一假期多地樓市回暖，內房股持續活躍。

【索尼宣佈30億美元股票回購計劃】索尼集團週五公佈了基本符合市場預期的盈利展望，並宣佈將最高回購5000億日元（約合32億美元）公司股票。這家總部位於東京的企業預計，2027年3月財年營業利潤將達1.6萬億日元，同比增幅約11%。剛結束的上一財年，索尼盈利水平有所提升，音樂業務與智慧手機影象感測器業務成為業績增長的最大主力。訊息公佈後，索尼股價一度大漲7.3%，創下兩個多月來最大單日盤中漲幅。索尼表示，計劃於5月29日登出3%的流通股份。受元器件成本飆升拖累，索尼東京上市股票年內跌幅已超20%，此次回購有望緩解股價下行壓力。公司同時稱，本年度PS5遊戲機銷售目標，將取決於能否以合理價格為這款旗艦主機採購到充足的儲存晶片。
【建設兩岸融合發展示範區部省際工作會議在京舉行】中共中央臺辦、國家發展改革委、福建省會同48箇中央和國家機關有關部門，8日在北京召開建設兩岸融合發展示範區部省際工作會議。會議總結了《中共中央 國務院關於支援福建探索海峽兩岸融合發展新路建設兩岸融合發展示範區的意見》貫徹落實情況，研究下步重點工作，支援福建在探索海峽兩岸融合發展新路上邁出更大步伐，高質量建設兩岸融合發展示範區。（央視新聞）

【印尼一火山噴發已致2人死亡 】據印尼警方訊息，印尼北馬魯古省杜科諾火山噴發已致2人死亡，另外還有一人失蹤。 據印尼火山監測機構訊息，今天（5月8日），杜科諾火山發生噴發，火山灰柱高度達到約一萬米。相關機構建議公眾不要在火山口半徑4公里範圍內活動。救援部門稱有5名登山者受傷。
【30條中日航線4月取消全部航班】航班管家DAST最新統計顯示，4月共有30條中日航線取消全部航班，比3月取消數量有所減少。不過，4月實際執行的赴日航班較3月整體減少182班。整個4月中國大陸赴日本共有1543個航班取消，取消率為37.7%。（第一財經）

Indonesia Forex Reserves Hit Near 2-Year Low — Indonesia’s foreign exchange reserves fell to USD 146.2 billion in April 2026, from USD 148.2 billion in March, marking its lowest level since July 2024. Bank Indonesia attributed the decline to tax- and service-related outflows, government external debt repayments, and the issuance of global bonds. The central bank also noted its ongoing intervention in the foreign exchange market to stabilize the rupiah amid heightened global financial market uncertainty. Despite the decline, reserves remain sufficient to cover 5.8 months of imports, or 5.6 months including import needs and external debt servicing, well above the international adequacy benchmark of around three months. Looking ahead, Bank Indonesia expects external sector resilience to remain intact, supported by ample reserves and continued foreign capital inflows. The central bank also cited sustained investor confidence in Indonesia’s economic outlook and relatively attractive investment returns as key supporting factors.

Soybean Retreats from 7-Week High — Soybean futures fell below $11.8 per bushel, easing from a seven-week high hit on May 4 as improved South American supply conditions offset stronger biofuel demand due to higher global energy prices. Brazil, the world’s largest producer and exporter of soybeans, shipped a record 16.75 million metric tons in April, up 9.7% from a year earlier and surpassing the previous high of 16.1 million tons set in April 2021. The country’s 2025/26 soybean crop is also projected to reach a record near 180 million tons, keeping prices under pressure. Elsewhere, US planting has progressed well, with seeding at 33% complete, 10 points ahead of average as drier US weather forecasts helped ease concerns that recent Midwest storms could slow or delay seeding in some areas. Meanwhile, renewed clashes between the US and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz heightened concerns over prolonged energy supply disruptions, pushing global oil prices higher and reinforcing demand for biofuel feedstocks such as soybeans.
【榮耀申請註冊“榮耀 Robot”商標】企查查APP顯示，近日，榮耀終端股份有限公司申請註冊“榮耀 Robot”商標，國際分類為9類科學儀器，已申請商品/服務包括：實驗室機器人；教學機器人；科學研究用具有人工智慧的人形機器人等。

【受電動汽車業務虧損和遊戲業務疲軟拖累，索尼季度利潤下滑】索尼集團(Sony Group)公佈，由於其與本田汽車的電動汽車合資企業出現虧損，加上游戲等業務疲軟，第四財季淨利潤大幅下滑。這家日本娛樂和電子公司週五表示，在截至3月份的第四財季，其淨利潤同比下降63%，至831.2億日元（合5.296億美元）。該業績低於分析師預估的2,022.4億日元。索尼集團表示，其與本田汽車的合資企業錄得449億日元的權益法投資損失，該合資企業已停止銷售其電動汽車車型。其遊戲、電影和影象感測器業務的營業利潤均出現下滑。其娛樂技術業務的營業虧損則有所收窄。第四財季收入增長8.3%，至3.036萬億日元。對於4月份開始的財政年度，該公司預計收入將下降1.4%，至12.300萬億日元，淨利潤將增長12.5%，至1.160萬億日元。

Indonesia Home Price Growth Hits Record Low — Residential property prices in Indonesia climbed by 0.62% year-on-year in Q1 2026, easing from a 0.83% increase in Q4 and marking the softest growth since the data series began in 2003. The latest figures reflect declining purchasing power and rising layoffs, which contributed to the overall moderation in property prices. Price growth slowed across all housing segments: medium-sized houses (0.88% vs 1.12% in Q4), large houses (0.50% vs 0.72%), and small houses (0.61% vs 0.76% in Q4). Among the 18 cities included in the survey, 10 reported softer price growth, with the sharpest slowdown seen in Banjarmasin (0.52% vs 1.63%), while prices in Surabaya declined by 0.27% after edging down 0.04% in Q4.

【中證協啟動2026年券商做好金融“五篇大文章”試評價，普惠與養老指標進一步細化】記者5月8日從業內獲悉，中國證券業協會日前正式啟動2026年證券公司做好金融“五篇大文章”試評價工作。前期，中證協研究修訂了《證券公司做好金融“五篇大文章”專項評價辦法（試行）》，並於2026年3月就修訂稿向全行業廣泛徵求了意見。從此次下發的試評價正式指標來看，中證協在保持評價體系總體框架穩定的同時，精準打出了“加法”與“減法”的組合拳——既順應市場新變化擴容了指標維度，又剔除了冗餘重複項，評價導向更加清晰鮮明。對比此前的徵求意見稿，此次試評價的正式指標在數量上由13項增至14項，評價總分保持不變。（中證金牛座）

【機構續押日元還會再跌 干預只能短暫止血】Insight Investment Management Ltd.預計，在近期干預措施的影響消退後日元將重新走弱，因此該公司維持日元空頭部位。管理約800億美元資產的貨幣解決方案主管Francesca Fornasari在墨爾本接受採訪時表示，若沒有基本貨幣或財政政策的配合，外匯干預成功的機率相當低。她表示，日本央行在升息方面慢半拍，日本政府仍在維持其支出計劃，這兩點都對日元不利。Fornasari說，政府顯然希望在日元兌美元匯率160的水準劃出一道防線，但問題在於目前採取的政策不完全支援這一目標。Insight Investment的看法呼應了越來越多市場參與者的觀點，即在一連串疑似干預措施曾將日元兌美元匯率推升至最高155.04後，日元可能再次走弱。

【巴西總統盧拉：我告訴特朗普，歡迎包括中國在內的所有國家投資稀土本地加工】當地時間5月7日，美國總統特朗普在白宮會見到訪的巴西總統盧拉。據路透社、香港《南華早報》8日報道，在三小時會面後，盧拉在華盛頓大使館召開的新聞釋出會上透露，會面中他向特朗普表態稱，巴西將保留礦產本地精煉業務，願意向所有有意在該國境內加工稀土礦產的國家開放投資，不會排擠中國。 “我們沒有偏好，我們希望與所有願意來巴西投資的主體共享機遇，”他說，“美國、中國、德國、日本、法國，任何願意與我們合作，助力我們開採、分離並將這些稀土轉化為財富的主體，我們都歡迎。” 盧拉還說，他告訴特朗普，巴西國會在其訪美前夕透過了一項針對關鍵礦產的新監管框架，並將該領域視為國家主權事務。 盧拉強調，巴西過往數十年來對外出口銀、黃金、鐵礦石等原生礦產，沒有從中獲取工業附加值，他的政府不會重蹈覆轍。 “在稀土問題上，我們要改變做法。這是大自然賦予巴西的財富，我們希望成為最大受益者”，他說。 另據彭博社報道，盧拉還表示，他告訴特朗普，只要相關企業能自行承擔能源生產成本，巴西歡迎資料中心領域的外來投資。他稱，希望美方“重新對巴西產生興趣”。 盧拉對記者表示，2008年後中國超越美國成為巴西最大貿易伙伴，原因是美國企業放棄了在該地區的專案競標。 “我告訴他，我們多次為修建公路、鐵路舉行國際招標，美國從不參與競標，參與的往往都是中方企業，”他說，“長期以來，美國不再關注拉美，他們只從打擊毒品走私的角度看待拉丁美洲。” （觀察者網）

【愷英網路旗下極逸SOON與中手遊達成戰略合作】5月8日，愷英網路旗下杭州極逸人工智慧科技有限公司與港股主機板上市公司中手遊（0302.HK）共同宣佈，雙方達成深度戰略合作，推出面向全球遊戲市場，由AI驅動的市場洞察、遊戲開發到全球發行的一站式智慧體——GamePartner.AI（簡稱GPA），助力並構建中國遊戲開發者出海生態。該平臺由極逸人工智慧提供核心AI遊戲開發技術支援，中手遊負責全球推廣與運營。

【亞洲航空訂購150架空客A220飛機】記者今日從空客方面獲悉，馬來西亞亞洲航空 (簡稱“亞洲航空”) 確認訂購150架最新一代空客A220-300飛機。該筆採購協議是空客A220系列飛機迄今為止最大的單筆確認訂單，使該專案的確認訂單總數突破1000架。公開資料顯示，空客A220是一款專為短途和中短途市場設計的窄體噴氣式客機，定位在100-160座級左右，航程可達6700公里。截至2026年3月底，全球25家運營商已接收了501架空客A220飛機。（介面新聞）

【李家超：2026全球調解峰會 打造香港成為全球調解之都】香港特區行政長官李家超今日（8日）出席國際調解院舉辦的2026全球調解峰會。李家超在致辭時表示，調解體現了和睦共處的精神，而這一價值觀深深植根於中華文化。香港具備成為全球調解之都的條件，並正朝此目標邁進。在“一國兩制”框架下，香港是國際金融、航運及貿易中心，更受惠於國家的強大支援與賦予的機遇，同時作為國際都會，與全球保持緊密聯絡。李家超指出，國家“十五五”規劃明確支援國際調解院更好發揮作用，將鞏固香港日後在透過調解和平解決爭端方面的關鍵作用。特區政府會持續深化與國際調解組織的合作伙伴關係，攜手推動香港發展成為全球調解中心。特區政府誠邀各國政府、企業、投資者等，充分利用國際調解院在香港所提供的調解服務。 (大灣區之聲)

【愛迪特：後續將持續調整價格策略 不排除進一步提價可能】愛迪特(301580)5月7日在業績說明會上表示，在價格調整策略方面，公司採取了產品分層、客戶分層、分步落地的精細化原則，後續將根據市場競爭情況、成本上漲幅度持續調整，不排除進一步提價可能，對於核心原材料市場供需導致成本結構、市場供需和客戶價值等大幅變化，公司可能考慮不設定固定的調價頻率，確保價格機制能夠有效反映市場變化。

【野村上調亞股年底目標位 看好AI相關公司盈利並預計中東風險降低】野村策略師上調MSCI除日本外亞洲指數的年底目標位，理由是對人工智慧推動的盈利增長更有信心，並且中東衝突相關的風險溢價回落。野村策略師在報告中指出，亞洲AI供應鏈的盈利動能強於預期，尤其是韓國和中國臺灣地區大型半導體及科技硬體企業，並且美伊衝突相關風險緩解。雖然更廣泛的區域基本面和上漲潛力仍然喜憂參半，但相對少數與AI相關的公司盈利表現強勁，仍可繼續在指數層面帶來顯著上行空間。野村將MSCI除日本外亞洲指數目標位從1,094點上調至1,316點，意味著較週四收盤水平仍有16%的上漲空間。野村建議繼續超配韓國和MSCI中國指數，對印度持中性看法。在東南亞市場中，野村更看好新加坡和馬來西亞。

【Tencent and Alibaba Earnings Growth Pressured by Rising AI Costs and Competition】Tencent Holdings Ltd. and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. are expected to face pressure on earnings growth due to rising AI investment costs and intensifying competition in China’s artificial intelligence sector following DeepSeek’s latest model launch. 【China’s 3.5 Million b/d Oil Import Drop Emerges as Key Hidden Force Rebalancing Global Crude Market】China has reduced crude oil imports by about 25% from prewar levels to roughly 8.2 million barrels per day, down from around 11.7 million, according to Vortexa estimates cited in the report. The drop, driven largely by reduced stockpiling rather than demand destruction, has added unexpected supply to the global market and helped keep oil benchmarks near $100 per barrel despite the Iran war. State-owned refiners have also been reselling cargoes to overseas buyers, contributing to weaker physical premiums, which have fallen from about $30 per barrel in early April to as low as $1. Commercial inventories in China are still rising, while strategic reserves are estimated at about 1.4 billion barrels. The report says possible drivers include weaker-than-expected demand growth, structural shifts such as EV adoption and coal-to-chemicals substitution, and increased domestic supply, though the exact cause of the import decline remains unclear.

Japan 10Y Yield Rises as Mideast Tensions Flare — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield climbed to around 2.48% on Friday, reversing the prior session’s decline as renewed US-Iran clashes in the Strait of Hormuz lifted geopolitical risk and revived inflation concerns. Three US Navy destroyers transiting the strategic waterway reportedly intercepted Iranian attacks and conducted retaliatory strikes, although President Donald Trump said the ceasefire remains in effect. In Japan, data showed real wages rose for a third consecutive month in March, reinforcing expectations that the Bank of Japan could continue tightening policy even as the Middle East conflict adds uncertainty to the growth outlook. Meanwhile, minutes from the BOJ’s March meeting suggested policymakers see room for additional rate hikes if an Iran-related energy shock persists and sustains broader inflationary pressures.

US 10-Year Yield Holds Advance — The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note hovered around 4.39% on Friday, following an advance of about 3 basis points in the previous session, as renewed US-Iran clashes in the Strait of Hormuz reduced expectations for an imminent peace deal and reignited inflation concerns. Three US Navy destroyers transiting the strategic waterway reportedly intercepted Iranian attacks and carried out defensive strikes, although President Donald Trump said the ceasefire remains in effect. The Trump administration is still awaiting Iran’s response to a proposal aimed at reopening Hormuz and bringing an end to the nearly 10-week conflict, with reports suggesting Tehran is expected to reply via Pakistan within the next two days. Meanwhile, investors are also focused on the upcoming April jobs report, which is forecast to show the US economy added 62K jobs last month, down from 178K in March, while the unemployment rate is expected to hold steady at 4.3%.

【月之暗面Kimi完成新一輪約20億美元融資】據華峰資本5月7日釋出的資訊，近日，月之暗面Kimi完成新一輪約20億美元融資，投後估值突破200億美元。這是月之暗面成立以來規模最大的單筆融資，也是國內大模型創業公司迄今金額最高的私募融資之一。據介紹，本輪融資由美團龍珠領投，水木資本、中國移動、CPE源峰等參投。至此，月之暗面半年內累計融資超39億美元，總融資額超376億元人民幣，成為國內大模型創業公司中累計融資最多的企業。對比2025年11月約43億美元的估值，當前估值超過200億美元，增長約4倍。華峰資本表示，受益於模型能力迭代，月之暗面ARR（年度經常性收入）在4月已超2億美元，付費訂閱與API收入加速增長。
【香港電訊盈科2500萬美元買下世界盃轉播權】近日，FIFA官網顯示，中國香港地區已獲得2026年世界盃轉播權。據悉，香港電訊盈科公司旗下Now TV與免費電視臺Viu TV獲得美加墨世界盃獨家轉播權。Now TV將透過收費平臺全程直播104場比賽，Viu TV將會免費播出揭幕戰、決賽等精選場次。據悉，電訊盈科買下世界盃轉播權花費約2500萬美元（約1.7億元人民幣）。（大河報）

Indonesia Shares Eye First Weekly Rise in Three — Indonesian equities edged down 12 points or 0.1% to 7,167 in early Friday trade, snapping a three-session strength after an overnight retreat on Wall Street amid renewed U.S.–Iran hostilities that rattled a fragile ceasefire. Locally, investor sentiment was clouded by caution ahead of April foreign reserves data due later today, after March figures slipped to near a two-year low amid persistently weak rupiah. Traders also vigilantly braced for several data releases from the central bank next week, including April consumer confidence and retail sales. Losses were led by basic materials, property, and non-cyclicals, with notable drags from Merdeka Copper Gold (-4.1%), Elang Mahkota Teknologi (-3.1%), Pertamina Geothermal (-2.9%), and Hartadinata Abadi (-2.4%). Still, the market is on track for its first weekly gain in three, up about 2.4% so far, boosted by bargain hunting, resilient Q1 economic output, and mild inflation despite higher non-subsidized fuel prices.

【Hamas Considers Suspending Gaza Ceasefire Talks】Hamas is reportedly considering a temporary suspension of Gaza ceasefire negotiations, according to two sources cited in the report. One Hamas source said the group’s leadership is reviewing the move because it believes Israel is not seriously engaging in steps that would halt daily violence and killings in Gaza.

Platinum Remains Above $2000 — Platinum futures traded above $2,000 an ounce, staying at their highest since April 22 as persistent tight supply conditions offset inflation risks from renewed Middle East tensions. Fresh clashes between the US and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz raised doubts about the month-long ceasefire and heightened worries over prolonged energy supply disruptions. The escalation revived inflation fears and reinforced expectations that central banks might keep interest rates higher for longer, dampening demand for the non-yielding metal. Still, investors focused on signs that the US is seeking to de-escalate tensions, while also awaiting Iran’s response to a proposal to reopen the strait. The platinum market also remains structurally tight, with output concentrated in South Africa and Russia, making production vulnerable to disruption. In South Africa, aging mines, high power costs, and only gradual gains from new projects continue to limit growth, while Russia faces sanctions-related constraints.

Yen Set to End Week Little Changed — The Japanese yen traded near 157 per dollar on Friday and was set to end the week little changed, as intervention fears and fresh verbal warnings from Tokyo failed to sustain the recent rally. Japan’s top currency diplomat said on Thursday that the country has no limits on how frequently it can intervene in currency markets and maintains daily communication with US authorities. The yen had initially surged on April 30 amid suspected intervention, with another bout of movement seen on May 6, although the Ministry of Finance has not confirmed any official action in the foreign exchange market. Meanwhile, data showed that Japan’s real wages rose for a third consecutive month in March, reinforcing expectations that the Bank of Japan could continue tightening policy. On the external front, the yen faced renewed pressure from a stronger US dollar as clashes between the US and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz kept geopolitical tensions elevated.

【歐美貿易協議獲批陷僵局 歐洲議會尋求加入保障機制】據歐洲方面7日訊息，歐盟與美國去年達成的貿易協議在歐盟內部審批過程中陷入僵局。歐洲議會反對倉促批准該協議，稱美國特朗普政府的威脅以及“反覆橫跳”的立場，使協議保障機制變得更加必要。據悉，歐洲議會、歐盟委員會和歐盟理事會代表6日晚就落實歐盟－美國貿易協議舉行長達6個小時的三方協商。儘管歐盟委員會稱協商取得“進展”，但各方未能達成突破，下一輪協商定於5月19日舉行。歐盟輪值主席國塞普勒斯能源、商業與工業部長邁克爾·達米亞諾斯表示，各方承諾儘快推進歐美貿易協議落實，並繼續與歐洲議會合作。他強調，協商目標是為歐洲企業尋求“成功且平衡的結果”。

Bangladesh Inflation Rate Rises at Faster Pace — The annual inflation rate in Bangladesh rose to 9.04% in April 2026 from 8.71% in the previous month. The biggest upward pressure came from food and non-alcoholic beverages (8.39% vs 8.24% in March), housing and utilities (8.92% vs 8.43%), and transportation (9.31% vs 7.47%), mainly driven by higher global energy costs as Bangladesh remains among the countries most vulnerable to disruptions stemming from the Middle East conflict due to its heavy reliance on imported fuel and limited reserve supplies. Inflation also increased for alcoholic beverages and tobacco (9.81% vs 9.69%), furnishings, household equipment, and routine household maintenance (6.19% vs 6.15%), health (3.9% vs 3.69%), communication (9.21% vs 8.65%), recreation and culture (9.85% vs 9.26%), education (8.48% vs 8.32%), and restaurants and hotels (10.88% vs 10.38%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices eased to 0.7%, from a five-month high of 0.89% in March.

【金正恩視察重要軍工企業】據朝中社8日報道，朝鮮勞動黨總書記、國務委員會委員長金正恩6日視察重要軍工企業，瞭解今年將給南部邊境遠端炮兵部佇列裝的新型自行加農榴彈炮的生產情況。報道說，相關部門按照部隊試驗計劃進行了155毫米新型自行加農榴彈炮車的不同地形行駛和渡河試驗，並進行了改良炮彈試射。金正恩說，新型火炮武器系統具備出色的機動性、高超的戰鬥環境資訊處理能力和自動射擊系統，將完全改變朝鮮炮兵武力的構成。他表示，2026年在加強朝鮮國防力量的過程中將“重新整理前所未有的紀錄”。金正恩還視察了裝甲武器研究所和生產中的新型主戰坦克和不同型號發射架車。

【古巴國家主席迪亞斯-卡內爾譴責美國追加制裁措施】當地時間7日，古巴國家主席迪亞斯-卡內爾發文表示，古巴人民已瞭解美國政府相關行動背後的“殘酷性”，以及美方針對古巴採取行動的方式。迪亞斯-卡內爾稱，古巴人民和國際社會都清楚，這是一場針對一個國家及其人民的“單邊侵略”，而古巴人民“唯一的願望”是和平生活、自主決定自身命運，並避免受到美國“帝國主義”的干涉。他表示，美國當天宣佈的新一輪經濟封鎖措施加劇了古巴當前面臨的困難局面，同時也進一步堅定了古巴“捍衛祖國、革命和社會主義”的決心。（央視新聞）

【Citigroup Expands FX Push Into Hedge Funds and Private Equity as Dollar Outlook Turns Mixed】Citigroup Inc. is expanding its foreign-exchange business into hedge funds and private-equity clients as global trading activity increases, according to FX trading head Flavio Figueiredo. The bank aims to deepen its presence in segments where penetration is currently low while maintaining strength in corporate and real-money flows, and plans to increase its FX sales and trading workforce by 4%–5% this year. Figueiredo said U.S. dollar positioning is broadly neutral, with expectations that investors may resume selling the dollar once the US-Iran war stabilizes, while carry trades remain active and could support demand for higher-yielding emerging-market currencies such as the Brazilian real, Mexican peso, South African rand, and Colombian peso.

Meanwhile, the jobs report released earlier this week showed mixed results and had little impact on rate expectations. Traders see only a 34% chance of a rate hike later this month, though a July increase remains fully priced in as rising energy costs fuel inflation concerns. Still, the kiwi is on track for its second straight weekly gain.

Taiwan Stocks Retreat from Record High on Profit Taking — The TAIEX, Taiwan’s benchmark stock index, fell 136 points, or 0.3%, to 41,794 in Friday morning trading, erasing gains from the previous four sessions as traders took profits after the index hit a record high for the fourth straight day. The broader index retreated from its record peak reached a day earlier at 41,998 after briefly breaking the 42,000 level intraday, mainly supported by strength in the chip sector. The decline was mainly driven by the electronic technology sector, which fell 0.9% after surging on Thursday. TSMC, which accounts for more than 40% of the total market value, fell 0.4%. The index tracked a downbeat session on Wall Street overnight as traders awaited Iran’s response to the latest US peace proposal. A renewed escalation of tensions in the Middle East also further pressured sentiment. Other major laggards included Delta Electronics (-2.2%), Hon Hai Precision Industry (-1.0%), ASE Technology Holding (-3.0%), and Accton Technology Corp. (-8.0%).

【零硬體改造、依託現有電錶！電動車室內充電風險智慧識別系統上線】在市場監管總局的指導下，雲南電網依託國家計量資料建設應用中心（綠色電力），成功研發並落地應用“電動車室內充電風險智慧識別系統”。該系統透過技術創新賦能監管模式轉型，實現了對高層建築內電動腳踏車違規入戶充電行為的高效、精準識別與風險預警。該系統構建了一套大資料驅動、無硬體改造的遠端“技術+管理”協同治理模式。在技術上，該系統運用人工智慧分析演算法，基於電網現有智慧電錶提供的15分鐘負荷曲線趨勢特徵，即可遠端精準識別電動腳踏車充電的“電化學指紋”，實現了低成本、可推廣的普適性監測。在管理上，該系統支撐構建“智慧識別—風險畫像—閉環治理”的全鏈條機制，將預警資訊推送至電網、物業、社群等多方責任主體，形成從發現、核查、整改到長效監控的線上管理閉環。目前，該系統已在50餘個代表性居民區成功試執行，在無需加裝裝置、不增加投資的前提下，系統識別準確率達88%。

TTF Prices Jump on Renewed US-Iran Tensions — European natural gas futures rose more than 2% to €44.7 per MWh on Friday, rebounding after three straight sessions of losses, as renewed fighting between the US and Iran raised uncertainty over the prospects for a peace deal. The US said its forces struck Iranian military facilities on Thursday in response to attacks on guided-missile destroyers transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, President Trump said the ceasefire remains in place despite the strikes, while Iranian state TV reported that the situation is “back to normal.” The latest clashes came as Washington seeks to de-escalate tensions while awaiting Iran’s response to a proposal to reopen the strategic waterway. The effective closure of the strait has choked off around one-fifth of global LNG supply, with the route currently facing a dual blockade from both sides. The disruption has tightened global supply, fueling concerns in Europe as the region needs to replenish inventories before next winter.

China Stocks Fall as US-Iran Tensions Resurface — The Shanghai Composite edged down 0.2% to 4,172 on Friday, while the Shenzhen Component also slipped 0.2% to 15,615, after reaching two-month and over five-year highs, respectively, as market sentiment turned cautious amid renewed US-Iran tensions. Reports indicated that three US Navy destroyers transiting the Strait of Hormuz intercepted Iranian attacks and launched retaliatory strikes, fueling concerns over regional stability and energy security. Meanwhile, investors were also closely watching the upcoming meeting between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing on May 14–15. While the White House is reportedly proceeding with preparations for the visit, Chinese officials are said to be uneasy about holding the talks before the US-Iran conflict stabilizes. Energy stocks were among the laggards, particularly PetroChina (-5.5%) and CNOOC (-5.0%). Despite Friday’s slight pullback, both benchmark indices remained on course to post a fifth consecutive weekly gain.

AUS 10Y Yield Rises Back Toward 5% — Australia’s 10-year government bond yield rose toward 5%, moving back to multi-decade highs as renewed clashes between the US and Iran weakened hopes for a near-term peace agreement and reignited inflation concerns. The latest escalation followed US attempt to exit a conflict now in its third month, while awaiting Iran’s response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for energy flows. The near-closure of the strait and the resulting energy price shock have fueled concerns about rising inflation, which could keep interest rates higher for longer. In Australia, markets are pricing around a 20% chance of another rate hike in June, after 75 bps of tightening over the past three meetings. The odds rise to about 68% for August, with a rate near 4.6% fully priced in by September. Meanwhile, rising oil prices has also put pressure on the government to restrain spending in its 2026/27 budget due next week, expected around a narrower AU25 billion deficit (0.8% of GDP).

【South Korea Posts Record $37.3 Billion Current-Account Surplus on Semiconductor Export Boom】South Korea’s current-account surplus surged to a record $37.3 billion in March, according to Bank of Korea data, marking the 35th consecutive monthly surplus. The goods balance recorded a $35.1 billion surplus as exports hit an all-time high of $94.3 billion, driven mainly by semiconductor and computer-related shipments, with chip exports rising nearly 150% on a customs-clearance basis. Petroleum and chemical exports also increased due to higher oil prices. Imports rose at the fastest pace in 15 years. The financial account showed a $37 billion net asset increase, while foreign investors cut holdings of Korean equities by a record $29.3 billion amid Middle East tensions and concerns over memory-chip demand.

Hong Kong Stocks Slide as US-Iran Conflict Escalates — The Hang Seng Index fell by 280 points, or 1.1%, to around 26,340 on Friday, reversing gains from the previous sessions as renewed tensions in the Middle East dampened investor sentiment. The US and Iran exchanged fire in the Strait of Hormuz, with both sides accusing each other of initiating the attack, raising fears of further escalation in the region and potential disruption to global energy shipping routes. South Korean Won Weakens on Geopolitical Tensions — The South Korean won weakened to around 1,464 per dollar, pulling back after touching a more than two-month high, as renewed US-Iran tensions triggered risk-off sentiment across Asian markets. The confrontation saw both sides exchange fire in the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns over potential disruptions to global oil supplies, while pushing Brent crude above $100 per barrel and strengthening the US dollar as investors sought safe-haven assets. The move prompted broad USD demand and profit-taking across regional currencies, with the won among the weaker performers. Meanwhile, downside pressure was partly cushioned by strong external fundamentals, after South Korea posted a record current account surplus in March driven by a surge in semiconductor exports. Expectations of sustained AI-led chip demand and a resilient trade balance continued to provide structural support, even as short-term flows remained dominated by geopolitical risk and dollar strength.

【最高法釋出典型案例 嚴懲行業“內鬼”洩露個人資訊】隨著犯罪技術迭代更新，個人資訊洩露問題日益突出，犯罪手段更趨智慧化、隱蔽化，部分政企、平臺對資訊資料管理不善，敏感個人資訊遭竊取、洩露、販賣，甚至催生“職業竊密人”。犯罪分子利用非法獲取的個人資訊精準實施詐騙、敲詐勒索、“開盒”等違法犯罪，形成侵犯公民個人資訊犯罪黑灰產業鏈，嚴重侵害公民人身、財產安全，也嚴重危害公共安全和社會秩序。今天，最高人民法院釋出侵犯公民個人資訊犯罪及關聯犯罪典型案例，其中有兩件是行業“內鬼”洩露個人資訊的，一件涉案的是醫院，另一件是鐵路系統；另一個典型案例是官方學籍學歷資料查詢平臺被入侵導致個人資訊洩露。

【DoubleLine’s Gundlach Repositions Funds Against Risk of Forced US Treasury Coupon Cuts】DoubleLine Capital CEO Jeffrey Gundlach said he has shifted some portfolios, including the firm’s flagship fund, from higher-coupon US Treasuries into lower-coupon bonds of the same maturity to hedge against a possible future restructuring of US debt. In an interview, Gundlach said the US government could theoretically reduce coupon payments on outstanding debt during a future recession to lower interest costs, citing a hypothetical cut to 1% from 4% without changing maturities. He called the scenario a “longshot” but warned such a move would cause bond prices to collapse and severely damage US borrowing credibility. Gundlach linked the idea to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s discussions about managing the yield curve to address the US debt burden.

【White House Weighs AI Oversight After Concerns Over Anthropic’s Mythos Model】Vice President JD Vance raised concerns in a call with major AI company leaders, including OpenAI’s Sam Altman, Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, Elon Musk, Sundar Pichai and Satya Nadella, that advanced AI models such as Anthropic’s Mythos could autonomously identify software vulnerabilities and potentially enable cyberattacks on critical infrastructure like banks, hospitals and water systems. According to people familiar with the discussion, Vance urged coordination among companies and the government, while the White House is considering an executive order to create formal oversight for frontier AI models and has asked Anthropic to delay broader deployment of Mythos. National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leading the response effort, though the approach has reportedly triggered internal debate over whether it represents an overreaction or a policy shift.

South Korean Shares Pause Record Rally — The benchmark KOSPI fell 0.7% to around 7,440 on Friday, pausing after a record-setting run, as renewed US-Iran tensions triggered profit-taking. Investor sentiment weakened after the US and Iran exchanged fire in the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns over potential disruptions to global oil supplies. The escalation pushed Brent crude prices back above $100 per barrel and fueled broader risk aversion across Asian markets. Technology shares led the decline, with heavyweight chipmakers Samsung Electronics (-2.0%) and SK Hynix (-0.3%) retreating, alongside LG Energy Solution (-2.2%), Doosan Enerbility (-4.7%), and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (-5.1%). Still, losses were partly capped by continued optimism over Korea’s AI and semiconductor outlook, with the index up over 12% this week for its strongest weekly gain since 2008. Additional support came as South Korea posted a record current account surplus of $37.33 billion in March, driven by a sharp surge in semiconductor exports.
