【我國煤礦防爆裝備智慧化測評關鍵技術取得突破】市場監管總局近期組織國內科研機構，開展煤礦防爆裝備智慧化測評關鍵技術研究工作，取得了一系列創新成果，推動我國在煤礦防爆裝備測評領域實現技術突破。研究團隊開展煤礦防爆裝備內部點燃不傳爆、故障安全開斷、溫升等試驗智慧化測評技術研究，揭示了極限溫度環境下防爆裝備安全演變規律，建立了煤礦防爆安全特徵引數的虛實對映關係模型，研製了煤礦防爆裝備智慧化測評裝置，發明了防爆結構內部點燃不傳爆瞬態全息提取技術，制修訂煤礦防爆裝備相關國家/行業標準10項，為煤礦防爆裝備產品安全的有效檢測提供了從方法到標準的重要技術基礎。目前，研究成果已在有關檢驗機構與生產企業進行應用，對煤礦防爆變頻器、煤礦防爆組合開關、煤礦防爆電控箱、煤礦防爆電纜聯結器等產品進行防爆與效能檢測，有力支撐國產煤礦防爆裝備的技術迭代與質量提升。

【“五一”假期1127.9萬人次出入境 較去年同期增長3.5%】據國家移民管理局通報，今年“五一”假期全國邊檢機關共保障1127.9萬人次中外人員出入境，日均225.6萬人次，較去年“五一”假期增長3.5%，單日出入境通關最高峰出現在5月2日，達252.9萬人次。其中，外國人入出境125.5萬人次，較去年同期增長12.5%；入境外國人中，適用免籤政策入境43.6萬人次，較去年同期增長14.7%。共計查驗出入境交通運輸工具53.1萬架（艘、列、輛）次，較去年同期增長16.6%。按照國家移民管理局統一部署，全國邊檢機關嚴格落實“兩公佈一提示”要求，科學預測、及時釋出本口岸出入境客流情況，提示廣大出入境人員合理安排行程；科學組織勤務，開足查驗通道，嚴格執行中國公民通關排隊不超過30分鐘措施；密切部門協作聯動，穩妥做好高峰期客流疏導和交通配套綜合保障，全力保障旅客順暢通關。“五一”假期期間，全國口岸出入境安全高效、平穩有序。

Vietnam Holds 2026 Inflation Target at 4.5% Despite War Risks — Vietnam’s central bank will maintain its 2026 inflation target at 4.5% even as price pressures from the Iran war mount, Governor Pham Duc An said in an interview. Inflation rose 5.46% yoy in April, driven by an 11.1% surge in transport costs. Duc An noted that the global economic landscape remains “complex and unpredictable,” with geopolitical tensions complicating policy stance. The State Bank pledged to support production and business activity to help meet the government’s goal of double-digit growth over the next five years. Monetary policy will be managed flexibly, coordinated with fiscal measures to balance growth and stability. Further, authorities will rely on open market operations to ensure liquidity, steer credit toward productive sectors, and restrict lending to riskier areas. The board will also monitor market conditions closely, adjusting rates as needed while maintaining a balance between credit expansion and capital mobilisation.

Heating Oil Futures Fall Further — US heating oil futures extended their decline, dropping below $4.0 per gallon, after indications of a potential US-Iran peace agreement. President Donald Trump stated that operations to escort stranded ships out of the Strait of Hormuz would be temporarily paused to allow time to finalize a deal with Iran, but added that the blockade of Iranian ports would remain in place. His comments followed Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s assurance that the Middle East ceasefire is still holding and that the initial major US military operation against Iran has ended. Iran also denied carrying out attacks against the UAE, but warned of a “decisive response” if Abu Dhabi launches strikes on its territory. Meanwhile, weather forecasts have shifted slightly warmer as the market transitions toward the summer cooling season, although below-average temperatures are still expected across parts of the US Midwest in the near term.

Indonesian Equities Rise for Third Session — Indonesian shares advanced 37 points or 0.5% to 7,094 in early Wednesday trade, extending gains for a third session after record closes on Wall Street’s S&P 500 and Nasdaq, lifted by U.S. President Donald Trump’s pause in efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for a deal with Iran. Locally, Indonesia's GDP grew 5.61% yoy in Q1 2026, beating market forecasts and marking the fastest yearly expansion since 2022, boosted by festive-season demand, government spending on the Free Nutritious Meal Program, and a favorable low base. However, strength was tempered by a smaller trade surplus in March, reflecting sharp declines in coal and coffee exports. Meanwhile, the rupiah's weakness persisted, adding pressure to the economy. All sectors moved higher, led by basic materials, non-cyclicals, and industrials. Top movers included J Resources Asia Pacific (11.8%), TBS Energy Utama (8.6%), Unilever Indonesia (5.5%), and Energi Mega Persada (4.6%).

Financial System Resilient Amid Worsening Global Outlook: RBNZ — New Zealand’s financial system remains resilient even as global risks intensify, according to the central bank's Governor Anna Breman. In its latest Financial Stability Report, she said the system is well-positioned to support households and businesses if conditions weaken. However, prolonged conflict in the Middle East is raising global financial stability risks and already weighing on the domestic economy. While growth had been recovering, the outlook has softened, with slower momentum expected to affect employment and make debt servicing more challenging. Despite these headwinds, the banking sector remains robust, supported by strong capital and funding buffers. Stress tests also indicate that banks can withstand severe economic shocks, leaving them capable of supporting customers and managing pressures from offshore funding markets.

Gasoline Futures Extend Drop — US gasoline futures fell below $3.60 per gallon, extending their retreat from a near four-year high on hopes of de-escalation in the Middle East conflict. President Donald Trump said efforts to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz would be temporarily paused to allow space to finalize a settlement with Iran aimed at ending the war. His remarks came after Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the ceasefire in the Middle East remains intact and that the initial major US military operation against Iran has concluded, further calming markets. Meanwhile, Iran denied carrying out attacks against the UAE and warned of a “decisive response” if Abu Dhabi launches strikes on its territory. On the fundamentals side, the EIA reported increased gasoline demand for the week ending April 24, alongside a decline inventories and slightly lower production.

【古巴譴責美國對古制裁及軍事威脅】當地時間5月5日，古巴外交部長羅德里格斯譴責美國對古巴實施的新一輪制裁及相關軍事威脅。羅德里格斯表示，美國國務卿有關不存在針對古巴“石油封鎖”的說法“是在撒謊”，並稱其言論與美國總統及白宮發言人的表態相矛盾。他指出，事實不容掩蓋：2026年1月29日，美國總統簽署行政命令，威脅對向古巴出口燃料的國家加徵關稅，直接導致在過去4個月中，僅有一艘燃料運輸船抵達古巴；美國長期對古巴供應方進行威脅和施壓，違反自由貿易規則和航行自由；根據5月1日一項新的行政命令，美國在能源領域設立“次級制裁”。羅德里格斯稱，美方非常清楚石油封鎖給古巴人民造成的巨大損害和痛苦。羅德里格斯還指出，幾十年來美國一直試圖透過經濟戰摧毀古巴，但無論是經濟封鎖、能源封鎖，還是軍事威脅和直接侵略，都是國際犯罪行徑。

【我國測控裝備智慧化測評技術邁上新臺階】記者今天瞭解到，針對測控裝備智慧化測評領域缺乏科學、通用的智慧化水平測評標準與測試方法，導致測控裝備智慧最佳化效能與應用效果難以統一衡量的問題，市場監管總局組織國內優勢科技力量，開展裝備系統智慧化標準、檢測、計量、認證技術研究與裝置研發，取得一系列創新成果，完善了智慧化測評質量基礎設施。研究團隊創新利用自然語言處理與人工智慧聚類技術，構建測控裝備智慧化通用測評指標體系與典型測控裝備測評指標體系，基於主客觀組合賦權法構建測控裝備智慧化評估模型，相關研究整理形成國際、國家、團體等系列標準。研究團隊攻克數字孿生測評方法、參考資料集及模型可信度計量等關鍵測試計量技術，形成典型測控裝備智慧化測評方法集，研發構建測控裝備數字孿生體測量系統與物理實體測評裝置，實現測控裝備智慧化水平可測試、可量化。相關研究成果形成測控裝備智慧化綜合測評系統與測控裝備智慧化測評認證模式，已面向6類典型測控裝備開展智慧化測評驗證，搭建3套測評驗證實物場景，構建了具有核心技術和基礎資料支撐的測試、計量、認證一體化測控裝備智慧化評測體系。（央視）

Offshore Yuan Approaches 3-Year High — The offshore yuan traded around 6.81 per dollar on Wednesday, approaching its strongest level since March 2023, as demand for safe-haven assets such as the greenback weakened amid diplomatic progress between the US and Iran. Market sentiment improved after President Donald Trump pointed to what he described as “great progress” toward a “complete and final agreement with representatives of Iran,” while stating that the US would temporarily pause efforts to assist stranded vessels leaving the Strait of Hormuz. In parallel, Trump indicated he would discuss the Iran conflict with Chinese President Xi Jinping during their upcoming summit on May 14–15, while seeking to temper tensions surrounding the issue. On the domestic front, a private survey showed that the composite PMI rose to 53.1 in April from 51.5 in March, as both manufacturing output (52.2 vs. 50.8) and services activity (52.6 vs. 52.1) expanded at a faster pace.

The US reaffirmed its ceasefire with Iran, confirmed that offensive operations have ended, and temporarily suspended efforts to assist stranded vessels exiting the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for potential renewed negotiations. Benchmark indices in Australia, China, and Hong Kong also moved higher. Japanese markets, however, remained closed due to public holidays.

South Korean Won Hits Over 2-Month High — The South Korean won rose toward 1,456 per dollar, rebounding to its strongest level in over two months, amid easing geopolitical risk and improved external conditions. US President Donald Trump signaled a pause in maritime operations in the Strait of Hormuz while negotiations with Iran continue, reducing fears of prolonged disruption in a key global oil shipping route and pushing crude prices lower. Lower oil prices improve import cost expectations and soften external balance pressures for South Korea, easing depreciation risks for the won. Domestic inflation rose to a 21-month high on fuel costs tied to earlier energy price spikes, but remains driven mainly by import pass-through rather than demand pressures, limiting overheating concerns while keeping monetary policy expectations broadly stable. The currency also benefited from stronger foreign inflows into Korean assets amid improved global risk appetite, as investors added to local equities, reinforcing FX demand for the won.

China Stocks Climb Post-Holiday — The Shanghai Composite rose 0.9% to a two-month high of 4,151 on Wednesday, while the Shenzhen Component climbed 2.4% to 15,464, its strongest level since March 2021, as investors returned from an extended holiday break and reacted positively to improving geopolitical development and strong momentum in technology shares. Optimism was driven by President Trump’s signals of progress toward a potential Iran agreement and a temporary pause in US-led maritime operations in the Strait of Hormuz to support diplomacy. Sentiment was further lifted by gains in tech stocks amid strong earnings from Advanced Micro Devices and Super Micro Computer, with notable performers including Hygon Information Technology (20%), Cambricon Technologies (11.8%), Zhongji Innolight (3.2%) and NAURA Technology (3.8%). Meanwhile, a private survey showed that China’s composite PMI rose to 53.1 in April from 51.5 in March, supported by growth in both manufacturing (52.2 vs. 50.8) and services (52.6 vs. 52.1) PMIs.

Hong Kong Stocks Gain as Middle East Tensions Ease — The Hang Seng Index edged higher by about 181 points, or 0.7%, to 26,085 on Wednesday, as investors tracked gains in global equities while still weighing uncertainty from the Middle East. Sentiment improved after Washington moved to de-escalate tensions with Iran, halting offensive operations, reaffirming the ceasefire, and a temporary suspension of efforts to support vessels leaving the Strait of Hormuz. Oil prices also eased after recent spikes driven by supply disruption concerns, helping to relieve pressure on inflation expectations and improving the outlook for regional equities. The decline in crude further boosted investor confidence across Asian markets, supporting risk assets and extending gains in global equities. In Hong Kong, financials and semiconductor-related tech led the rally. Among notable movers were Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (6.6%), Xiaomi (1.5%), AIA Group (0.1%), Akeso Inc. (4.4%), and CK Hutchison Holdings (2.4%).

【英國公司“培訓”人形機器人垃圾分揀員】垃圾分揀工作環境艱苦，員工健康風險高、流動性大，英國一家垃圾處理公司為此專門“培訓”人形機器人垃圾分揀員，以期提高工作效率。據英國廣播公司4日報道，這家垃圾處理公司位於倫敦東部雷納姆，由家族企業“夏普集團”經營。傳送帶上，舊鞋、錄影帶甚至水泥塊等垃圾流水般運進廠房，24名員工輪流工作，每年能夠分揀大約28萬噸垃圾。公司方面表示，受工作環境限制，儘管公司保持著很高的安全標準，但工傷和因工作導致的疾病發病率仍比其他行業高出約45%，員工年流失率高達四成。(新華社)

【伊朗否認襲擊阿聯酋 警告將堅決回應任何針對行動】伊朗武裝部隊哈塔姆安比亞中央總部和伊朗外交部5日分別發表宣告，否認伊朗在過去幾天內對阿聯酋實施過導彈或無人機襲擊，並警告說如有任何來自阿聯酋方向的針對行動，伊朗將採取堅決回應。 據伊朗伊斯蘭共和國廣播電視臺報道，哈塔姆安比亞中央總部當天在宣告中否認阿聯酋方面相關指控，稱其缺乏事實依據。宣告還批評阿聯酋允許其領土被用於駐紮美國及以色列軍事力量，並“針對伊朗進行不公正的媒體攻擊、誹謗與輿論操控”。 哈塔姆安比亞中央總部在宣告中警告說，如有任何來自阿聯酋領土針對伊朗島嶼、港口或沿海地區的行動，將遭到“強烈”的回應。 伊朗外交部同日晚發表宣告，駁斥有關伊朗向阿聯酋發射導彈和無人機的指控，並強調伊朗的防禦行動“旨在擊退美國的邪惡行徑”。 宣告譴責阿聯酋與敵對勢力勾結、對伊朗實施破壞性行為，包括允許敵對勢力繼續在阿聯酋境內設立軍事基地和存放軍事裝備，並警告這種情況將對地區和平與穩定造成危險後果。宣告還說，伊朗將採取一切必要和適當措施，捍衛其國家利益和安全。 阿聯酋國防部5日在社交媒體上發文稱，其防空系統正在應對來自伊朗的導彈和無人機襲擊。(新華社)

Yen Strengthens as Dollar and Oil Ease — The Japanese yen rose toward 157.5 per dollar on Wednesday, snapping a three-day losing streak as both the US dollar and oil prices declined on growing signs of de-escalation in the Middle East. Washington reaffirmed the ceasefire, confirmed that offensive operations against Iran have ended, and temporarily paused efforts to assist stranded vessels leaving the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for potential renewed talks with Tehran. The yen remains particularly sensitive to Middle East developments due to Japan’s heavy dependence on oil imports from the Gulf. At the same time, investors stayed alert to the possibility of official support for the currency following suspected intervention by Japanese authorities last week. Estimates suggest Tokyo may have deployed around $35 billion to stabilize the yen, although officials have not confirmed any intervention. Still, the yen’s recent pullback suggests a lack of further follow-through action from policymakers.

China Services Growth Beats Estimates — The RatingDog China General Services PMI increased to 52.6 in April 2026 from March’s three-month low of 52.1, surpassing market forecasts of 52. New business grew for the fortieth successive month, the second-longest period of continuous expansion in the survey's history, with domestic demand remaining a key driver. Meanwhile, foreign sales fell for the second straight month, although the rate of decline was only marginal and eased compared with March. Employment declined fractionally for the third month in succession. Average input price inflation accelerated to its highest level in 2026 so far, boosted by higher oil prices and fuel costs due to the impact of the war in the Middle East. Meanwhile, selling prices fell for the fourth time in the past five months, albeit marginally. Finally, business confidence was among the highest recorded over the past year, supported by new projects, market expansion, and efficiency gains.

China RatingDog Composite PMI Rises from 3-Month Low — The RatingDog China General Composite PMI rose to 53.1 in April 2026 from March’s three-month low of 51.5, signaling a solid pickup in overall business activity as both manufacturing output and services expanded at a faster pace. Total new business grew more strongly, supported by firmer inflows across both sectors, while outstanding work increased for a third consecutive month, pointing to sustained demand. Employment was broadly stable, slipping only marginally from the previous month. On the price front, cost pressures intensified, with input prices rising at the fastest rate since April 2022, largely driven by manufacturing. Firms responded by raising selling prices, with charge inflation accelerating to a 31-month high, reflecting efforts to pass through higher costs and protect margins.

Oil prices fell on the news, easing inflation concerns and lifting global equities alongside Wall Street’s record highs. Semiconductor heavyweights led the advance, with Samsung Electronics (12.3%) and SK Hynix (10.0%) hitting record highs on optimism over the AI-driven chip supercycle and tightening memory supply. Other notable gains included SK Square (11.6%), Hyundai Motor (3.3%), and KB Financial Group (2.9%). Strong foreign and institutional buying added support, with overseas investors purchasing about KRW 3 trillion worth of shares and institutions adding about KRW 1.9 trillion.

Dollar Slides on Iran Deal Optimism — The dollar index fell toward 98 on Wednesday, ending a three-day advance as growing optimism that Washington could reach a deal with Tehran reduced demand for the currency’s safe-haven appeal. Defense Secretary Hegseth said the ceasefire that began nearly a month ago remains intact, while Secretary of State Rubio confirmed that offensive operations have concluded as Washington shifts its focus to protecting shipping routes in the strait. President Trump also announced a temporary pause in a US-led effort to assist stranded vessels in exiting the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for renewed talks with Tehran. Oil prices retreated, easing inflation concerns and tempering expectations that the Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates to arrest price pressures. Market participants now turn to ADP’s private payrolls report for April to assess labor market strength, ahead of the more closely watched monthly jobs report due Friday.

Fitch Raises Argentina’s Rating to “B-” — Fitch upgraded its credit rating on Argentina by one notch to “B-” from “CCC” on Tuesday, with a stable outlook, citing the country’s improved fiscal performance and progress on economic reforms. The note also cited legislative victories by Argentine President Javier Milei, including labor reforms and the easing of environmental restrictions on mining. However, the agency noted that vulnerabilities persist due to weak international reserves, high inflation, and a history of macroeconomic instability. Fitch said it expects economic growth to moderate to 3.2% in 2026. Standard & Poor’s credit rating for Argentina stands at CCC+ with a stable outlook. Moody’s credit rating for Argentina was last set at Caa1 with a stable outlook. DBRS’s credit rating for Argentina was last reported at B (low), also with a stable outlook.

Philippines Jobless Rate Ticks Down to 5% — The unemployment rate in the Philippines edged down to 5% in March 2026, the lowest level in three months, from 5.1% February. The number of unemployed persons decreased to 2.58 million from 2.66 million in the previous month. Meanwhile, the employment rate inched up to 95% from 94.9%, with total employment reaching 49.07 million. The labor force participation rate fell to 63.3% from 63.8% in February but was still above 62.9% in March 2025. The services sector accounted for the largest share of employment at 63.0%, followed by agriculture (19.1%) and industry (17.9%). The top sub-sectors were wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles (20.2%), agriculture and forestry (17.1%), and construction (9.6%). Wage and salary workers comprised 63.7% of the workforce, most of whom were employed in private establishments. The average weekly hours worked was estimated at 40.7 hours.

Philippines Industrial Output Strongest Since 2023 — Manufacturing production in the Philippines climbed 10.5% year-on-year in March 2026, accelerating from a downwardly revised 4.5% gain in the previous month. This marked the strongest annual growth since January 2023, driven largely by a rebound in the manufacture of coke and refined petroleum products (4% vs -16.6% in February), which contributed 41.1% to the overall increase. Other key contributors included the manufacture of computer, electronic and optical products (20.8% vs 15.2%), basic metals (42% vs 32.3%), and transport equipment (7.4% vs 2.2%). In contrast, output growth moderated in the manufacture of food products (3% vs 3.5%), other non-metallic mineral products (4.4% vs 5.1%), tobacco products (3.2% vs 11.1%), and leather and related products, including footwear (13% vs 18.3%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial output rose 1.9%, rebounding from a 0.3% fall in February. For the first quarter of the year, industrial output expanded 5.5%.

On the monetary front, the Reserve Bank raised cash rates for a third straight meeting Tuesday, warning the Middle East oil crisis could fuel inflation and prolong price pressures. Aussie Dollar Hits Fresh 4-Year Top — The Australian dollar climbed to above $0.72, hitting a fresh four-year high after the Reserve Bank delivered a widely expected 25bp hike to 4.35%, while risk sentiment improved amid signs of de-escalation in the Middle East conflict. In an eight to one vote, the RBA raised the cash rate for a third straight meeting, underscoring its focus on bringing inflation back to the 2–3% target. The decision marked a more hawkish stance than the split seen in March, though policymakers signaled that monetary policy is now “well placed to respond to developments,” hinting at a possible pause ahead. Markets see only a 20% chance of another move in June, while a further increase toward 4.60% by September remains fully priced. On the geopolitical front, optimism grew that a deal with Tehran could be within reach, after the US declared an end to offensive operations against Iran, reaffirmed the ceasefire, and temporarily paused efforts to help stranded vessels exit the Strait of Hormuz.

New Zealand Dollar Rises After Jobs Report — The New Zealand dollar rose to $0.591, marking a second consecutive session of gains, as investors digested the labor market report. The unemployment rate ticked down to 5.3% in the first quarter from 5.4% in the previous quarter, slightly below market expectations of 5.4%. Meanwhile, employment increased by just 0.2% over the quarter, missing the 0.3% forecast. The war in the Middle East has weighed heavily on business confidence, leading firms to scale back investment and hiring. Other details in the report also point to ample spare capacity in the market and subdued wage growth. Markets are pricing in only a 35% chance of a rate hike later this month, but an increase in July is still fully priced in. The Reserve Bank of New Zealand held its cash rate steady in April but signaled that any signs of significant second-round inflationary effects or a rise in medium-term inflation expectations would warrant decisive and timely rate hikes.

【千尋智慧與博世集團達成戰略合作 加速具身智慧產業落地】近日，具身智慧公司千尋智慧（Spirit AI）與博世中國（BOSCH）正式簽署了戰略合作協議。雙方將圍繞機器人資料採集與模型訓練、工業場景部署、核心部件供應等領域展開系統性合作，共同推動通用機器人大腦的商業化程序。此次雙方達成戰略合作是具身智慧從技術探索邁向規模化應用的重要節點。雙方將在未來兩年內，依託博世在中國的工廠、物流中心等真實工業環境，深度開展機器人資料採集與模型訓練合作。

【佛羅里達州一家公司稱其船隻已穿越霍爾木茲海峽】總部位於佛羅里達州的一家航運運營商表示，旗下船隻CS Anthem於週一安全透過了霍爾木茲海峽。這家名為Crowley的公司表示，該公司“認可美國海軍和政府合作伙伴的專業精神，他們在全球範圍內致力於維護海上安全”。負責管轄中東地區美軍的美國中央司令部(U.S. Central Command)表示，美軍最近幾天為商船開闢了一條通道，以便商船透過該水道，打破伊朗對霍爾木茲海峽的封鎖。CS Anthem是之前被困在波斯灣的眾多船隻之一。丹麥集裝箱船運營商A.P.穆勒-馬士基集團(A.P. Moller-Maersk)週一表示，另一艘懸掛美國國旗的船隻Alliance Fairfax也穿越了霍爾木茲海峽。
韓元兌美元升值突破1460關口，創下4月17日以來最強水平。
紐約期金突破4620美元/盎司，日內漲1.13%。

【Blackstone、KKR據悉與谷歌洽談在人工智慧領域進行合作】據知情人士透露，Blackstone Inc.和KKR & Co.正與Alphabet Inc.進行洽談，以讓它們旗下的公司能夠使用谷歌的人工智慧AI模型。當下OpenAI和Anthropic PBC正分別與另類資產管理公司結盟成立AI諮詢公司，將私募股權投資公司支援的企業轉變為AI公司的新收入來源。知情人士表示，除了Blackstone和KKR之外，Alphabet還在與私募股權投資公司EQT AB進行洽談。由於討論內容保密，他們要求匿名。他們還表示，這些討論並非獨家進行，也不能保證最終會達成協議。
【大國糧倉裝備上新 讓每一粒糧食住上“空調房”】從田間到餐桌，糧食不僅要種得好，更要存得好。記者從國家糧食和物資儲備局瞭解到，今年，我國將深入推進綠色儲糧技術整合應用示範，加快推動糧食倉儲綠色轉型。按照國家規劃，到2027年，全國要建成100個綠色儲糧技術整合應用“樣板間”，覆蓋從南到北、從東到西七大儲糧生態區。（央視）

Hong Kong Private Sector PMI Slips to 10-Month Low — The S&P Global Hong Kong SAR PMI was down to 48.6 in April 2026 from 49.3 in the previous month, marking the lowest reading since June 2025. It also indicated the second straight month contraction in the private sector

【中國銀河證券：港股價效比敘事不會消失 投資策略上把握三條主線】中國銀河證券釋出研報稱，港股價效比敘事不會消失，但會從全面估值修復切換為結構性防禦和左側佈局，港股當前處於估值有底、但外部流動性壓制的矛盾階段，當前市場處於短期震盪分化，中期若外部壓力緩解，港股估值修復空間依然可觀。投資策略上應把握三條主線：(1)科技板塊。建議聚焦半導體/硬體裝置。前期熱門AI概念股已出現明顯回撥，短期回撥壓力仍在，建議迴避過熱標的，等待調整後再佈局。AI應用端的Token出海邏輯仍在，5月或有新模型釋出，維持關注。(2)創新藥板塊。ASCO大會臨近，配置視窗期仍在，可提前關注業績確定性高的個股。(3)高股息/紅利資產。公用事業同時受益於電力裝置出海邏輯，攻守兼備，兼具防禦性與成長性。
CFETS：4月30日人民幣匯率指數按周漲0.09至100.17.
Larsen & Toubro earnings below expectations at 38.70 INR — Larsen & Toubro (LT) released earnings per share at 38.70 INR, compared to market expectations of 44.17 INR.

【Rivian稱投入數億美元自研晶片】Rivian執行長RJ Scaringe接受採訪時透露，該公司正在為其定製晶片專案投入“數億美元”，該專案的首款晶片，內部稱為Rivian自動駕駛處理器或 RAP-1，將於今年問世。Scaringe表示，該公司計劃“每隔幾年”釋出一款新晶片，RAP-2和RAP-3將是首款晶片的後續產品，採用比RAP-1所用的臺積電 5 奈米制程工藝“更強大”的晶片技術。“這不像投資幾億美元就萬事大吉了，”Scaringe說，“我們組建了一支團隊。這支團隊將繼續開發該平臺的未來版本。”

【Rivian考慮自研鐳射雷達感測器，可能與中國公司合作】美國電動汽車製造商Rivian執行長RJ Scaringe在當地時間週二接受採訪時表示，該公司正在考慮生產自己的鐳射雷達感測器，並可能與一家中國公司合作生產。Rivian正在考慮利用中國技術在美國自行生產鐳射雷達感測器，而不是直接從中國供應商採購。Scaringe表示，他們可能會透過合資企業來實現這一目標，並指出，對於Rivian等汽車製造商所需的“價格在幾百美元低位”的感測器而言，“所有真正的選擇都來自中國”。
布倫特原油突破109美元/桶，日內跌0.79%。

【中信證券：一季度電子行業基金配置略有回落 超配比例仍處歷史高位】中信證券研報指出，2026年一季度公募基金季報披露完畢，電子行業配置比例自2025年四季度歷史高位環比略降，但仍處高位區間：2026年一季度電子行業基金重倉股市值規模合計為6200.15億元，環比-6.41%。子行業而言，半導體在電子行業內部佔比提升，消費電子、元器件在電子行業內部佔比略降。預計2026年二季度的AI行情開始發散，建議投資人關注AI業務相關公司。

【金建希案法官疑似墜亡】據多家韓國媒體報道，韓國前總統尹錫悅的夫人金建希涉嫌股價操縱等案二審主審法官今天（5月6日）凌晨被發現死於法院內。據報道，經初步調查，現場“基本排除他殺嫌疑”，該法官“疑似墜亡”。韓國警方正就其具體死因等進行調查。 4月28日，韓國高等法院就金建希所涉案件進行二審宣判，主審法官宣佈判處金建希4年刑期，罰款5000萬韓元（約合23萬元人民幣），超過一審1年零8個月刑期的量刑結果。與一審僅認定部分受賄嫌疑不同，二審認定金建希的股價操縱嫌疑構成有罪。

【中信證券：一線城市銷售端築底訊號初顯，有望於2027年企穩，上海有望成為一線城市中率先企穩的城市】中信證券研報指出，2026年以來，我國房地產市場延續結構性分化行情，一線城市成為本輪市場修復的核心主線。“小陽春”期間，國內各線城市房地產市場表現明顯分化，一線城市在二手房、新房成交、庫存去化及價格修復等方面全面領跑，二三線城市則相對滯後。從長期資料觀察，一線城市銷售端築底訊號初顯、庫存端持續出清、開發端邊際修復，有望於2027年企穩，上海有望成為一線城市中率先企穩的城市。債市方面，下行空間仍存，預計區間震盪為主。

【中信證券：沃什在5月透過美國參議院全院投票、得到正式任命的機率較高】中信證券研報指出，隨著美國司法部結束對於鮑威爾的刑事調查，我們判斷當前沃什在5月透過美國參議院全院投票、得到正式任命的機率較高。整體而言，在貨幣政策框架與美聯儲對外溝通方面，沃什相較於伯南克、耶倫和鮑威爾更加傳統、謹慎。沃什對資產負債表工具持謹慎態度，主張以政策利率作為主要工具以及緩慢縮表，並且沃什主張貨幣政策決策更多依據實時資料而非預先承諾的路徑，認為過度依賴前瞻性指引會削弱政策靈活性。
美國：南方突擊隊在一次襲擊中擊斃3名“毒品恐怖分子”。

【中信證券：關注豬週期上行時點】中信證券研報表示，2026年4月28日，政治局會議再度點名穩定價格，4月中旬，豬肉批發價跌破14.5元/公斤，為2008年後最低值。供給過剩疊加中長期需求量的下降，共同導致了本輪豬價的降幅超預期，同時行業集中度上升帶來的廠商博弈以及養殖效率改善導致的去產能困難使得漲價週期愈發不明顯。向後看，當前仍處於豬肉去產能的開端，去產能節奏較慢，週期較長，從存欄數量推斷，二季度豬肉供給仍偏寬，三季度之後或出現供給的有效邊際下降。

【銀河證券：能源、通訊服務和現金流穩定資產仍具相對優勢】銀河證券指出，若美伊停火繼續延長、霍爾木茲海峽通行逐步恢復，前期由戰爭升級帶來的極端避險需求或邊際回落，黃金可能由單邊上行轉向高位震盪，權益市場風險偏好也有修復空間。但由於伊朗核問題、制裁解除、港口封鎖等核心分歧尚未解決，原油仍將是全球通脹與風險偏好的關鍵變數。同時，阿聯酋退出歐佩克+意味著產油國供給紀律邊際鬆動，或限制油價進一步單邊上行。對利率而言，油價與關稅若繼續推升成本型通脹，美聯儲降息視窗仍將後移，美債收益率下行空間受限，全球權益估值擴張也將受到壓制。結構上，能源、通訊服務和現金流穩定資產仍具相對優勢。

【三星電子市值達萬億美元 成臺積電之後第二家達到該規模的亞洲公司】三星電子市值達到1萬億美元，隨著人工智慧AI晶片的需求激增，這家全球最大的儲存器製造商股價在過去一年裡上漲了三倍多。週三早盤這家韓國公司的股價一度上漲11%，使其成為繼臺積電之後第二家達到萬億美元里程碑的亞洲公司。三星電子和同行SK海力士、臺積電處於一場變革的核心，在這期間亞洲成為全球AI生態系統的基石。這一轉變推動區域科技股強勁上漲——SK海力士和臺積電本月也創下紀錄新高，投資者押注對先進晶片和算力的持續需求。

新世界發展稱有潛在買家不時接洽，惟公司尚未就任何出售資產訂立協議.

【中信證券：五一假期出行方式增速分化 關注航空佈局時機】中信證券研報指出，五一假期整體旅客出行人次穩健增長，不同出行方式同比增速表現分化，其中民航/鐵路/公路日均旅客傳送量同比-5.3%/+4.9%/+2.0%，出行方式增速分化、遠端需求進一步修復和特色深度旅遊刺激多元化需求或為假期出行主要特徵。受高油價減班和需求前置影響，五一假期民航旅客傳送量同比下降5.3%。2026年一季度航司利潤端符合預期，量價表現彰顯資料端改善，只待油價企穩的東風。航油價格及供應擾動衝擊下，中方航司對抗短期擾動更具韌性，關注歐線、東南亞航線等中方航司市佔率進一步提升，同時關注中期國內民航業格局潛在新變數。

【中信證券：輸入性通脹環境下的出口韌性或支撐上游資源鏈和外向型中高階製造業景氣佔優】中信證券研報表示，4月PMI資料顯示製造業景氣有所改善，輸入性通脹伴隨的出口與企業盈利韌性對製造業景氣有一定積極意義。結構上，出口端的修復程度最為突出，也帶動生產景氣回升，價格仍在高位執行，對應4月PPI讀數可能顯著上行。從行業看，中高階製造業、能源化工鏈行業景氣度較高，高耗能行業PMI回落。不過，非製造業景氣低位執行，可能源於地方投資審批新政影響建築業景氣，以及失業率上行影響服務業景氣修復。展望後續，輸入性通脹環境下的出口韌性或支撐上游資源鏈和外向型中高階製造業景氣佔優，其他領域則需關注高油價對產需的擠壓效應。

【中信證券：建議關注經營穩健、份額提升、全球化能力較強的家電龍頭標的】中信證券研報表示，受內需偏弱、外銷高基數及原材料價格和匯率波動影響，家電行業25Q4和26Q1業績階段性波動。分板塊看，白電公司經營仍具韌性，黑電公司受海外份額提升和結構升級支撐，小家電公司表現分化，廚電仍受地產後週期拖累。展望後續，隨著補貼政策延續、外銷基數壓力緩解以及企業海外佈局最佳化，行業收入和盈利有望邊際修復，建議關注經營穩健、份額提升、全球化能力較強的龍頭標的。

【中信證券：銀行板塊全年絕對收益可期】中信證券研報表示，一季報顯示，上市銀行息差和中收等核心驅動要素表現好於市場預期，雖存在基數效應，但全年經營修復曲線形態已經確立。資金面顯示，一季度銀行板塊長線資金延續流入，險資等低風偏資金延續A股和H股銀行的配置意願；公募基金則重視個股策略調整，增加了低估值和高增長公司配置權重。展望全年，預計業績增長有望維持一季度水平，板塊投資風格仍將延續，全年絕對收益可期。

【中信證券：煤價有望超預期 Q2業績彈性也預計將進一步放大】中信證券研報表示，中東地緣衝突以來，國內動力煤需求面臨淡季，但化工耗煤需求或持續釋放，推動煤價小幅上漲，表現好於預期；焦煤價格在供給擾動的預期下，也穩中看漲。煤炭板塊近幾周跟隨中東局勢波動過後，重拾上漲，隨著夏季旺季臨近、海外因素支撐、厄爾尼諾天氣等預期，旺季預期板塊利好因素有望持續疊加，與市場風格輪動形成共振，煤價有望超預期，Q2業績彈性也預計將進一步放大。

Silver Rebounds as US-Iran Tensions Ease — Silver rose above $73.5 an ounce on Wednesday, recouping losses from earlier in the week as signs of de-escalation in the Middle East weighed on oil prices, helping to ease inflation concerns. Defense Secretary Hegseth said the ceasefire established nearly a month ago remains in place, while Secretary of State Rubio confirmed that offensive operations have ended as Washington shifts its focus to securing shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump also announced a temporary pause in a US-led effort to assist stranded vessels in exiting the strait, allowing time to assess whether a deal with Iran to end the conflict can be reached, though the blockade on ships traveling to and from Iranian ports will remain in effect. Silver has come under sustained selling pressure since the start of the conflict, as surging energy costs fueled inflation concerns and strengthened expectations that central banks may keep interest rates higher for longer or even tighten policy further.

【五一假期澳門入境旅客約87.3萬人次】澳門特區政府治安警察局6日公佈的資料顯示，五一假期澳門各口岸總通關客流量381.2萬人次，同比增1.6%，其中，入境澳門旅客約87.3萬人次。 從客源地來看，內地、港、臺及外國的旅客分別佔83.0％、10.8％、1.3％及4.9％。資料還顯示，5月2日澳門出入境客流量重新整理三項單日通關紀錄，分別是：總通關客流88.9萬人次、入境旅客24.8萬人次，以及橫琴口岸通關客流近14.8萬人次。

US Futures Gain on Iran Deal Hopes — US stock futures advanced on Wednesday as optimism grew that a deal with Tehran could be within reach, after Washington declared an end to offensive operations against Iran, reaffirmed the ceasefire, and temporarily halted efforts to assist stranded vessels in exiting the Strait of Hormuz. Futures tied to the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 climbed 0.4% and 0.8%, respectively, while Dow futures edged up 0.2%. In extended trading, Advanced Micro Devices surged more than 16% after posting stronger-than-expected first-quarter earnings and revenue, along with an upbeat outlook for the current quarter. Super Micro Computer also jumped 18% following robust profit guidance, whereas Arista Networks slid nearly 12% after falling short of margin expectations. Investors now turn to another batch of earnings due Wednesday, including reports from AppLovin, Walt Disney, Uber, CVS Health, and DoorDash. Market participants will also monitor the release of ADP’s private payrolls report for April.

【銀河證券：建議關注景氣度較高的上游算力基礎設施】銀河證券認為，4月人工智慧板塊在板塊內部仍然呈現出結構嚴重分化的特徵，整體呈現硬體強、軟體及應用弱的結構，短期看來地緣衝突以及油價中樞維持高位震盪的影響弱化，但受到財報季的影響，上游算力基礎設施尤其是國產算力業績大幅超預期，資金也更加青睞業績確定性較強以及預期較高的板塊及公司，短期來看結構分化仍然在延續，建議關注景氣度較高的上游算力基礎設施，尤其是國產算力產業鏈。

【華泰證券：短期行情或進入震盪期 風格層面建議啞鈴配置】華泰證券研報認為，上週市場震盪上行，科創50接力創業板指走強並接近前高，科技主線行情持續下節前資金落袋意願不強，假期港股先漲後跌。展望節後，研報認為本輪行情盈利驅動的底色未變，但短期情緒快速修復後，市場或進入震盪期：內部，估值抬升空間有限，交易結構較擁擠；外部，中東局勢仍有反覆、美聯儲寬鬆預期降溫。風格上，大盤成長佔優的中期邏輯延續，但短期有再平衡需求，建議適當增配小盤和紅利，透過啞鈴配置應對波動率上升；行業上，繼續在景氣線索內部輪動，關注泛AI鏈、電力鏈和出口鏈內部擁擠度相對較低的方向。

【KKR稱私募市場困境被誇大】KKR的管理層試圖淡化席捲私募市場公司的動盪，這家總部位於紐約的公司此前公佈的季度盈利超出了分析師的預期。該多策略資產管理公司週二公佈第一季度扭虧為盈，保險部門的收入增長逾一倍。同期，公司融資活動保持穩健，收費收入和交易利潤也取得增長。KKR聯席執行長斯科特·納托爾(Scott Nuttall)在週二與分析師的電話會議上說：“事實是，外界對我們公司業務和整個行業波動性的看法，與我們的親身感受並不相符。”該公司公佈的財報顯示，當季實現利潤3.648億美元，合每股38美分；相比之下，上年同期虧損1.859億美元，合每股22美分。當時，業績因關稅引發的市場大幅下挫而受到拖累。首席財務官羅伯特·盧因(Robert Lewin)表示，私募信貸業務成為一個出人意料的亮點。私募信貸領域近來因不良貸款擔憂而備受衝擊，但KKR當季為該資產類別募集了超過150億美元。他補充說，儘管充斥著各種負面訊息，一些機構投資者正被重新吸引回私募信貸領域。納托爾表示，他預計公司股價的波動性會隨著時間的推移而下降。今年以來，KKR的股價已下跌約20%。

【銀河證券：市場或將圍繞外部地緣衝突反覆、國內基本面修復以及後續政策預期持續博弈】銀河證券展望節後市場行情，市場或將圍繞外部地緣衝突反覆、國內基本面修復以及後續政策預期持續博弈，一季度資料顯示市場向好基礎進一步夯實，依然要關注外部不確定性對市場交易結構的階段性擾動。關注一：科技創新、自主可控與產業景氣的確定性趨勢，2026年一季度資料顯示，TMT與中游製造是修復的主攻方向，半導體、其他電子、通訊裝置、航海裝備、電池等板塊表現較優。關注二：修復動能向資源品和部分消費服務擴散，包括受益於PPI回升與漲價邏輯的有色金屬、基礎化工、石油石化等板塊，同時消費細分領域受益於景氣修復與政策支援。關注三：地緣衝突反覆博弈中的能源及替代性需求主題、防禦性板塊，關注煤炭、煤化工、新能源、金融、公用事業等。

【華燦光電：在AR眼鏡方向，公司單色顯示模組將於今年上半年實現小批次交貨】華燦光電4月30日在機構調研時表示，目前，公司正全力推進Micro LED業務研發和產業化落地。在AR眼鏡方向，公司單色顯示模組將於今年上半年實現小批次交貨，全綵顯示模組正按計劃推進研發。在Micro LED通訊應用方向，公司持續提升產品效能，目前已取得顯著提升，技術指標已接近客戶需求。同時，公司在積極與產業夥伴合作，加快產業化程序，並探索向Micro LED產業鏈下游延伸拓展。

【中信建投：一季報顯示A股業績改善但景氣分化明顯 行業配置思路仍聚焦景氣邏輯】中信建投指出，高景氣推動全球科技股共振大漲，投資者情緒進入高漲區，全球高景氣進一步鞏固科技作為當前市場核心主線的格局。美伊局勢再度緊張，短期擾動有限。一季報顯示A股業績改善但景氣分化明顯，行業配置思路仍聚焦景氣邏輯，重點關注：AI（半導體、光通訊、伺服器、電子布等）、油氣生產、煤化工、煤炭、新能源（鋰電、鈉電、風電、能源金屬）、軍工、食品飲料（非白酒）、美容護理。

Irish Services Sector Contracts for 1st Time in 5 Years — The AIB Ireland Services PMI dropped to 49.7 in April 2026 from 50.7 in March, marking the first contraction in activity since February 2021, as overall business activity declined marginally. New business was broadly unchanged, with firms citing economic uncertainty and higher costs linked to the Middle East war. Transport, tourism & leisure and financial services recorded declines, while technology, media & telecoms expanded strongly and business services rose modestly. New export orders fell for the first time since June 2025, and backlogs declined slightly amid softer demand. Employment rebounded after March’s fall, with most sectors hiring. Meanwhile, input cost inflation accelerated to its highest since December 2022, driven by fuel, freight, energy, and wage increases, pushing firms to lift charges at a two-year high pace. Sentiment remained positive but subdued, near a multi-year low, as geopolitical risks, rising costs, and interest rate concerns weighed on the outlook.

【“五一”節後百基齊發 公募基金積極佈局權益市場】“五一”小長假後，公募基金產品迎來新發小高峰，逾百隻新品扎堆開售。其中，權益類基金佔比超過七成，成為發行主力。一邊是公募新發如火如荼，一邊是次新基金“新子彈”快速打入市場，多家公募機構表示，關注A股節後的結構性機會。Choice資料顯示，5月共有129只新基金進入發售期（不同份額分開計算）。僅“五一”節後的首個交易日（5月6日）就有42只基金啟動發售，且涉及多家大型基金公司，包括易方達基金、廣發基金、中歐基金、博時基金、華安基金、永贏基金等，部分基金公司的新發產品數量達到4只。（上海證券報）

【天風證券：化工行業已經進入歷史底部區域，供給端在行業供需調整中權重加大】天風證券研報表示，化工行業新增產能進入釋放階段，2026年供需逆轉可期。化工行業已經進入歷史底部區域，供給端在行業供需調整中權重加大。“反內卷”短期內透過控制開工方式調整供需平衡促進價格回暖、盈利修復，而中長期關注關停低效產能的落實節奏，促進企業技術升級擺脫同質化競爭、加大研發創新投入轉向高附加值產品；透過政策端制度安排可加快產業週期修復節奏。供需逆轉：2025年政策、資本開支拐點已現；“反內卷”的提出提供了對後續行業盈利改善、長期走向更健康發展的預期。

【OpenAI總裁稱馬斯克希望獨佔OpenAI，以籌集800億美元用於火星計劃】OpenAI總裁格雷格·布羅克曼當地時間週二作證稱，馬斯克曾支援將這家人工智慧初創公司轉型為營利性企業，但希望取得完全控制權。布羅克曼表示，2017年馬斯克曾希望OpenAI改變其公司結構，因為作為一家非營利組織很難籌集到OpenAI構建高階人工智慧模型所需的資金。但馬斯克同時表示，如果這種情況發生，他希望成為OpenAI的領導者。“他說他需要800億美元才能在火星上建造一座城市，”布羅克曼說，“最終，他需要完全的控制權。”馬斯克還表示，何時放棄完全控制權將由他自己決定。這次會面最終不歡而散，馬斯克怒氣衝衝地離開。

【中金：成長風格仍有優勢 順週期行業有望受益於供需再平衡】中金指出，配置方面，成長風格仍有優勢，但今年與其他板塊的相對錶現有所收斂。中金認為成長行情的決定因素在於高景氣的產業趨勢和盈利兌現，其重要性往往超出宏觀、估值、資金等其它因素。經歷過去三年去產能週期，疊加“反內卷”等政策推進，越來越多的順週期行業有望受益於供需再平衡，關注：1）景氣成長：AI龍頭資本開支繼續高增長，仍建議重點關注基礎設施環節，如半導體、電子硬體、光通訊等。儲能電池、創新藥等領域也值得關注。2）週期改善：綜合考慮地緣局勢和油價中樞上升的可能，以及行業產能週期位置，建議關注供需格局支撐漲價的化工、能源金屬等，受益出海趨勢的電網裝置、工程機械等。

【天風證券五月配置策略：盯著勝率做交易】天風證券研報稱，價值風格處於“高賠率-低勝率-強趨勢-中擁擠”區間，而小盤風格處於“中等賠率-強趨勢-低擁擠”，風格配置建議“價值+小盤”。五月配置建議如下：大類：A股>轉債>十債>美股；風格：價值>成長，小盤>大盤；行業：汽車、化工、機械、銀行和電子。

【糧食與農業板塊正成為資金佈局的“確定性”方向】近日，在地緣局勢波動，疊加國際油價、化肥價格變化等多重外部因素共振下，糧食與農業板塊正成為資金佈局的“確定性”方向，主動權益基金在一季度加大配置力度，部分產品更轉向聚焦糧農主題。與此同時，多隻糧食、農業類ETF密集發行並獲得資金重點流入，成為非科技賽道中表現亮眼的新熱點。2026年4月以來，華夏基金、博時基金、易方達基金等機構相繼在糧農賽道推出新基金，形成扎堆發行熱潮。其中，華夏糧食ETF於4月24日成立，易方達糧食ETF也於4月21日至29日完成發售，博時糧食ETF則將於5月7日起正式發行。南方基金、廣發基金、鵬華基金等公司也陸續跟進，進一步豐富場內糧農主題產品線。行業分析指出，公募集中發力糧食ETF，主要源於該板塊在當前市場環境中具備較高的配置確定性，尤其在非科技類ETF中表現突出。相比食品飲料、傳統消費等賽道，糧食ETF收益率更具相對優勢，成為資金佈局的重要方向之一。

【4家AI“一人公司”同日領照】日前，北京躍墨科技有限公司、北京愛因賽廣告傳媒有限公司等4家人工智慧“一人公司”同日領取營業執照。北京市場監管領域推出“主題套餐服務”“一鍵點選”等創新舉措，服務“一人公司”快速啟航。 “一人公司”（簡稱OPC）多指依託AI技術，由單個創業者主導並藉助智慧工具完成產品全鏈路閉環的新型創業模式。隨著人工智慧技術加速普及，“一人公司”已成為創新創業的新正規化。北京市市場監督管理局精準適配新業態發展需求，打造整合智慧登記體系，為“超級個體”提供全週期、精細化登記服務。（北京日報）

【拒絕美國干涉，巴拿馬議員抵華交流】“我們是一個自由且擁有主權的國家……我們想去哪裡，就去哪裡。”正在中國訪問的巴拿馬民主革命黨議員哈伊羅·薩拉查4日在社交媒體上發表宣告稱，巴拿馬的主權“不容動搖”，並公開對美國外交代表試圖干涉巴拿馬內政的行徑表示質疑。 巴拿馬《星報》5日報道稱，由7名議員組成的巴拿馬代表團於3日抵達中國，此行是巴國會巴中議會友好小組交流活動。代表團負責人、巴拿馬人民黨議員帕齊·李表示，此行議員們將參觀華為和廣交會。 （環球時報）

【全球記憶體告急 蘋果下架多款高效能Mac裝置】5月6日，受全球記憶體短缺危機影響，蘋果線上商店下架了多款高效能Mac裝置。目前，配備32GB和64GB記憶體的Mac mini已無法直接購買，M4 Pro版本的記憶體上限被壓縮至48GB，且256GB固態硬碟版本也被移除，致使該系列起售價升至799美元。同時，Mac Studio系列M3 Ultra版的256GB記憶體選項已取消，目前最高僅提供96GB配置，部分型號送貨時間延長至9-10周。 庫克表示，蘋果低估了使用者本地執行AI工具的需求，預計未來幾個月供需失衡仍將持續。由於預計記憶體成本將顯著上升，蘋果透過削減高配選項以保障基礎型號供應。業內預測，受三星和SK海力士供應限制，記憶體超級週期有望延續至2027年，消費者購買高效能裝置的成本將維持高位。（快科技）

Gold Extends Gains for a Second Session — Gold climbed toward $4,600 an ounce on Wednesday, advancing for a second straight session as signs of de-escalation in the Middle East pushed oil prices lower, helping to alleviate inflation concerns. Defense Secretary Hegseth said the ceasefire established nearly a month ago remains intact, while Secretary of State Rubio confirmed that offensive operations have ended as Washington pivots toward safeguarding shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump also announced a temporary pause in a US-led effort to assist stranded vessels in exiting the strait, allowing time to gauge whether a deal with Iran to end the conflict can be reached, although the blockade on ships traveling to and from Iranian ports will stay in place. Gold has faced significant selling pressure since the onset of the war, as soaring energy costs fueled inflation fears and reinforced expectations that central banks may keep interest rates elevated for longer or potentially tighten further.

【以媒：特朗普近日一度考慮恢復空襲伊朗】據以色列第12頻道電視臺5日以美國高階官員為訊息源報道，就是否恢復對伊朗空襲，美總統特朗普近日立場反覆變化，但暫時按兵不動，以便談判繼續。報道說，特朗普1日一度要下令再次發動空襲，但伊朗當天經由巴基斯坦提交最新談判方案後，他在最後一刻改變了主意，儘管他對這一方案表示“不滿意”。作為替代，特朗普選擇啟動“疏導”霍爾木茲海峽的“自由計劃”行動，同時給外交程序更多時間。報道稱，儘管美政府官員強調，特朗普目前仍傾向於窮盡談判手段，但一些“來自白宮以外的顧問”正向特朗普施壓，要求恢復空襲。一些美國官員警告，如果特朗普接下來幾天相信談判已經進入死衚衕，將下令對伊朗發動一輪“短促而猛烈”的軍事打擊，以打破僵局，迫使伊朗就範。美政府官員告訴第12頻道電視臺，包括總統特使威特科夫、女婿庫什納在內的一些身邊人告訴特朗普，與伊朗的談判正在取得進展，分歧在縮小，但同時強調，即便能與伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊達成協議，也不確定伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊是否會接受。據伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社5日報道，伊朗總統辦公室主任哈吉·米爾薩伊就有關總統佩澤希齊揚與伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊指揮官存在分歧的傳聞作出回應，明確予以否認。(新華社)

Australia Manufacturing Stays in Contraction — Australia’s Ai Group Industry Index for manufacturing edged up 0.7 points to -27.9 in April 2026, still deep in contraction as cost and demand pressures persisted. Fixed-price contracts limited firms’ ability to pass on rising input costs, while export disruptions, cautious ordering, and shipment delays drove production cutbacks. Upstream, chemicals saw a moderated decline as demand was brought forward, but other segments struggled with weak confidence, supply disruptions, and rising energy costs. Minerals and metals fell to a record low, hit by softer exports, delayed orders, raw material shortages, and skilled labour constraints. Downstream conditions were uneven: some machinery and equipment makers reported steady demand, but others flagged rising raw material and fuel costs alongside customer uncertainty. Food and beverage producers faced higher input, packaging, and transport costs, with limited pricing power squeezing margins further.

【亞市早盤金價上漲 特朗普暫停“自由專案”以觀望伊朗協議能否最終敲定】在積極的投資者情緒下，金價在早盤交易中上漲。現貨黃金上漲0.6%，報每盎司4,584.89美元。美國總統特朗普在Truth Social上發帖稱，他已同意暫停“自由專案”，這是本屆政府旨在促進商船透過霍爾木茲海峽的倡議。特朗普說：“在與伊朗代表達成全面最終協議方面已經取得了巨大進展。”FOREX.com市場分析師Fawad Razaqzada在一封電子郵件中表示，黃金正越來越多地被視為一種風險敏感型資產。

【孟外長訪華，孟媒列出優先議題】應中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅邀請，孟加拉國外交部長卡利勒於5月5日至7日訪問中國。據孟加拉國《每日太陽報》5日報道，訪問期間，卡利勒將與中國外長舉行雙邊會談，預計兩位外長將就雙方共同關心的問題進行全面探討，並就當前地區及全球局勢交換意見。 土耳其阿納多盧通訊社在報道中提到，中國連續15年保持孟加拉國最大貿易伙伴地位，2024年，中孟雙邊貿易額240.5億美元。2025年，兩國建交50週年。 孟加拉國《金融快報》稱，孟加拉國官員認為，卡利勒外長此次北京之行，可能成為雙方進行積極接觸的重要渠道，雙方已列出此次會談的優先重點議題。 報道稱，孟加拉國方面預計將推動蒙格拉港現代化建設、擴大菠蘿蜜等農產品出口，以及開通廣州—吉大港和上海—吉大港的直飛航線。其他可能涉及的議題還包括經濟區開發等。 《金融快報》稱，作為孟加拉國最大的發展夥伴之一，中方預計將重點強調進一步深化共建“一帶一路”倡議框架下的廣泛交流與合作。（環球時報）
【“五一”廣東迎客超4700萬人次，實現旅遊收入近300億元】從廣東省文化和旅遊廳獲悉，2026年“五一”假期五天（5月1日-5月5日），全省接待遊客4706.9萬人次，同比增長2.1%；實現旅遊收入297.7億元，同比增長0.9%。（南方財經）
【深圳24個重點商圈客流同比增兩成 總營業額同比增17.42%】今年“五一”假期，深圳各大商圈人氣旺盛，新業態新場景帶來假日新體驗新玩法，消費市場呈現一派繁榮活躍景象。記者5月5日從深圳市商務局獲悉，5天假期，全市監測的24個重點商圈總客流量同比增長20.97%、總營業額同比增長17.42%，“假日經濟”成色十足。（深圳特區報）
【日本經濟產業大臣：與沙烏地阿拉伯和阿聯酋就確保原油穩定供應達成合作協議】日本經濟產業大臣赤澤亮正宣佈，日本已與沙烏地阿拉伯和阿拉伯聯合大公國（阿聯酋）達成合作協議，以確保原油供應穩定。赤澤亮正於4月4日至5日訪問了沙烏地阿拉伯和阿聯酋，並會見了兩國的相關部長。
【先正達考慮2026年下半年在香港IPO 估值可能達到500億美元】德國商報(Handelsblatt)援引訊息人士的話報道，總部位於瑞士的種子和農用化學品公司先正達計劃於9月或10月在香港交易所上市。報道稱，這家由中國國有企業中化控股的公司估值可能達到500億美元。

Australia Construction Index Surges But Stays in Contraction — The Ai Group Industry Index for Australia’s construction sector jumped 37.8 points to -19.3 in April 2026, indicating a sharp improvement in conditions, though the sector remained in contraction. Firms continued to report steady underlying demand, but activity was constrained by rising input and labour costs. Builders also noted a limited appetite for risk, which weighed on new project commitments. At the same time, labour shortages persisted, as skilled trades were increasingly sought after across multiple sectors, adding further pressure on project timelines and costs.

【魯比奧：“史詩怒火”已結束 不允許伊朗控制海峽“常態化”】美國國務卿魯比奧5日下午在白宮主持記者會，稱美國進攻伊朗的“史詩怒火”軍事行動已結束，同時強調美國絕不允許伊朗對霍爾木茲海峽的控制“常態化”。魯比奧確認，美國今年2月底對伊朗發動的“史詩怒火”軍事行動已經結束，“正如總統通知國會所說，我們已完成了這一階段的任務”，現在進入“自由計劃”行動階段。他稱這一由美軍“疏導”霍爾木茲海峽被困船隻的計劃是一項“防禦性”行動。（新華社）

【高景氣驅動全球科技股共振 機構：5月A股科技主線有望延續】“五一”小長假期間，海外市場整體執行平穩。在北美雲廠商資本開支繼續擴張，及全球儲存晶片龍頭業績全面超預期的提振下，與科技板塊關聯度較高的納斯達克指數、韓國綜合指數領漲全球大類資產。展望節後市場，券商策略研報認為，5月A股大機率延續震盪偏強的執行格局：一方面，海外科技股業績超預期，產業趨勢密集催化；另一方面，一季報顯示A股業績整體改善但景氣度分化，AI產業鏈和資源能源板塊仍是景氣度高企的兩大方向。後續，科技成長有望繼續鞏固市場核心主線的地位。（上海證券報）

【500餘家醫藥生物上市公司披露一季報，近八成實現盈利】2026年一季度，國產創新藥商業化落地提速、海外授權交易密集兌現，帶動多家上市藥企業績攀升。據記者不完全統計，截至4月30日，已有500餘家醫藥生物上市公司披露2026年一季報，近八成實現盈利。記者注意到，創新藥需求紅利沿產業鏈傳導，賦能CXO、生物材料等上下游賽道景氣度持續走高。同時，國內藥企透過戰略轉型、加碼研發、積極出海，持續夯實創新核心。多位醫藥行業專家對記者表示，憑藉技術、成本及產業化多重優勢，國產創新藥出海勢頭強勁、產業鏈韌性十足，有望為行業高質量發展開啟新空間。（上海證券報）

【Anthropic承諾斥資2,000億美元購買谷歌雲服務和晶片】據媒體援引一位知情人士的話報道，Anthropic已承諾未來五年內在谷歌雲(Google Cloud)服務上支出2,000億美元，這是雙方近期協議的部分內容。這一承諾表明，這家人工智慧初創公司佔谷歌上週向投資者披露的未實現收入的40%以上。受此訊息影響，谷歌母公司Alphabet 的股價週二在盤後交易中上漲約2%。Anthropic 於 4 月與谷歌及其晶片合作伙伴博通簽署了一項協議，將獲得數吉瓦的張量處理單元（TPU）算力，預計將於 2027 年開始投入使用。Alphabet還計劃向Anthropic投資高達400億美元，以深化合作關係。報道稱，涉及Anthropic和OpenAI的合同目前佔亞馬遜AWS、微軟Azure和谷歌雲等主要雲服務提供商2萬億美元訂單的一半以上。 在人工智慧領域的投入以及蓬勃發展的雲業務推動下，Alphabet股價錄得創紀錄漲勢，有望超越英偉達，成為全球市值最高的公司。

【油價延續跌勢 特朗普稱伊朗談判取得“很大進展”】油價連續第二天下跌，美國總統唐納德·特朗普表示，在結束與伊朗戰爭的最終協議方面取得了“很大進展”。WTI原油期貨跌破每桶100美元，週二跌3.9%；布倫特原油期貨收於每桶110美元附近。特朗普在Truth Social發帖表示，美國推動船隻透過霍爾木茲海峽的行動將暫停，但海上封鎖將繼續實施。自2月底衝突爆發以來，布倫特原油價格已上漲超過50%，數億桶波斯灣石油無法進入全球市場。目前，海峽被雙重封鎖，阻礙了這一咽喉要道的石油運輸，德黑蘭方面阻撓航運，而美國則阻止船隻進出伊朗港口。早些時候，美國國務卿馬爾科·盧比奧在白宮告訴記者，“史詩狂怒行動”已經結束，距離美國和以色列開始轟炸伊朗已過去66天。他說：“我們實現了行動的目標。”

Brent Declines as US Winds Down Iran Offensive — Brent crude futures dropped below $108 per barrel on Wednesday, declining for the second straight session after US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that “Operation Epic Fury is concluded,” noting that its objectives had been met. President Donald Trump also said the US would temporarily pause its effort to assist stranded vessels in exiting the Strait of Hormuz, allowing time to assess whether a potential agreement with Iran to end the conflict could be reached. However, the US blockade on ships traveling to and from Iranian ports will remain in place. Washington is now turning its attention to reopening the strait, facing mounting pressure from other nations and growing domestic opposition to the war. These developments unfold against a backdrop of continued deadlock between the US and Iran, with little headway toward renewed negotiations, as Tehran maintains that any talks hinge on the removal of the US naval blockade.

【上海電氣參研兆瓦級航空高速渦輪發電機系統試驗成功】近日，由中國航發湖南動力機械研究所主持研製的兆瓦級航空混合動力系統試驗成功。該系統中的高速發電機系統由上海電氣電站集團、南京航空航天大學無錫研究院、自動化學院（簡稱“南航無錫院”）與動研所聯合研製，成功完成兆瓦級混合動力系統地面效能試驗，標誌著我國在大功率高速航空發電機系統工程化應用方面取得重要突破，填補了大功率高速航空發電機系統工程化應用空白。目前，上海電氣已形成覆蓋350kW至1MW的航空高速發電機全譜系產品矩陣，其中350kW系列產品正在穩步開發。該系列發電機產品可適配不同功率等級的航空混合動力系統，廣泛應用於混合電推進航空器、電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）及通用航空等領域，為低空經濟發展提供核心裝備支撐。

【G7擬設常設機構統籌關鍵礦產供應】據報道，五位訊息人士透露，七國集團（G7）國家正在商討設立一個常設秘書處，以確保旨在增加關鍵礦產供應的倡議不會因G7輪值主席國更替而中斷。美國和歐盟上月同意在鋰、鈷和稀土等關鍵礦產方面深化協調。但其中兩位訊息人士透露，歐洲方面拒絕了建立單一共享儲備的想法，更傾向於由各國分別掌控自身儲備。訊息人士還稱，歐洲各國政府也不希望由美國主導該專案，因為他們擔心在危機情況下，關鍵礦產的獲取可能會受到限制。自今年年初以來，歐盟一直在推進自身的關鍵礦產試點儲備專案，該專案由義大利、法國和德國牽頭。這些訊息人士因未獲授權公開討論此事而要求匿名。他們表示秘書處可能設在國際能源署（IEA）或經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)。這兩個機構均位於巴黎。

Oil Declines as US Winds Down Iran Offensive — WTI crude futures dropped to about $100 per barrel on Wednesday, declining for the second straight session after US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that “Operation Epic Fury is concluded,” noting that its objectives had been met. President Donald Trump also said the US would temporarily pause its effort to assist stranded vessels in exiting the Strait of Hormuz, allowing time to assess whether a potential agreement with Iran to end the conflict could be reached. However, the US blockade on ships traveling to and from Iranian ports will remain in place. Washington is now turning its attention to reopening the strait, facing mounting pressure from other nations and growing domestic opposition to the war. These developments unfold against a backdrop of continued deadlock between the US and Iran, with little headway toward renewed negotiations, as Tehran maintains that any talks hinge on the removal of the US naval blockade.
英國航運媒體《勞埃德船舶日報》5日報道說，霍爾木茲海峽仍處於事實上關閉狀態，被困船隻對美國的“自由計劃”並不信任。（央視）

【白宮記者協會晚宴嫌犯被控襲擊特工】美國聯邦檢察官週二對被控企圖暗殺總統特朗普的男子追加了一項指控，稱他上個月在華盛頓一場新聞界晚宴外衝闖安檢站時，用霰彈槍擊中了一名特勤局特工。這份由華盛頓一個大陪審團提交的起訴書，在針對科爾·艾倫(Cole Allen)的刑事案件中增加了第四項指控。根據一份刑事訴狀，31歲的艾倫此前在華盛頓希爾頓酒店被捕後，已被控企圖暗殺特朗普以及兩項槍支犯罪，其中包括在暴力犯罪期間開槍。代理司法部長託德.布蘭奇(Todd Blanche)是出席白宮記者協會晚宴的特朗普政府官員之一。他表示，艾倫當時全副武裝，“衝闖安保防線並開槍擊中了一名特勤局特工，企圖暗殺總統特朗普，但由於執法人員勇敢而迅速的反應，他被制止了。”布蘭奇在週二的一份宣告中補充道：“在總統特朗普的領導下，暴力的政治行動者永遠不會獲勝，我們將依法在最大程度上起訴任何參與這些可怕行為的人。”此前，對於擊中參與晚宴安保工作的那名特勤局特工的子彈是否為艾倫所發，外界最初存在一些疑慮。
【新股提示：維通利、嘉晨智慧今日申購】今日可申購維通利和北交所個股嘉晨智慧，維通利發行總數約6233萬股，網上發行約為2045萬股，發行市盈率25.36倍，申購程式碼為：001393，申購價格：30.38元，單一賬戶申購上限2萬股，申購數量500股整數倍。嘉晨智慧發行總數約1800萬股，發行市盈率14.99倍，申購程式碼為：920096，申購價格：14.43元。

【美國食品藥品監督管理局（FDA）批准了首批水果口味的電子煙】美國食品和藥物管理局（FDA）面臨日益增大的政治壓力之際，該機構週二批准了水果味電子煙的上市銷售，這是該機構首次批准非菸草口味的電子煙產品。FDA表示，獲批的產品來自總部位於洛杉磯的Glas公司——這是一家利用技術對裝置進行年齡驗證的小型電子煙製造商，其獲批的煙彈口味包括經典薄荷、清新薄荷、黃金和藍寶石等。該監管機構表示：“FDA對這些產品進行了嚴格、科學的審查，發現申請人充分證明，Glas的裝置訪問限制技術結合FDA要求的營銷限制，有望有效降低青少年使用該產品的可能性。”當天早些時候，媒體報道稱，唐納德·特朗普總統上週末批評了FDA局長馬卡里（Marty Makary），指責其批准調味電子煙和尼古丁產品的速度不夠快。

Australian Industry Conditions Improve — Australia’s Industry Index rose by 9.8 points to -24.4 in April 2026, signaling some stabilisation but still pointing to a deep contraction in industrial conditions. Key components improved modestly: activity and sales, as well as employment, each gained 4.5 points to -31.2 and -25.2, respectively, while new orders climbed 7.7 points to -24.8. Input volumes also picked up, rising 6.6 points to -5.5, suggesting a tentative recovery in demand. Yet cost pressures surged: the prices index jumped 13.5 points to 69.3 as fuel levies filtered through supply chains, pushing selling prices up 10.1 points to 23.1 and wages 2.1 points higher to 36.2. Capacity utilisation rebounded to 77.7% after earlier declines. Despite these gains, firms remain constrained by skilled labour shortages, elevated energy costs, lingering supply disruptions, and intensifying competition from online and overseas suppliers, underscoring structural headwinds even as headline conditions show modest improvement.

【韓國4月通脹創21個月新高】韓國4月整體通脹率攀升至21個月高位，凸顯中東局勢緊張與油價走高帶來的影響正持續加深。韓國統計部週三公佈資料，4月居民消費價格指數同比上漲2.6%，創2024年7月以來最大漲幅，3月該指數同比漲幅為2.2%。此次公佈的通脹資料，與媒體調查的11位經濟學家預期中值完全一致。環比來看，4月居民消費價格上漲0.5%，同樣符合市場預期；3月環比漲幅為0.3%。剔除波動較大的食品和能源價格後，4月核心CPI同比上漲2.2%，環比上漲0.3%。4月成品油價格大幅飆升，全球能源成本上漲的傳導效應凸顯。柴油價格同比暴漲31%，環比上漲8.1%；汽油價格同比上漲21%，環比上漲8.7%。韓國是能源進口大國，石油、天然氣及主要工業大宗商品高度依賴中東供應。

【2025年保險資管公司營收淨利顯著增長 資管規模超萬億元機構數量增至11家】絕大部分保險資管公司2025年年報如期披露，行業整體營收及盈利延續穩健較快增長態勢。截至4月底，除中英益利資管以及2025年12月開業的友邦保險資管、荷全保險資管外，其他35家保險資管機構（含1家養老險公司）均已釋出了2025年年報，合計實現營業收入484.45億元，同比增長14.9%；合計淨利潤218.64億元，同比增18.3%。這35家機構平均淨資產收益率（ROE）達18.5%。多家保險資管機構資管規模、管理費收入及利潤額均創下新高。行業馬太效應凸顯，頭部機構發展增速領跑行業，資管規模超萬億元的保險資管機構數量由8家增至11家。

【Meta計劃為使用者推出先進的“代理式”AI助手】據英國《金融時報》報道，Meta 正致力於開發一款高度個性化的人工智慧助手，以協助其數十億使用者處理日常事務。此前，該公司因不斷攀升的人工智慧支出而面臨投資者的密切關注。報道援引知情人士的話稱，這家社交媒體巨頭正在開發代理工具，其中包括一款由其新推出的Muse Spark人工智慧模型驅動的高階數字助手。報道稱，該助手目前正由一小部分員工進行內部測試，其目標是開發一款類似於OpenClaw的產品。OpenClaw由OpenAI 擁有 ， 它 能夠 連線多種軟硬體工具， 並從生成的資料中學習， 所需的人工干預遠少於聊天機器人。此外，另有媒體報道稱，Meta正在訓練一個代號為“Hatch”的內部AI代理，其靈感源自OpenClaw，計劃於6月底前完成內部測試。

NZX 50 Nears 4-Week High After Jobs Data — The NZX 50 climbed 86 points, or 0.7%, to 13,126 in Wednesday morning trade, halting losses from the previous session after the unemployment rate unexpectedly declined in Q1 2026. The latest data showed New Zealand's unemployment rate inched down to 5.3% in Q1, lower than both the previous quarter and market expectations of 5.4%, which had been the highest level since Q2 2015. The broader index hit its highest level since April 10, mainly buoyed by financials and consumer staples. Meanwhile, a statement from RBNZ Governor Anna Breman in the Financial Stability Report, noting that the country's financial system is resilient and well-positioned to support households and businesses, also lifted sentiment. The index tracked Wall Street, which closed in the green overnight, supported by solid earnings reports and lower energy prices. Among the top performers were Infratil (9.0%), A2 Milk (1.4%), Mercury NZ (0.6%), Gentrack Group (0.5%), and ANZ Group (0.4%).

【英媒：被困船隻對美國“自由計劃”不信任 】英國航運媒體《勞埃德船舶日報》5日報道說，霍爾木茲海峽仍處於事實上關閉狀態，被困船隻對美國的“自由計劃”並不信任。美軍4日啟動名為“自由計劃”的疏導行動，表示將“引導”被困在霍爾木茲海峽的船隻駛離該海峽。美國國防部長赫格塞思5日稱，美軍已在霍爾木茲海峽上空形成一個保護“穹頂”，來自世界各國的“數以百計”船隻正等待透過海峽。然而，《勞埃德船舶日報》援引保險公司和被困船隻船東的看法報道，美方宣告與霍爾木茲海峽的實際安全狀況並不相符。美國主導的“自由計劃”並未提供足夠的清晰度或足夠可信的保障，不足以證明霍爾木茲海峽能夠恢復通行。船東的主要關切是一旦伊朗襲擊船隻，美國是否會進行干預。（新華社）

【上證報評論：既要芯之光，又要茅臺香，理性看待“股王之變”】近期，以茅臺為代表的傳統消費龍頭與以寒武紀、源傑科技為代表的硬科技新貴，股價交替登頂，在A股市場交相輝映。表面看，這是兩大賽道龍頭企業市值、股價的席位更迭；深層看，這或許是資本市場投資邏輯之變，是中國經濟向創新驅動轉型的生動縮影。許多硬科技企業從“技術替代”到“業績兌現”，A股市場“科技主線+價值壓艙”估值生態初步確立。當下時點，理性、全面、正確看待“股王之變”十分必要。硬核科技和強大內需是中國經濟高質量發展的核心雙驅。“芯之光”與“茅臺香”並非非此即彼，而是辯證統一。兩大驅動，缺一不可，應協同發力、共生共榮。

【伊朗：阿聯酋正與美國和以色列合作對抗德黑蘭】伊朗外交部發布宣告稱，“阿布扎比當局採取了不恰當的做法，違反了睦鄰原則和《聯合國憲章》的基本準則，明顯與美國這一侵略方合作，威脅伊朗的安全和國家利益。”伊朗外交部否認阿布扎比有關導彈和無人機從伊朗發射、針對阿聯酋的說法。宣告還表示，現階段武裝部隊的行動僅旨在遏制“美國侵略”。伊朗警告美國和以色列，這一局勢將對地區和平與穩定帶來危險後果。
【“洪迪厄斯”號郵輪將在西班牙加那利群島靠岸】世界衛生組織與西班牙衛生部當地時間5月5日晚達成最終協議，確認此前在大西洋海域暴發漢坦病毒疫情的“洪迪厄斯”號郵輪將在西班牙加那利群島進行靠岸。目前，西班牙政府已批准該船進入其領海，並將在嚴格的衛生監測下展開人員下船及轉運工作。（央視新聞）

【訊息人士：美國商船在穿越霍爾木茲海峽期間，船上配有軍事安保人員】據兩名美國官員透露，週一，兩艘美國商船在穿越霍爾木茲海峽時遭到伊朗襲擊，船上配備了美國軍事安全小組。五角大樓稱，伊朗使用導彈、無人機和武裝小艇襲擊了這兩艘商船，但美軍攔截了襲擊並炸燬了這些小艇。這是首次有報道稱，美國軍事安全人員隨船穿越霍爾木茲海峽。這是特朗普為打通這條關鍵通道而發起的“自由計劃”的一部分，該計劃旨在引導船隻突破伊朗對該海峽的封鎖。此次行動使美軍在衝突中陷入新的困境，也增加了美軍遭受伊朗侵略的風險。（NBC）
【Sentinel Midstream 批准得美國克州深水石油出口港專案】石油運輸與儲存公司Sentinel Midstream表示，該公司正推進其位於美國得克薩斯州海岸附近的深水石油出口專案的建設。Sentinel認為，該專案一旦投入運營，預計將支撐每年價值數十億美元的出口額。

Uruguay Inflation Accelerates in April — Uruguay’s annual inflation rose to 3.2% in April 2026 from 2.9% in the previous month. The strongest price increases were seen in education (7.1%), restaurants and lodging (7.1%), personal care and social security (5.3%), utilities (4.5%), information and communication (3.7%), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (3.4%), and insurance and financial services (3.2%), while prices fell for clothing and footwear (-4.7%). On a monthly basis, inflation picked up to 0.54% from 0.41% in March.

【5月6日美股成交額前20：英特爾大漲約13%，多家機構上調其目標價】週二美股成交額第4名英特爾收高12.95%，成交203.4億美元。英特爾2026第一財季業績超預期，多家華爾街機構上調目標價。公司2026年第一季度財報顯示，資料中心與人工智慧（DCAI）部門營收同比增長22%，AI相關業務已佔總營收的60%。同時，公司已上調PC及伺服器CPU價格，行業供需緊張可能延續至2027年，市場對其盈利修復的確定性預期增強 。多家華爾街機構在財報後上調了英特爾的目標價。機構普遍認為，AI需求增長、地緣政治優勢（作為美國領先晶片製造商）以及管理層執行力的改善是推動公司價值重估的關鍵 。

Uruguay Jobless Rate Rises in March — Uruguay’s unemployment rate rose to 7.8% in March 2026 from 7.4% in February, marking the highest level since May 2025. Joblessness was slightly higher in Montevideo at 8.0% than in the rest of the country at 7.6%. By gender, the unemployment rate stood at 9.3% for women and 6.4% for men, while youth unemployment remained elevated at 25.9% and was lowest among workers aged 65 and over at 2.9%. Among those employed, 9.4% were underemployed and 22% were not registered with social security in their main job. Meanwhile, the labor force participation rate edged down to 64.3% from 64.6%, and the employment rate declined to 59.3% from 59.8% in February.

S&P 500 & Nasdaq Hit New Records — US equities climbed to new highs on Tuesday, buoyed by a retreat in energy prices that eased concerns about a sharper uptick in inflation this year. The S&P 500 gained 0.8% and the Nasdaq advanced 1.2%, both reaching record levels, while the Dow closed up 0.8%. Oil and product prices eased after Defense Secretary Hegseth stated that the ceasefire with Iran is still holding, despite attacks targeting the UAE this week. High energy costs had already driven bets of a Fed hike this year. The JOLTS reflected a robust labor market in March and strong ISM results, including surging prices, aligned with arguments from hawkish Fed dissenters. Intel surged 14% on reports that it may produce processors for Apple devices. Amazon also gained on fresh additions of logistics and distribution. In turn, Palantir dropped 7% after missing the market's ambitious guidance estimates, and AMD sank ahead of its results after the bell.

【蘋果據悉將允許使用者選用多款第三方人工智慧服務】蘋果公司將允許使用者從一系列外部人工智慧服務中進行選擇，為其軟體各項功能提供支援。此舉旨在推進將旗下裝置打造為綜合性AI平臺的戰略。知情人士表示，使用者將能夠在多個第三方AI模型中進行選擇，用於生成和編輯文字及影象等任務。這項變化預計將於今年秋季隨iOS 27、iPadOS 27 和macOS 27上線。彭博新聞社3月報道稱，蘋果計劃向外部人工智慧助手開放Siri，此舉旨在強化iPhone作為人工智慧平臺的地位。在2024年推出的Apple 智慧平臺目前在Siri、“寫作工具”和“圖樂園”等功能中僅提供ChatGPT這一種第三方選項。這都是蘋果力求在人工智慧市場佔據優勢的一環，但路徑有所不同。該公司並非僅依靠自研最佳AI軟體和服務，而是致力於讓使用者能夠在其裝置上便捷獲取多種選擇。

【歐洲央行管委Villeroy：未看到油價產生足以促使加息的影響】歐洲央行即將卸任的管理委員會成員Francois Villeroy de Galhau表示，該行尚未看到油價上漲對通脹產生足以促使其加息的影響。“如果我們看到這樣的第二輪效應，我們將採取行動並加息，以防止通脹變得廣泛且持久，”他週二對法國第五電視臺說。“目前，我們沒有看到足夠跡象表明這種傳導正在發生。”在宣佈將於5月底退休後，Villeroy將不會參加下一次政策會議。他的任期原定於明年結束。

【美國SEC新提案出爐 計劃允許企業將財報披露頻率改為每半年一次】美國證券交易委員會(SEC)釋出一項提議，允許美國公司選擇每半年而非每季度披露財報，此舉可能減少上市公司向投資者公開的資訊量。為了提高透明度，過去半個多世紀，SEC要求上市公司每季度提交財報。若該提議獲透過，將取消對上市公司強制季度披露的要求，但企業仍可選擇繼續每三個月釋出業績公告和業績展望。SEC主席保羅·阿特金斯在宣告中表示：“如果最終採納，週二提出的修訂將為公司提供更大的監管靈活性。”

【谷歌首席科學家稱歐盟資料措施給使用者帶來隱私風險】谷歌一位頂級科學家週二向歐盟反壟斷監管機構發出警告，稱其要求該公司與OpenAI等競爭對手共享搜尋引擎資料的提案，可能導致使用者隱私資訊洩露。這是圍繞谷歌這一利潤豐厚商業模式的博弈中，迄今為止最嚴厲的抨擊。作為歐盟競爭事務執法機構的歐盟委員會，近年來透過一系列立法對科技巨頭展開整頓，旨在確保使用者擁有更多選擇，併為小型競爭對手創造競爭空間，但此舉卻引發了美國政府的強烈不滿。自2012年起擔任谷歌傑出科學家、並被視為該領域領軍人物的謝爾蓋·瓦西爾維茨基，將於週三會見歐盟反壟斷官員，表達其擔憂並提議採取具有更完善保障措施的更廣泛方案。

Tin Holds Gains on Tight Supply — Tin futures in the UK were around $49,500 per tonne in May, holding the rebound from the previous month to trade over 20% higher year-to-date on persistent risks to supply and speculative bets on demand. Major producer Indonesia doubled down on threats against the illegal mining of tin and seixed 500 tonnes of metal connected to sources without licences. The move consolidated the pledge from Jakarta that it would crack down on mining activity that lack licensing after President Subianto ordered the closure of 1,000 illegal mines in Sumatra, tightening the outlook on supply from the key exporter. Elsewhere, operations in Myanmar's Man Maw mine remained slow since being closed for a resource audit in 2023. Meanwhile, tin's utility in datacenters drove Asian traders to pile on futures contracts for speculative positions on AI technology following the crowded developments in silver, although trading halts by the SHFE limited the rally.

Lumber Futures Remain Below $600 — Lumber futures have been trading below $600 per thousand board feet since early April, as weaker consumer sentiment and uncertainty surrounding developments in the Middle East weigh on demand. At the same time, supply constraints in several regions have partially offset the decline in demand. Profitability for Canadian mills remains under pressure from elevated duties and tariffs. The US has recently outlined preliminary antidumping and countervailing duties on Canadian softwood lumber, with the antidumping rate reduced from 20.6% to 10.7% and the countervailing duty trimmed from 14.6% to 14.2%, bringing the combined rate to about 25.9%. Including an existing 10% Section 232 tariff, total effective duties on Canadian imports are expected to remain near 35.9% once they take effect in August. Despite these measures aimed at supporting domestic producers, US sawmill utilisation remains relatively weak at around 64%, with capacity use trending lower since 2017.

European Stocks Rebound — European stocks closed sharply higher on Tuesday, benefiting from some respite in global energy prices and a batch of optimistic corporate earnings. The Eurozone's STOXX 50 rose 1.8% to 5,870 and the pan-European STOXX 600 advanced 0.7%. Heavyweight industrials surged amid the pullback in oil and natural gas prices that Europe imports, with Siemens, Schneider, and Siemens Energy jumping between 5% and 3%. The war in Iran did not escalate to more aggressive striking following brief attacks from the US and Iran yesterday. Meanwhile, AB InBev surged close to 10% after beating estimates for its first-quarter earnings and recording the first growth in sales in around three years. UniCredit soared close to 7% after posting higher profits, raising its full-year outlook, and launching its bid to raise its stake in Commerzbank. Also, Rheinmetall jumped 3.3% after reporting a 7.7% increase in earnings.

DXY Little Changed on Tuesday — The dollar index traded little changed at 98.4 on Tuesday, pausing the gains recorded over the previous two sessions as tensions between the US and Iran showed signs of easing. This follows an intense day on Monday, when both countries exchanged fire and the UAE became involved. A ceasefire now appears to be holding, and US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said two US commercial vessels transited safely through the Strait of Hormuz with military support, offering some reassurance. Still, the situation remains fragile. On the policy front, the Fed is widely expected to keep the federal funds rate unchanged through the rest of the year, with markets pricing in roughly a 50% chance of a quarter-point hike in early 2027. The dollar weakened against the euro, the pound, and the Australian dollar after the Reserve Bank of Australia raised borrowing costs for a third consecutive meeting. In contrast, the greenback gained against the yen amid suspected intervention by Japanese authorities.

Meanwhile, price growth slowed for some CPI categories, including transportation (2.2% vs 2.8%) and furnishings and household equipment (4.5% vs. 4.8%). On a monthly basis, the CPI rose by 1.1% in April, after a 1% increase in the prior month.

Colombian Exports Jump in March — Colombia’s exports rose 20.9% year-on-year to $5.32 billion in March 2026, accelerating from an 11.4% increase in February. The growth was mainly driven by a 149.2% surge in “other sectors,” largely reflecting higher shipments of non-monetary gold. Exports of fuels and extractive industries increased 24.8%, supported by a 107.7% jump in coal, coke, and briquettes. Manufacturing exports rose 6.9%, led by stronger sales of machinery, transport equipment, and chemicals. In contrast, exports of agricultural products, food, and beverages fell 6.8%, while crude oil shipments declined 17.7%.

US Natgas Prices Fall on Lower LNG Flows — US natural gas futures fell below $2.8 per MMBtu as supply increased in the domestic market, while exports declined. Pipeline flows to LNG export terminals dropped to the lowest level since late January due to routine spring maintenance, which temporarily reduces export capacity and leaves more gas in the US. Looking ahead, a gradual increase in cooling demand is expected as summer approaches. On the supply side, low prices have encouraged producers to reduce output. Companies such as EQT Corporation have scaled back drilling or temporarily curtailed production to avoid selling at weak prices. Still, storage remains about 7% above the seasonal average.

Traders continue to monitor developments in the Middle East, where a ceasefire appears to be holding after the US and Iran exchanged fire, with the UAE also becoming involved. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth added that two US commercial vessels transited safely through the Strait of Hormuz with military support, providing some temporary relief over concerns about further escalation. Market participants also digested fresh economic data. The ISM Services PMI indicated a slowdown in services activity, while job openings came in slightly above expectations. Meanwhile, the US Treasury said on Monday it now expects to borrow $189 billion in the second quarter, $79 billion more than projected in February.

Rice Futures at Over 7-Month High — Rice futures rose toward $11.7 per hundredweight, the highest since mid-September 2025, amid rising risks to the global supply. Global rice supplies are expected to decline this year as farmers across Asia reduce planting due to fertilizer shortages and higher fuel costs linked to the Iran war. Major exporting countries Thailand and Vietnam are among the hardest hit, as well as the Philippines and Indonesia, which rely on imports. At the same time, the emergence of El Niño is expected to bring hotter and drier conditions to the region in the second half of the year, potentially further curbing production of the world’s most widely consumed staple.

TTF Prices Fall from 4-Week Low — European natural gas futures dropped more than 2% to around €47 per megawatt hour, easing from a four-week high after the US downplayed the risk of a renewed conflict with Iran following recent clashes in the Strait of Hormuz and missile strikes on the United Arab Emirates. US officials said the incidents did not breach the ceasefire in place for nearly a month, helping calm market fears. The standoff between Washington and Tehran continues with little progress toward new talks, as Iran calls for the removal of a naval blockade while the US maintains pressure on its oil exports. Since the conflict began in late February, LNG flows from the Persian Gulf have largely stalled, disrupting about one-fifth of global supply and raising concerns in Europe as it seeks to rebuild gas inventories ahead of winter. Prices have risen about 40% since the war began, but have recently eased as some Asian demand softened.

【湖南煙花爆竹企業全面停產整頓】據湖南日報5月5日訊息，記者5日從省應急管理廳獲悉，即日起，全省煙花爆竹企業全面停產整頓，全力防範和消除各類安全隱患。 此次停產整頓將聚焦生產、經營、運輸、燃放、產品質量、出口等環節，重點查處企業“三超一改”、分包轉包、生產經營超標違禁產品、多股東獨立生產等問題。嚴格落實“五個一批”要求，即：打擊一批非法違法行為，關閉退出一批違法從業單位，清理銷燬一批超標違禁產品，集中曝光一批典型案例，通報約談一批問題突出地區，確保煙花爆竹行業領域非法違法行為得到有效整治。 同時，舉一反三，在全省進一步深入開展安全生產隱患大排查、大整治，對重點行業拉網式排查，堵塞漏洞，壓實責任，全力提升本質安全水平，守牢守嚴紅線、底線。（湖南日報）

Baltic Dry Index at 5-Month High — The Baltic Exchange's dry bulk freight index, which monitors rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, climbed about 3.7% to the highest since early December 2025 at 2,832 points on Tuesday, buoyed by the larger vessel segments. The capesize index, which typically transports 150,000-ton cargoes including iron ore and coal, jumped 5.8% to a five-month peak of 4,703 points; and the panamax index, which usually carries 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, rose 2.6% to 2,054 points. On the other hand, the supramax index decreased by 0.8% to 1,508 points.

Gasoline Futures Fall from 4-Year High — US gasoline futures eased to $3.63 per gallon from a near four-year high of $3.74 reached on May 4, after Washington downplayed the risk of a renewed full-scale conflict with Iran following recent clashes in the Strait of Hormuz and missile strikes on the United Arab Emirates. US officials said the incidents did not violate the ceasefire that has been in place for nearly a month, helping calm market concerns despite ongoing tensions. The standoff between the US and Iran continues, with little progress toward new talks as Tehran demands an end to the naval blockade while Washington maintains pressure on Iran’s oil exports. Meanwhile, data from the Energy Information Administration showed gasoline demand edged higher to 9.10 million barrels per day, while inventories fell and production declined slightly.

Lithium Rises 50% YTD — Lithium carbonate prices in China surpassed CNY 175,000 per tone in May, gaining 50% this year toward to approach the highest level since 2023 amid growing long-term demand. The surge in crude oil and product prices since the start of March supported the outlook for larger economies to favor new energy vehicles, which use batteries that take lithium as a major input. Likewise, BYD forecasted it will sell 1.5 million units overseas this year, revised higher from the January estimate of 1.3 million units. Demand also remained supported by Chinese investment in power infrastructure, recently consolidated with Beijing stating it would double national EV charging capacity to 180 gigawatts by 2027. Fresh buying is also featured from data center operators, whose power storage systems require more lithium than those used by EVs, on the historical capital investments by AI companies and hardware producers.

France’s Budget Deficit Narrows in Q1 2026 — France’s state budget deficit shrank to €42.9 billion in January–March 2026, down from €47.0 billion a year earlier. Special Treasury accounts posted a deficit of €11.7 billion, nearly unchanged from €11.8 billion in the same period last year.

Brent Crude Slips Below $112 — Brent crude futures slipped below $112 per barrel on Tuesday, reversing gains from the previous session, after US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the ceasefire with Iran remains in place despite this week’s attacks on the UAE. He added that the Strait of Hormuz is open, noting that two US commercial vessels transited safely with US military support, which repelled attacks from Iranian drones, missiles, and armed small boats. Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 Extend Record Highs — US equities rose to fresh peaks on Tuesday as a pullback in energy prices tamed yesterday's risk of more aggressive inflation this year. The S%P 500 and the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.7% to record highs, and the Dow rose 0.5%. Oil and product prices eased as the strikes between Iran against the US and UAE yesterday did not result in all-out attacks against Iranian energy infrastructure, preventing the worsening of an already serios energy shock for economies that import from the Middle East. High energy costs had already driven bets of a Fed hike this year. The JOLTS reflected a robust labor market in March and strong ISM results, including surging prices, aligned with arguments from hawkish Fed dissenters. Intel surged 14% on reports that it may produce processors for Apple devices. Amazon also gained on fresh additions of logistics and distribution. In turn, Palantir dropped 3% after missing the market's ambitious guidance estimates, and AMD sank ahead of its results after the bell.

US Economic Sentiment Weakens Further — The RealClearMarkets/TIPP Economic Optimism Index eased further to 42.6 in May 2026, the lowest level since June 2024, down from 42.8 in April , though above the expected 42. The index has now remained below the neutral 50 mark for nine consecutive months, indicating sustained pessimism. The Six-Month Economic Outlook, which measures consumers’ views on the economy’s prospects over the next six months, fell 1.8% from 38.5 in April to 37.8 in May, its lowest level since June 2024. The Personal Financial Outlook, which tracks Americans’ expectations for their own finances over the next six months, was broadly unchanged, edging up 0.2% from 50.2 to 50.3, remaining just above neutral. Confidence in Federal Economic Policies, which gauges views on the effectiveness of government economic policy, was unchanged at 39.8 from April.

【香港可持續航空燃料基地落戶東莞】香港可持續航空燃料基地正式落戶東莞，相關投資意向協議今天（5日）在香港簽署。這將是粵港澳大灣區建立的首條完整可持續航空燃料產業鏈。 香港特區行政長官李家超表示：“推動可持續航空燃料（SAF）產業鏈發展，是香港對接國家‘十五五’規劃、響應國家綠色發展戰略的具體行動。” 香港中華煤氣有限公司主席李家傑介紹，在東莞興建的新工廠，預計年產約45萬噸的SAF及氫化植物油（HVO），形成“大灣區生物質廢料—東莞精煉生產—香港摻混、加註和交易”的模式。當前，全球主要航空樞紐已進入SAF產業化競速階段，香港生產商怡斯萊未來5年至10年會在大灣區投資逾100億港元，提升香港航空和新能源產業競爭力。（大灣區之聲）

【Apollo經濟學家稱AI最終會創造更多崗位】 Apollo Global Management的首席經濟學家Torsten Slok表示，人工智慧帶來生產率提升，最終創造的崗位可能會多於流失的崗位。Slok週二在接受採訪時表示：“整體而言，從各個行業來看，生產投入成本基本上都有所下降。”他說，當投入成本變得更低時，“對這些投入的需求就會增加”。他以放射科醫生為例稱，隨著AI降低了影像判讀成本，該領域的就業和薪資正在上升。市場對AI衝擊勞動力市場的擔憂十分普遍。諾貝爾獎得主、經濟學家Simon Johnson表示，他認為“高薪工作”可能消失；OpenAI上月也提出政策建議，旨在幫助應對AI驅動的動盪時代。儘管如此，也有人預計AI將帶來積極影響。德國央行行長Joachim Nagel今年3月對德國學生表示，廣泛使用AI的歐洲企業大多反映正在招聘員工。

US New Home Sales Jump 7.4% in March — Sales of new single-family homes in the US rose 7.4% month-over-month to 682,000 in March 2026, exceeding expectations of 650,000 and up from 635,000 in February. Gains were led by the South (+11.1% to 441,000) and the Northeast (+80.0% to 27,000), offsetting declines in the West (-3.5% to 138,000) and Midwest (-5.0% to 76,000). Housing supply stood at 481,000 units, representing 8.5 months at the current sales pace, while the median new home price fell 6.2% year-over-year to $387,400.

【法國議會兩院對等混合委員會透過草案 簡化非法所獲文物歸還程式】法國議會兩院對等混合委員會日前就一項旨在簡化非法所獲他國文物歸還程式的法律草案達成一致。該草案文字將於6日和7日分別在法國國民議會（議會下院）和參議院（議會上院）審議。這項草案旨在簡化法國公共領域的非法所獲他國文物歸還程式。根據法國現行法律，所謂“納入公共領域的文物原則上不可轉讓”，歸還相關文物需逐案立法處理，程式較為複雜。而最新草案擬建立一套制度性機制：允許在符合歸還條件的情況下，將1815年至1972年間法國以偷盜、掠奪等方式所得的外國文物，從公共領域中“移出”，簡化歸還程式。屆時歸還事宜還可透過行政程式批准，無需逐案立法。（新華社）

【C919大飛機首飛九週年 4月航班量同比增長117.9%】5月5日，國產大飛機C919迎來首飛9週年。航班管家資料顯示，截至2026年4月末，C919累計執飛商業客運航班已超過4.2萬班次，運營規模持續擴大。僅2026年4月，當月執飛航班量 3190班次，同比大幅增長117.9%，展現出強勁的市場運營能力。航線網路方面，自投入執行以來，C919已累計執飛往返航線57條（單程113條），覆蓋29座機場，其中包括28座境內機場及港澳臺機場1座（中國香港），航線佈局穩步拓展。（新華財經）
【美軍隨時準備恢復對伊朗大規模作戰】美軍參謀長聯席會議主席凱恩5月5日在新聞釋出會上稱，美軍隨時準備好恢復對伊朗大規模作戰，只待指令下達。凱恩稱，美軍中央司令部及其他聯合作戰部隊始終保持高度戒備，一旦接到命令，隨時準備對伊朗發起大規模作戰行動。他表示，重啟對伊軍事行動的門檻是一項政治決定。目前，美軍仍處於低烈度軍事行動階段。（CCTV國際時訊）

US Job Quits Rise in March — The number of job quits in the US rose to 3.171 million in March 2026 from the upwardly revised 3.046 million in February but below 3.456 million a year ago. The number of quits increased the most in healthcare and social assistance (+37,000); accommodation and food services (+25,000) and real estate and rental and leasing (+19,000). The quits rate, a metric that measures voluntary job leavers as a proportion of total employment, rose to 2% from 1.9% previously.

Canada Services PMI Improves in April — Canada’s S&P Global Services PMI Business Activity Index rose to 49.2 in April from 47.2 in March, but remained below the 50.0 threshold for a sixth straight month. The sector showed signs of stabilization, with activity declining only marginally and at the slowest pace in six months. Firms increased staffing levels for the first time since August 2025, while business confidence climbed to a one-and-a-half-year high. However, concerns over the Middle East conflict and tariffs persisted, with firms reporting higher operating costs. Selling prices rose at the fastest pace in two years, reflecting mounting cost pressures.

ISM Services PMI Inches Down as Expected — The ISM Services PMI inched down to 53.6 in April of 2026 from 54 in the previous month, loosely aligned with market expectations of 53.7, but remained firmly above averages from the previous year. The index measuring business activity and output rose by 2 points to 55.9, consolidating the initial resilience of the US economy to the outbreak of war in the Middle East, which triggered a surge in a wide range of energy costs for businesses. The increase in production was due to a drop in the backlog of orders (-0.6 to 53) as the gauge for new orders sank 7.1 points to 53.5. Meanwhile, employment rose by 2.8 points to 4, but remained below the 50 threshold for a second month. Prices continued to surge with their gauge coming at 70.7, the highest since 2022, largely due to energy costs.

【美國服務業增長降溫 新訂單創三年來最大降幅】美國美國供應管理協會（ISM）調查顯示，受新訂單增長創三年來最大降幅以及成本壓力維持在2022年末以來高位的影響，美國服務業擴張在4月連續第二個月放緩。ISM4月非製造業PMI從3月的54.0降至53.6，略低於預期的53.7。調查中的商業活動分項指數實際上上升了2點至55.9，但其他分項表現更為疲弱。新訂單指數從3月創下的三年高點60.6降至53.5，下降7.1點，為自2023年3月以來最大降幅。與此同時，成本壓力並未緩解，支付價格指數維持在70.7不變，處於自2022年10月以來的高位。

TSX Edges Up as Oil Eases — The S&P/TSX Composite edged higher to trade above 33,500 on Tuesday, as oil prices declined but remained elevated amid ongoing Middle East tensions. The US and Iran launched fresh attacks in the Gulf on Monday, intensifying their standoff over the Strait of Hormuz. The prospect of softer energy prices eased concerns about broad inflation, supporting banks and the broader index. Royal Bank of Canada and TD Bank edged higher. Gold prices rose, lifting miners, with Barrick (+1.0%) and Wheaton Precious Metals (+1.0%) advancing. Cameco (+2.8%) gained after reporting higher Q1 earnings and EBITDA, driven by stronger uranium and fuel sales. Meanwhile, Shopify sank 10% despite beating Q1 revenue estimates and reporting a rise in gross profit to $1.54 billion from $1.16 billion a year earlier, as net income fell short. Suncor Energy (+0.3%) is set to report earnings after the close.

US Job Openings Fall Less than Expected — Job openings in the US fell by 56,000 to 6.866 million in March 2026, above market expectations of 6.84 million. The number of job openings decreased in professional and business services (-318,000) but increased in finance and insurance (+98,000). Meanwhile, hires increased to 5.6 million while total separations changed little at 5.4 million. Within separations, both quits (3.2 million) and layoffs and discharges (1.9 million) were little changed.

Ibovespa Rises on Corporate Earnings and Copom Minutes — The Ibovespa edged up to trade near 186,000 on Tuesday, as investors digested Copom minutes and a wave of corporate earnings. The central bank noted that the increase in inflation is unlikely to prevent more rate cuts this year, although threats to the anchor of inflation expectations may reduce the magnitude of cuts compared to those expected earlier. Banks advanced, with Bradesco (+1.0%) and Banco do Brasil (+2.0%) higher. Ambev jumped over 10% after reporting Q1 net income of R$3.89 billion, up 2.1% year-on-year. After the close, C&A (+1.3%), Iguatemi (+1.5%), Itaú (+0.2%), Prio (-2.3%), RD Saúde (+1.4%), and TIM (+1.4%) are set to report results. Elsewhere, UBS BB raised Sabesp’s (-0.9%) target price to R$38 from R$33.80 but downgraded the stock to neutral. Petrobras fell over 1% as oil prices declined despite Middle East tensions.

US Private Sector Activity Grows Less than Initially Thought — The S&P Global US Composite PMI was revised down to 51.7 in April 2026 from a preliminary 52.0, yet still improved from March’s 50.3. Growth was driven by a rebound in services and stronger manufacturing, though new orders and employment saw only modest increases. Business confidence improved from March. Price pressures intensified, with input cost inflation hitting the highest level of 2026 so far, and selling prices rising at the fastest pace in nine months.

【李嘉誠家族擬拋售43億英鎊英國資產】5月5日午間，李嘉誠家族旗下的港股上市公司長和披露了一筆價值約455億港元的交易。公告稱，長和旗下電訊業務集團CKHGT已同意出售其於英國電訊業務VodafoneThree所持有的全數股權，收取43億英鎊（相當於454.94億港元）的代價金額，有關交易須待相關監管機構批准。據瞭解，VodafoneThree的主要業務為流動網路營運，目前為英國最大流動網路營運商，擁有超過2800萬名客戶。（上證報）

【機構：霍爾木茲海峽持續受阻料將推高穀物期貨】霍爾木茲海峽的交通受阻一直對芝加哥期貨交易所的穀物期貨構成支撐，但一些分析師預計，如果衝突很快得到解決，價格將迅速逆轉。AgResource在一份報告中表示：“以美國和全球庫存與使用比率衡量，穀物估值遠高於‘合理價值’，而穀物分析師幾十年來一直使用該比率。”該公司表示，這就是為什麼霍爾木茲海峽的局勢是芝加哥期貨交易所價格的最大影響因素。這場戰爭已推動穀物期貨年初至今上漲，但今天上午稍作喘息——芝加哥期貨交易所玉米期貨下跌0.7%，大豆期貨下跌0.4%，小麥期貨下跌1%。

【美國國債收益率在勞動力資料公佈前下跌】在關鍵勞動力資料即將公佈以及美國總統特朗普與伊朗維持脆弱停火之際，對美國政府債券的需求走強，推動美國國債收益率走低。3月份貿易逆差從修正後的578億美元擴大至603億美元。經濟學家此前預計為609億美元。職位空缺和勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)報告將於美東時間上午10點公佈。本週勞動力資料可能會受到投資者的密切關注。市場普遍預計美聯儲將在明年很長一段時間內維持利率不變，但如果就業市場迅速走軟，這種情況可能會改變。10年期美國國債收益率從隔夜的4.460%降至4.418%。兩年期美國國債收益率從3.991%降至3.927%。30年期美國國債收益率略高於5%。

Silver Rebounds on Middle East Uncertainty — Silver prices climbed to $73.5 per ounce on Tuesday, recovering from a near-2% drop in the previous session, as investors monitored escalating Middle East tensions and their potential to stoke inflation and alter interest rate expectations. A shaky truce in the region came under further strain following US-Iran clashes in the Gulf, with both nations competing for control of the Strait of Hormuz, which has been effectively closed since the war began. US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth warned that President Donald Trump could restart "major combat operations" against Iran if needed. Rising energy costs risk driving inflation higher and postponing central bank rate cuts. Though precious metals are traditional inflation hedges, their appeal fades in high-rate environments, as non-yielding assets become less attractive. Meanwhile, the IMF chief warned that a prolonged conflict into 2027, with oil at $125 per barrel, could lead to a "much worse" global economic outcome.

【中東戰爭對需求的衝擊加劇 美國服務業增長動能明顯放緩】標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家Chris Williamson表示,“3月份小幅下滑之後，美國商業活動重新恢復增長，但很明顯，自年初以來，增長動能已經明顯放緩。調查資料顯示，GDP年化增速約為溫和的1%。增長可能會進一步走弱，因為服務業兩年來首次報告新業務流入減少，反映出中東戰爭對需求的衝擊正在加劇。戰爭的直接影響在服務領域最為明顯，高企的價格已導致可選消費（如度假和娛樂）出現回落，同時，高燃料成本和出行受阻也抑制了運輸活動。不過，金融服務需求的下降，這在一定程度上與市場前景不確定性上升有關，也反映出市場對更高通脹和利率衝擊房地產和信貸活動的預期。投入成本通脹進一步上升，燃料價格上漲，商品和服務價格普遍走高，工資也在上漲。這些因素將在未來幾個月傳導至消費者通脹。”

US Services Activity Revised Lower — The S&P Global US Services PMI rose to 51 in April of 2026 from the three-year low of 49.8 in the previous month, revised slightly downward from the flash estimate of 51.3 but still ahead of the initial market expectations of 50. The result reflected a tentative recovery from the sharp and immediate impact of the war in the Middle East, which triggered supply risks for energy consumer that sent commodity pries soaring. Still, new business intake fell for the first time in two years, with panelists citing higher uncertainty from clients due to the war and fresh tariff concerns from the US government. Still, employment increased, particularly for part-time positions. Meanwhile, input price inflation remained elevated due to higher fuel and gas prices, in addition to increasing staffing costs, driving sellers to increase their charges. Looking ahead, business expectations remained high on hopes of an end to the Middle East war.

【受中東戰事影響 德國工商大會下調德企出口預期】德國工商大會5日釋出的一項調查結果顯示，受中東局勢特別是伊朗戰事影響，德國企業海外經營預期明顯轉弱，出口前景預期由此前的小幅增長轉為停滯，外部環境不確定性持續上升。該調查覆蓋逾4500家企業。近三分之一受訪企業認為，衝突暴露全球供應鏈脆弱性，這些企業預計相關市場經濟形勢將進一步趨緊。前景預期方面，調查顯示企業信心明顯走弱，預計經濟形勢將惡化的企業比例由中東衝突前的24%升至32%，表明企業對外部環境的擔憂加劇。德國工商大會預計，今年德國出口或難以實現增長，而此前預期將增長1%。（新華社）

S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 Rise to Record Highs — US equities rose to fresh peaks on Tuesday as a pullback in energy prices tamed yesterday's risk of more aggressive inflation this year. The S%P 500 and the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.7% to record highs, and the Dow rose 0.5%. Oil and product prices eased as the strikes between Iran against the US and UAE yesterday did not result in all-out attacks against Iranian energy infrastructure, preventing the worsening of an already serios energy shock for economies that import from the Middle East. High energy costs had already driven bets of a Fed hike this year, as high and broad inflation combine with evidence of a strong labor market. Earnings also remained in the spotlight. Pfizer was 1% higher after posting their results. Also, Intel gained over 4% on reports that it may produce processors for Apple devices. Amazon also gained on fresh additions of logistics and distribution services. In turn, Palantir dropped 3% after missing the market's ambitious guidance estimates.

Canada Private Sector Nears Stabilization — The S&P Global Canada Composite PMI rose to 49.9 in April 2026 from 47.6 in March, nearing the neutral 50 threshold and signaling a stabilization in business activity. A solid increase in manufacturing output helped offset a slight contraction in the services sector. New orders improved, and employment expanded for the first time in nearly a year, pointing to a modest recovery in demand. However, cost pressures remained elevated, with input price inflation largely unchanged, while output prices rose at the fastest pace since July 2023, indicating firms are passing higher costs on to customers.

Swiss 10-Year Bond Yield Little Changed — Switzerland’s 10-year government bond yield hovered just above 0.4%, retreating from a recent nine-month peak of nearly 0.5%, as investors evaluated the Swiss National Bank’s policy path while tracking stalled US-Iran negotiations. Headline inflation rate rose to 0.6% in April, the highest since December 2024, from 0.3% in March, sitting slightly above the 0.5% average projected by the SNB for this year. The increase was largely driven by higher energy prices, as the Middle East conflict pushed petrol prices sharply higher. Meanwhile, core inflation edged down to 0.3% from 0.4% in March, marking the softest increase since July 2021, easing pressure on the central bank to change policy. The appreciation of the franc amid ongoing safe-haven demand due to persistent geopolitical tensions and Switzerland’s low energy dependence should soften the impact on consumer prices. The SNB is expected to keep interest rates at 0% in June and possibly over the next 12 months.

Canada Imports Fall in March — Canada’s imports fell 1.6% month-on-month to C$72.8 billion in March 2026, with declines in 8 of 11 product categories. Consumer goods imports dropped 3.9%, led by a 9.3% fall in pharmaceuticals after a 14.4% surge in February. Decreases were also seen in clothing, shoes and accessories (-4.2%), other food products (-4.1%), miscellaneous goods (-2.7%), and meat products (-9.3%). Imports of aircraft and other transportation equipment plunged 12.8% after a 13.0% jump in February, driven by a 64.4% drop in aircraft purchases, as February’s elevated imports from the US were not repeated. Despite the monthly decline, total imports rose 4.6% in Q1 2026, with over two-thirds of the increase driven by metal and non-metallic mineral products, which surged 38.1%.

【美媒：美以正在協調 或準備對伊朗發動新一輪打擊】美國有線電視新聞網5日援引以色列訊息人士的話報道說，隨著霍爾木茲海峽緊張局勢升級，以色列正與美國協調，“為可能對伊朗發動的新一輪打擊”做準備。該訊息人士稱，新一輪打擊目標將集中在能源基礎設施和伊朗高階官員，旨在透過一場短期行動向伊朗施壓，迫使其在談判中作出更多讓步。但該訊息人士強調，是否恢復打擊仍取決於美國總統特朗普。特朗普對美伊談判陷入僵局以及無法開放霍爾木茲海峽“感到沮喪”。（新華社）

【美國關鍵國債收益率突破5% 凸顯債券市場面臨越來越大壓力】在本週初自7月份以來首次突破5%這一關鍵水平後，30年期美國國債收益率一直在5%左右徘徊，表明全球最大債券市場的壓力並未減輕。這是一個具有特殊重要性的門檻，交易員正關注是否有跡象顯示收益率可能進一步上移。截至週二美東時間上午6:42，該收益率報5.01%，週一曾觸及5.03%。債券拋售的核心原因是，隨著霍爾木茲海峽仍處於關閉狀態以及油價飆升，市場對通脹以及降息次數可能減少產生了新一輪擔憂。企業在人工智慧上的大量支出，也引發了對短期內價格漲幅可能加快的擔憂。

【部分歐洲監管機構對特斯拉FSD安全持懷疑態度】特斯拉執行長埃隆・馬斯克表示，他有信心歐盟很快將批准這家車企的全自動駕駛系統。但部分歐洲監管機構的郵件顯示，他們對這項技術及其宣稱的安全效益持明顯懷疑態度。據報道，郵件顯示，荷蘭、瑞典、芬蘭、丹麥和挪威的監管機構對這項技術提出了多項顧慮，而這些國家在馬斯克推動FSD獲批的程序中擁有關鍵話語權。 監管方擔憂的問題包括：系統存在超速傾向、在結冰路面行駛的安全性，以及駕駛員能否繞過車載防手機使用的管控功能。 監管機構還對特斯拉的做法表示不滿——該公司公開號召車主向監管部門施壓，要求放行全自動駕駛系統。 歐盟委員會將於週二聽取荷蘭官員解釋批准特斯拉FSD的理由。
